evidence.title: SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY prilákal takmer 19-tisíc divákov: Bratislavský CINEMAX hlási historický rekord. AKÉ filmy pritiahli najviac?
evidence.text:
SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY prilákal takmer 19-tisíc divákov: Bratislavský CINEMAX hlási historický rekord. AKÉ filmy pritiahli najviac?

Kino opäť prilákalo tisíce Slovákov. SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY navštívilo v nedeľu 20. septembra v sieti CINEMAX takmer 19-tisíc divákov, čo potvrdilo veľký záujem o filmový zážitok na veľkom plátne. Rekordný deň má za sebou aj CINEMAX BORY MALL v Bratislave, ktorý zaznamenal historicky najvyššiu návštevnosť.

SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY sa v CINEMAX uskutočnil v nedeľu 20. septembra a priniesol výrazný záujem divákov naprieč celou sieťou . Za jediný deň sa predalo takmer 19 -tisíc lístkov. Návštevníci si vybrali z takmer 300 premietaní v 14 kinách v 12 slovenských mestách. V porovnaní s minulým rokom priemerná návštevnosť na jedno premietanie vzrástla o 10 percent. Záujem bol zároveň výrazne podporený online predajom, kde sa predalo viac ako 80 % vstupeniek.

Najúspešnejším kinom sa stalo CINEMAX BORY MALL v Bratislave, ktoré počas jedného dňa navštívilo viac ako 5 200 divákov. V porovnaní s minulým rokom ide o nárast o 17 percent a zároveň o historicky najvyššiu návštevnosť CINEMAX BORY MALL . K úspechu prispela aj atraktívna ponuka prémiových formátov a technológií vrátane IMAX, Ultra X a Premium Plus, ktoré mohli návštevníci vyskúšať len za 3,90 eur. CINEMAX sa počas SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY zároveň podieľal na celkovej návštevnosti trhu približne 80 percentami, pričom samotný CINEMAX BORY MALL t voril približne pätinu z návštevnosti CINEMAX. Aj tento výsledok ukazuje, akú silnú pozíciu má bratislavský CINEMAX BORY MALL medzi slovenskými kinami a aký veľký záujem je o prémiový filmový zážitok.

Najnavštevovanejším filmom dňa bol Resident Evil , ktorý si pozrelo takmer 3 900 divákov. V prvej trojici najsilnejších titulov sa ďalej umiestnili Spider-Man: Nový deň a Labková patrola: Dinosaurí film.

Výraznú časť návštevnosti tvorili aj deti a rodiny. Tituly Labková patrola, Mimoni a monštrá, Kojot vs. šmejdi a Aut á spolu predstavovali takmer štvrtinu všetkých predaných vstupeniek. SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY tak oslovil široké spektrum návštevníkov od filmových fanúšikov až po rodiny s deťmi.

Výsledky SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY ukazujú, že o kvalitný kino zážitok je medzi divákmi na Slovensku naďalej veľký záujem . Či už išlo o rodinný film, dlho očakávanú premiéru alebo filmový zážitok v prémiovej sále, diváci si SLOVAK TELEKOM CINEMA DAY užili naplno.

evidence.title: Slovak Telekom, T-Mobile Czech upgrade with 24i
evidence.text:
24i, the video streaming platform expert, gas announced that Slovak Telekom and T-Mobile Czech Republic, part of the Deutsche Telekom (DT) Group, have extended their engagement with 24i to feature new value-added content libraries, including synthetic channels, and streamline the user experience across their current streaming services T-MobileTV GO, Magio GO and Digi GO.

“From the beginning, 24i has been a key partner to ensure we are delivering the best possible experience for our subscribers,” said Marcel Satanek, TV & Entertainment Tribe Lead at Slovak Telekom. “Because of their video delivery, user experience and local market expertise, the 24i team was instrumental in developing a super-aggregation platform that meets today’s consumer expectations. We are already talking about the next round of exciting new capabilities.”

With 24i Video Cloud, Slovak Telekom and T-Mobile Czech Republic are rolling out a unique deployment strategy that includes:

● Super-aggregation: The video services are aggregating leading third-party services like Voyo and Canal+, offering a wider range of content to subscribers. Discussions are underway to bring even more international services through other partnerships already fully interoperable with 24i.

● Synthetic channels: Similar to FAST channels, but the operators have the option to assemble them without ads. This innovative approach aims to add further value to current subscribers by providing access to a wider content catalogue through these types of virtual channels.

● Player 2.0: The DT companies and 24i collaborated on a new player look and feel with enhanced functionalities.

evidence.title: Hungary Magyar Telekom revokes tariff hike plan
evidence.text:
Hungary Magyar Telekom revokes tariff hike plan

Telekom announced on 16 January 2025 that it would implement an inflation-linked tariff adjustment of 3.7% with effect from 1 April 2025, similar to the price increases of the other two major domestic telecom operators.

In view of the economic environment in Hungary and the government's measures to curb inflation, the company has decided

not to implement the previously announced inflation-linked tariff adjustment for consumers and not to implement unilateral price increases and inflation-linked tariff adjustments until at least the end of the first half of 2026,

Last week, Márton Nagy met twice with the heads of the national telecom companies to discuss telecom tariffs . The government has said it expects operators to 'voluntarily' cap tariffs to curb inflation, or it will resort to regulation. There had been talk of the government expecting at least a 10% cut in charges, but more recently there have been reports that the increases planned for this year will be reversed by the telecoms operators.

In recent years, telecom operators have increased their subscription prices each year by roughly the official inflation rate of the previous year.

In 2022, domestic telecoms companies faced a significant increase in costs as inflation soared to double-digit levels not seen since the late 1990s. In a tight labour market, the rise in labour costs has been exacerbated by soaring energy prices due to the outbreak of the Russian-Ukrainian war, to which telecoms companies are vulnerable as energy costs weigh heavily on their operations. In the meantime, they have also been burdened with billions of forints in extra-profit taxes on the telecoms sector. In this context, the telcos decided to introduce annual tariff increases linked to inflation.

In September 2022, Magyar Telekom included an inflation-linked fee adjustment clause in the general terms and conditions of its customer contracts , according to which the monthly subscription fees will be adjusted annually in line with the average consumer price index of the previous business year published by the Central Statistical Office (KSH).

Accordingly, MTel has increased its tariffs by 14.5% from March 2023. In 2024, it implemented a 15% hike, lower than the previous year's inflation rate (17.6%), citing strong competition in the market, while from 1 April 2025, the increase was expected to be 3.7%, in line with the 2024 annual inflation rate.

Competitors have done just about the same, with Yettel announcing increases of 14.5% in 2023, 15.3% from 2024 and 3.7% from 2025. 4iG has announced price increases of 14.9% for Digi and 15.4% for Vodafone in 2024 for its telecoms services, now combined under the One brand, and One has announced a 3.5% tariff increase for this year.

Thanks to inflation-linked tariff raises, domestic telecom companies have been "shielded" from the cost-increasing effects of inflation. This has led to a spectacular turnaround in Magyar Telekom's investment story, resulting in a massive increase in revenues, which in turn has led to a significant improvement in profit levels.

Meanwhile, 4iG was in the process of integrating previously acquired companies, but after consolidation last year it was able to show double-digit growth in both revenue and EBITDA, with the base period also largely including Vodafone, 4iG's last major telecoms acquisition.

The improvement in earnings was further supported by the government's abolition of the utility tax for telecoms companies from 2024 and the phasing out of the special telecoms tax from 2025, which has deprived the country's major telecoms companies of billions of forints in revenue since 2022. For Telekom, for example, the two together amounted to around HUF 35 billion in 2023, and more than HUF 6 billion for the 4iG subsidiaries.

However, the government did not give the abolition of the special taxes "for free", but signed a cooperation agreement with both Magyar Telekom and 4iG to use the remaining amount for infrastructure investments in support of the national digitalisation strategy.

Of the two major telecoms companies listed on the Hungarian stock exchange, Magyar Telekom has a public guidance for revenue growth of 1-3% this year on a tariff increase of 3.7%, as the tariff adjustment only affects subscriptions and not total revenue.

At the EBITDA AL level, management forecast growth of 12-15%, while analysts project revenue growth of 4%, EBITDA growth of 12.5% and after-tax profit growth of 21.5% for 2025, according to the Refinitiv consensus.

magyar telekom did not say in today's statement whether a change in its targets should be expected or not.

With telecoms tariffs now in the government's inflation reduction crosshairs after the retail sector and banks, shares in Magyar Telekom and 4iG have also fallen, helped by the general deterioration in market sentiment in recent days as a result of the tariff war.

evidence.title: Hrvatski Telekom i Deutsche Telekom lansirali putnički eSIM T-Travel
evidence.text:
Hrvatski Telekom i Deutsche Telekom lansirali putnički eSIM T-Travel

Tržište putničkih eSIM-ova ubrzano raste, dok nova usluga nudi mobilni internet putnicima u više od 200 svjetskih odredišta

Hrvatski Telekom i Deutsche Telekom predstavili su T-Travel , novu digitalnu eSIM platformu koja putnicima omogućuje pristup mobilnom internetu u više od 200 odredišta diljem svijeta. U razvoju globalnog proizvoda važnu je ulogu imao tim Hrvatskog Telekoma, koji je sudjelovao u razvoju korisničkog iskustva, ponude, cjenovnog modela i poslovnih partnerstava.

T-Travel je namijenjen putnicima koji žele biti povezani odmah po dolasku u drugu zemlju, bez traženja lokalne fizičke SIM kartice i bez nepredviđenih troškova roaminga. Cijeli je proces digitalan – korisnik odabire odredište, trajanje putovanja i podatkovni paket te ga aktivira na uređaju koji podržava eSIM.

T-Travel nudi četiri opcije – Lite, Standard, Max i Unlimited – s razdobljem valjanosti od jednog do 30 dana . Količina podatkovnog prometa i cijena ovise o odredištu i trajanju putovanja.

Korisnici mogu na jednom mjestu upravljati s više eSIM paketa, primjerice za članove obitelji ili suputnike, dok je korisnička podrška dostupna 24 sata dnevno, sedam dana u tjednu.

- Putovanja su danas gotovo nezamisliva bez mobitela. Koristimo ga za navigaciju, rezervacije, plaćanje, prijevoz i komunikaciju gdje god se nalazili pa nam je od početka bilo važno da T-Travel upravo taj dio putovanja po dolasku na novo odredište učini što jednostavnijim - izjavio je Krešimir Madunović, član Uprave i glavni operativni direktor za privatne korisnike Hrvatskog Telekoma.

Kako navodi Madunović, stručnjaci Hrvatskog Telekoma sudjelovali su u razvoju proizvoda namijenjenog korisnicima diljem svijeta.

- Fokus nam je bio na tome da cijeli korisnički put, od odabira odredišta i odgovarajućeg paketa do aktivacije eSIM-a, bude što jednostavniji, brži i intuitivniji i time lako dostupan svima - pojasnio je Madunović.

T-Travel je zasebna digitalna usluga i ne mijenja postojeće roaming pogodnosti korisnika Hrvatskog Telekoma i drugih društava Deutsche Telekom Grupe. Prvenstveno je namijenjen putnicima koji nisu njihovi korisnici. Usluga je dostupna putem internetske stranice t-travel.com i mobilne aplikacije T-Travel, neovisno o tome kojeg mobilnog operatora korisnik inače koristi.

eSIM tržište sve veće, roaming pod pritiskom

Ulazak Deutsche Telekoma i Hrvatskog Telekoma dolazi u trenutku kada tržište putničkih eSIM-ova snažno raste. Prema procjenama FDM CCS Insighta koje je ranije objavio Financial Times, ove bi se godine u svijetu trebalo koristiti oko 134 milijuna putničkih eSIM-ova , nasuprot 101,8 milijuna u 2025. godini.

Na tržište su uz specijalizirane aplikacije poput Airala i Sailya ušli i fintechovi poput Revoluta i Klarne, koji korisnicima nude vlastite eSIM pakete. Upravo o tome kako novi igrači pritiskaju tradicionalni roaming te kako se razvija tržište putničkih eSIM-ova Lider je već pisao.

Prema procjenama STL Partnersa tržište putničkih eSIM-ova vrijedilo je 649 milijuna funti u 2025. godini i do 2030. moglo bi dosegnuti 3,2 milijarde funti.

Trend se prelijeva i na hrvatsko tržište. HAKOM-ovi podaci pokazuju da su prihodi hrvatskih operatora od podatkovnog roaminga stranaca pali s oko 56,6 milijuna eura u 2024. na oko 55,3 milijuna eura u 2025. godini, odnosno za 2,2 posto. U prvom tromjesečju 2026. iznosili su 2,99 milijuna eura, što je 0,6 posto manje nego godinu ranije.

The approach reflects Hrvatski Telekom’s pragmatic view of AI adoption. The expanded collaboration positions Hrvatski Telekom as a strong example of practical AI adoption in European telecoms, demonstrating how communications services providers (CSPs) can move from digital transformation toward AI-enabled business growth, while keeping customer value at the center.

evidence.title: Hrvatski Telekom and Markoja introduce wooden mobile tower
evidence.text:
Hrvatski Telekom and Markoja introduce wooden mobile tower

The tower made of technologically treated wood provides support for mobile antennas and other telecom kit for up to four carriers

5G vendors have made notable gains in reducing power consumption but not as much has been done about making passive tower equipment greener. Hrvatski Telekom wants to change that and has teamed up with Markoja to install a wooden mast, called Ecopol, n the village of Gradići, municipality of Velika Gorica. It is a free-standing, 40-metre-high cone-shaped tower, made of technologically processed wood. The telco said this innovative material ensures elasticity and long-term durability, with minimal impact on the environment.

Each tower can carry equipment from up to four different telecoms, and Hrvatski Telekom was the first to install antennas on the tower in Gradići, opening the door for other operators. According to the companies, Ecopoles also emit half as much carbon dioxide as traditional steel towers, and the materials used are completely recyclable.

“The Ecopol project represents an innovative step towards sustainable infrastructure, important for the development of the 5G network in Croatia. Telecommunication towers made of wooden construction, such as Ecopol in Gradići, not only reduce CO2 emissions in half compared to traditional steel poles, but also bring long-term resistance and greater security for cables that are integrated within the structure,” said Hrvatski Telekom technology and information technology member of the board Boris Drilo.

“Recyclable materials and innovative fire-resistant wood elements make it applicable in natural and tourist areas that require aesthetic and environmental compliance,” he added.

Ecopolis are designed with a focus on safety, including fire resistance and additional protection of built-in cables. “We are proud that Hrvatski Telekom was the first national operator to recognise the value of our Ecopol and set up its antennas on this innovative communication pillar, thus opening a new chapter in the development of sustainable telecommunications infrastructure in Croatia,” said Markoja founder and CEO Boris Markoja.

“This project perfectly reflects our commitment to the ‘5E’ values – energy, ecology, economics, aesthetics and ethics. Ecopol provides top-notch support for modern 5G technology with a significant reduction in CO₂ emissions, proving that technology and ecology can go hand in hand,” he said. “Our goal is to build the foundations for the future development of smart communities, all in line with sustainable business that contributes to the local population and the environment.”

In July this year, Markoja became a significant minority owner of the Finnish company Ecotelligent, which develops and builds passive telecommunications infrastructure made of engineered wood (LVL), and Markoja is the exclusive distributor of these poles in Croatia and the region. So far, two Ecopolis have been built, one in Gradići and the other in Podcrkavlje in Slavonia, and the third is currently under construction in the vicinity of Daruvar.

Markoja and Ecotelligent plan to expand the network of Ecopol towers across Europe, with a special focus on underserved areas and tourist centres, in cooperation with local communities and state-owned telecommunications and infrastructure operators.

evidence.title: Hrvatski Telekom connects container port in Rijeka, Croatia, with 5G network
evidence.text:
READ: How OpenAI made the network 'dumb' for AI

Hrvatski Telekom connects container port in Rijeka, Croatia, with 5G network

Will enable for dedicated network slices for industrial applications

Hrvatski Telekom (HT) has this week equipped a container port in Rijeka, Croatia, with a 5G network.

The telco said it was selected by port operating company Rijeka Gateway (APM Terminals), a company founded by A.P. Moller-Maersk and the ENNA Group, to develop and manage the network at the terminal in Rijeka.

Operations at the terminal are set to start next year.

Deutsche Telekom-owned HT said that APM Terminals will test this new operating model in Rijeka, and will migrate from 5G Non-Standalone (5G NSA) architecture to 5G Standalone (5G SA), enabling dedicated network slicing for industrial applications.

5G SA is not reliant on older mobile generations and solely uses a 5G core network.

The service increases network capacity, cuts latency, and can connect to an increased amount of connected devices.

Network slicing allows telcos, such as HT, to create separate and isolated networks for different use cases, while the slice can be configured differently.

"This project demonstrates Rijeka Gateway's confidence in our ability to provide a high availability service for flawless 24/7 port operations. It confirms our strategy in providing business-critical communication through our public mobile network," said Marijana Bačić, a management board member and chief operating officer for Business at Hrvatski Telekom.

Peter Corfitsen, CEO of Rijeka Gateway, claims the terminal in Rijeka "will be the only terminal in this part of Europe with remotely operated cranes."

"In Rijeka, we are developing one of the most technologically advanced terminals. From the beginning of designing the terminal, we defined the goal of minimizing the terminal's impact on the environment and the local community," he said. "Almost all equipment will be electric, and we are installing very advanced energy optimization and overall terminal management systems."

Back in November 2021, APM Terminals (51 percent) and Enna Logic (49 percent) signed a concession agreement to design, construct, and operate a state-of-the-art container terminal, Rijeka Gateway, on Croatia's North Adriatic coast.

The Rijeka Gateway is being developed in two phases, with phase one due for completion next year.

Total investments in Croatia by Maersk, Enna Logic, and Rijeka Gateway are expected to be more than €480 million ($521m) by 2026.

Hrvatski was founded on December 1998 after the separation of the Croatian Post and Telecommunications into two entities: Croatian Post and Hrvatski Telekom (aka Croatian Telecom). Deutsche Telekom acquired a majority stake in Hrvatski in 2001.

V ospredju razprav so bile trgovina, Tajvan in umetna inteligenca.

Umetna inteligenca spreminja poslovno analitiko v pogovor s podatki. A za odgovore, uporabne za poslovne odločitve, je potrebno še nekaj dela.

Izbor je končan. Člani strokovne komisije so med prijavljenimi rešitvami prepoznali premik od tehnoloških pilotov k delujočim storitvam, ki vključujejo prebivalce in povezujejo podatke. Opozarjajo pa, da bo treba številne napovedane učinke še dokazati z meritvami. Zmagovalce bomo razglasili 29. septembra v Ljubljani.

Marko Frankola, direktor DHL Global Forwarding Slovenija, o novih trgovinskih tokovih, panogah z največjim potencialom za rast ter tem, kako se podjetja prilagajajo vse bolj nepredvidljivim dobavnim verigam.

Zmagovalca lanskega natečaja poudarjata, da dober B2B-projekt ni nujno tehnološka revolucija, ampak rešitev konkretnega poslovnega izziva. Če ste s svojo digitalno rešitvijo izboljšali prodajo, procese ali sodelovanje s kupci, jo prijavite v izbor za Najboljši B2B e-commerce projekt 2026.

evidence.title: United Group Subsidiaries Vivacom & Mainstream Bulgaria Hit by Cyberattack
evidence.text:
United Group Subsidiaries Vivacom & Mainstream Bulgaria Hit by Cyberattack

United Group has confirmed that on the evening of Monday, 22 September, two of its subsidiaries in Bulgaria – Vivacom and Mainstream Bulgaria – were impacted by a malicious cyberattack carried out by external bad actors.

Thanks to swift containment measures, supported by leading cybersecurity specialists, the incident has been largely contained. An investigation is underway, and the relevant authorities and regulators have been notified in line with compliance obligations.

As a result of the attack, some of Vivacom’s business clients may be experiencing temporary technical difficulties with certain services. Restoring full functionality remains the highest priority for both Vivacom and Mainstream Bulgaria. Importantly, Vivacom’s core services – mobile and fixed connectivity – remain fully operational and unaffected. United Group strongly condemns these criminal acts, which are designed to disrupt businesses and inconvenience consumers for financial gain. Cyberattacks are an unfortunate reality for companies worldwide, and United Group continues to prioritise investment in the security and resilience of its networks across all markets in which it operates. The company is undertaking a thorough review of systems across the Group to identify any further vulnerabilities and reduce the risk of further incidents. United Group expressed regret for the disruption caused and thanked customers and partners for their understanding as remediation continues. The company remains fully committed to transparent communication and will provide further updates as appropriate.

evidence.title: Major outage at Vivacom leaves thousands without internet and phone access
evidence.text:
Major outage at Vivacom leaves thousands without internet and phone access

However, the company increased fees with the motive of better services

A serious technical problem at "Vivacom" affected thousands of the operator's subscribers this morning, leaving them completely without access to telephony and the internet. Users from different parts of the country are reporting a complete disruption of services - both mobile and fixed - without prior notice or explanation from the operator.

The problem appeared in the early morning hours and caused a wave of discontent on social networks. Users are reporting that they cannot make calls, use mobile internet or contact Vivacom's customer center, which also seems inaccessible.

For many of them, this is not a surprise, but rather another proof of the traditionally poor coverage and unstable internet connection that have been talked about for years. Today's outage, however, is among the largest to date and raises serious questions about the reliability of "Vivacom"'s network and their ability to respond adequately in critical situations.

At the moment, there is no official statement from the operator regarding the causes of the outage, nor an estimated time frame for full restoration of services. The lack of transparency further intensifies tensions among users, especially those who rely on mobile connections for work, distance learning or emergencies.

The situation calls into question not only the operator's technical stability, but also its communication strategy in times of crisis. While "Vivacom" remains silent, its subscribers wonder whether they can rely on the services they pay for every month.

evidence.title: Vivacom to Deliver High-Speed 5G Connectivity for First International AI Olympiad in Bulgaria
evidence.text:
Vivacom to Deliver High-Speed 5G Connectivity for First International AI Olympiad in Bulgaria

Bulgarian operator Vivacom will be sponsoring the first International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence (IOAI), to be held in Burgas from August 9 to 15. With fast and reliable Internet connectivity being a key requirement for the competition, the operator will be providing unlimited Internet at maximum speeds via its 5G network. Nearly 200 students from nearly 40 countries will leverage the network to create, use and advance artificial intelligence technologies.

Vivacom will also financially support the competition with an amount of BGN 10,000. Top perfoming students will receive great prizes from the operator, including the latest Nothing Ear 1 wireless headphones.

The International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence will consist of two rounds. In the science round, teams will develop new AI models and solve problems that mimic real scientific research. In the practical round, they will work with existing AI technologies such as ChatGPT, Dalle-2, etc. During the event, participants will also engage in debates on the future of artificial intelligence and the ethical implications, as well as hands-on workshops led by leading researchers and academics.

I am glad that Bulgaria is the founder and host of the first Artificial Intelligence Olympiad. AI is at the heart of a number of technological innovations and will play a key role in their development in the future. Olympiad participants are the next scientists and technological experts who will continue to develop the capabilities of artificial intelligence. Our partnership with the International Olympiad in Artificial Intelligence is the next logical step, part of our overall strategy to support the smart and talented youth of Bulgaria. As part of it, Vivacom traditionally supports the Bulgarian Olympians in natural sciences, and so far the company has donated nearly BGN 140,000 for their preparation and participation in international Olympiads.

Artificial intelligence has already entered many areas of our lives, it's time to pay attention to it in education as well. The importance of knowing the limits of its possibilities, using it ethically and for selfless purposes of the society is the next step in which to work with schoolchildren and students. We are extremely grateful to Vivacom, which stood up and with enthusiasm and understanding supported this idea, showing once again that investments in the youth of a country are investments in its better future.

evidence.title: Cyta workshop focuses on future of digital networks and cybersecurity
evidence.text:
Cyta workshop focuses on future of digital networks and cybersecurity

Cyta and Connect Europe held a workshop on the proposed European Digital Networks Act and revised cybersecurity rules, with Cyprus’ telecommunications infrastructure and the future security of digital networks among the issues discussed.

The workshop, organised by Cyta in cooperation with Connect Europe, focused on the proposed Digital Networks Act (DNA) and the revision of the Cybersecurity Act, known as Cybersecurity Act 2 (CSA2) .

Cyta CEO George Metzakis and Connect Europe Director General Alessandro Gropelli welcomed participants, while Commissioner of Communications Marios Pieris and Director of Digital Policy and Communications Kyriaki Pantziarou delivered opening remarks.

The event brought together representatives from competent public authorities , telecommunications providers, the business community, European institutions and Connect Europe.

Cyta said the proposed legislation could have implications for the pace and direction of investment across the sector.

“Discussions focused on the creation of a modern and harmonised European framework that will encourage investment in fibre-optic networks, 5G and future 6G networks, while accelerating the development of innovative digital services, with particular emphasis on the spectrum provisions of the Digital Networks Act,” the company stated.

Network security was another major area addressed during the workshop, particularly in relation to infrastructure supporting essential services.

The Cypriot telecommunications provider also said that measures would need to reflect the level of risk involved while avoiding unnecessary burdens.

The consumer impact was also considered, with the company linking investment in infrastructure to improvements in everyday digital services.

“Particular emphasis was placed on the benefits for consumers , ensuring that investment, technological advancement and enhanced security translate into better service quality, greater reliability, higher speeds and access to a wider range of advanced digital capabilities,” Cyta stated.

The discussion has particular significance for Cyprus given the extent of the country’s existing telecommunications coverage.

“For Cyprus, these discussions are particularly important, as the country has already developed advanced telecommunications infrastructure, with very high-capacity network and FTTP coverage reaching 95.5 per cent and 5G coverage at 100 per cent,” Cyta stated.

The company added that Cyprus’ position meant that the regulatory environment would play an important role in determining how the country’s networks developed from here.

“At this level of development, a modern and stable European framework is essential to support continued investment in next-generation networks and to strengthen the security and resilience of critical infrastructure,” Cyta stated.

FTTP, or fibre-to-the-premises, refers to fibre-optic connections extending directly to homes or business premises.

Cyta also referred to a recent joint initiative involving 17 major European telecommunications organisations, including the Cypriot operator.

The organisations have called for rules that they believe would allow the European telecommunications sector to support the continent’s wider digital ambitions .

“In their joint statement, they emphasise the need for a regulatory framework that will enable Europe to remain competitive in areas such as artificial intelligence, cloud services and next-generation networks, while ensuring a high level of security and resilience,” Cyta stated.

Cyta further mentioned that its own investment programme was part of the wider effort to improve connectivity and strengthen the country’s digital infrastructure.

“Cyta plays a key role in this effort through its long-standing investment in national and international telecommunications infrastructure, contributing to stronger connectivity and greater digital resilience for the country,” the company stated.

evidence.text:
Η Cyta, σε συνεργασία με τη Connect Europe, διοργάνωσε εργαστήριο για την πρόταση του νέου ευρωπαϊκού Κανονισμού για τα Ψηφιακά Δίκτυα (Digital Networks Act – DNA) και την αναθεώρηση του Κανονισμού για την Κυβερνοασφάλεια (Cybersecurity Act 2 – CSA2).

Τους συμμετέχοντες καλωσόρισαν ο Ανώτατος Εκτελεστικός Διευθυντής της Cyta, κ. Γιώργος Μετζάκης και ο Γενικός Διευθυντής της Connect Europe, κ. Alessandro Gropelli. Χαιρετισμούς απηύθυναν, επίσης, ο Επίτροπος Επικοινωνιών, κ. Μάριος Πιερή και η Διευθύντρια Ψηφιακής Πολιτικής και Επικοινωνιών, κ. Κυριακή Πάντζιαρου.

Στο εργαστήριο συμμετείχαν εκπρόσωποι αρμόδιων δημόσιων αρχών, τηλεπικοινωνιακών παρόχων, της επιχειρηματικής κοινότητας, ευρωπαϊκών θεσμών και της Connect Europe.

Στο επίκεντρο της συζήτησης βρέθηκε η δημιουργία ενός σύγχρονου και εναρμονισμένου ευρωπαϊκού πλαισίου που θα ενθαρρύνει τις επενδύσεις σε δίκτυα οπτικών ινών, 5G και μελλοντικά δίκτυα 6G, επιταχύνοντας παράλληλα την ανάπτυξη καινοτόμων ψηφιακών υπηρεσιών με έμφαση στις διατάξεις του Κανονισμού για τα Ψηφιακά Δίκτυα που αφορούν το ραδιοφάσμα.

Παράλληλα, συζητήθηκε η ανάγκη ενίσχυσης της ασφάλειας και της ανθεκτικότητας των δικτύων, με αποτελεσματικά μέτρα, που θα στηρίζουν την ομαλή λειτουργία των κρίσιμων υπηρεσιών.

Ιδιαίτερη έμφαση δόθηκε στα οφέλη για τους καταναλωτές, ώστε οι επενδύσεις, η τεχνολογική εξέλιξη και η ενίσχυση της ασφάλειας να οδηγούν σε καλύτερη ποιότητα υπηρεσιών, μεγαλύτερη αξιοπιστία, υψηλότερες ταχύτητες και περισσότερες σύγχρονες ψηφιακές δυνατότητες.

Η σημασία των θεμάτων που εξετάστηκαν στο εργαστήριο αποτυπώνεται και στην πρόσφατη κοινή παρέμβαση δεκαεπτά κορυφαίων ευρωπαϊκών τηλεπικοινωνιακών οργανισμών, μεταξύ των οποίων και η Cyta. Σε κοινή τους δήλωση, τονίζεται η ανάγκη διαμόρφωσης ενός ρυθμιστικού πλαισίου που θα επιτρέπει στην Ευρώπη να παραμείνει ανταγωνιστική σε τομείς όπως η τεχνητή νοημοσύνη, οι υπηρεσίες cloud και τα δίκτυα επόμενης γενιάς, διασφαλίζοντας παράλληλα υψηλό επίπεδο ασφάλειας και ανθεκτικότητας.

Για την Κύπρο, οι συζητήσεις αυτές έχουν ιδιαίτερη σημασία, καθώς η χώρα έχει ήδη αναπτύξει προηγμένες τηλεπικοινωνιακές υποδομές, με κάλυψη δικτύων πολύ υψηλής χωρητικότητας που φτάνει το 98% και κάλυψη 5G στο 100%.

Η Cyta διαδραματίζει καθοριστικό ρόλο σε αυτή την προσπάθεια, μέσα από τις διαχρονικές επενδύσεις της σε εθνικές και διεθνείς τηλεπικοινωνιακές υποδομές, συμβάλλοντας στην ενίσχυση της συνδεσιμότητας και της ψηφιακής ανθεκτικότητας της χώρας.

Μπορείτε να βρείτε τα δελτία τύπου της Cyta στο σύνδεσμο: www.cyta.com.cy/pr/pressreleases

evidence.title: Cyta, Connect Europe workshop frames future of digital networks, cybersecurity
evidence.text:
Cyta, Connect Europe workshop frames future of digital networks, cybersecurity

Cyta, in cooperation with Connect Europe, organised a workshop on the proposal for the new European Digital Networks Act (DNA) and the revision of the Cybersecurity Act (Cybersecurity Act 2 – CSA2).

Participants were welcomed by Cyta CEO George Metzákis, and the Director General of Connect Europe, Alessandro Gropelli. Opening remarks were also delivered by the Commissioner of Communications, Marios Pieris and the Director of Digital Policy and Communications, Kyriaki Pantziarou.

The workshop brought together representatives of the competent public authorities, telecommunications providers, the business community, European institutions and Connect Europe.

Discussions focused on the creation of a modern and harmonised European framework that will encourage investment in fibre-optic networks, 5G and future 6G netwroks, while accelerating the development of innovative digital services with a focus on the spectrum provisions of the Digital Networks Act.

The need to strengthen the security and resilience of networks was also discussed, through effective measures proportionate to the risks, supporting the uninterrupted operation of critical services.

Particular emphasis was placed on the benefits for consumers, ensuring that investment, technological advancement and enhanced security translate into better service quality, greater reliability, higher speeds and access to a wider range of advanced digital capabilities.

Ensuring security, resilience of Cyprus telecom infrastructure

For Cyprus, these discussions are particularly important, as the country has already developed advanced telecommunications infrastructure, with very high capacity network and FTTP coverage reaching 95.5 per cent and 5G coverage at 100 per cent. At this level of development, a modern and stable European framework is essential to support continued investment in next-generation networks and to strengthen the security and resilience of critical infrastructure.

The importance of issues examined during the workshop is also reflected in a recent joint initiative by 17 leading European telecommunications organisations, including Cyta. In their joint statement, they emphasise the need for a regulatory framework that will enable Europe to remain competitive in areas such as artificial intelligence, cloud services and next-generation networks, while ensuring a high level of security and resilience.

Cyta plays a key role in this effort through its long-standing investment in national and international telecommunications infrastructure, contributing to stronger connectivity and greater digital resilience for the country.

evidence.title: Cyta and Connect Europe discuss EU digital networks and cybersecurity proposals
evidence.text:
Cyta and Connect Europe discuss EU digital networks and cybersecurity proposals

Cyta and Connect Europe held a workshop in Nicosia on proposed EU rules for digital networks and cybersecurity.

Nicosia, Cyprus. Cyta and Connect Europe held a workshop on the proposed European Digital Networks Act and revised cybersecurity rules, examining implications for Cyprus’ telecommunications infrastructure and digital network security.

The event focused on the proposed Digital Networks Act and the revision of the Cybersecurity Act, known as Cybersecurity Act 2.

Cyta chief executive George Metzakis and Connect Europe director general Alessandro Gropelli welcomed participants. Commissioner of Communications Marios Pieris and Director of Digital Policy and Communications Kyriaki Pantziarou delivered opening remarks.

The workshop brought together representatives of competent public authorities, telecommunications providers, the business community, European institutions and Connect Europe.

Cyta said the proposed legislation could affect the pace and direction of investment across the telecommunications sector.

Discussions addressed the creation of a modern and harmonised European framework intended to encourage investment in fibre-optic networks, 5G and future 6G networks.

The framework would also aim to accelerate the development of innovative digital services, with particular attention given to the spectrum provisions of the Digital Networks Act, Cyta said.

Network security was another main topic, particularly regarding infrastructure supporting essential services.

Cyta said measures would need to reflect the level of risk involved while avoiding unnecessary burdens.

The company also linked infrastructure investment to improvements in everyday digital services, including better service quality, greater reliability, higher speeds and access to a wider range of advanced digital capabilities.

evidence.title: Cyta board outlines transformation and investment programme for 2024-2026
evidence.text:
Cyta board outlines transformation and investment programme for 2024-2026

Nicosia, Cyprus. Cyta’s board of directors on Thursday presented its report for the February 2024 to July 2026 term, outlining strategic reforms and investments in digital transformation, telecommunications infrastructure and technology services.

The board said its work focused on strengthening Cyta’s position as a connectivity provider while preparing the organisation for a broader role in Cyprus’ digital development.

It said investments in digital transformation, telecommunications infrastructure and technology services had created stronger foundations for customer services, additional opportunities for the economy and support for Cyprus’ wider digital progress.

The report highlighted an expansion of the institutional and legislative framework governing Cyta’s operations. The addition of the technology and energy sectors to Cyta’s remit was described as creating new growth opportunities, strengthening competitiveness and broadening the organisation’s contribution to customers and the country.

The board also approved Cyta’s Corporate Strategy 2025-2027 and established a portfolio of 21 strategic projects intended to support coordinated implementation, monitoring and oversight.

The report highlighted the launch of what Cyta described as the largest business transformation project in its history, involving the modernisation of its information technology systems.

Cyta said implementation had begun and that the programme aims to upgrade systems and business processes, simplify customer service, increase automation, speed up the development of new services and improve the customer experience.

The board reported that fibre optic network deployment accelerated during its term, while mobile network capabilities continued to expand and international telecommunications links were strengthened.

According to the report, the investments are expected to provide faster, more reliable and higher-quality services, improve business capabilities and support Cyprus’ position as a regional digital connectivity hub.

evidence.title: Cyta reports major investments and digital overhaul
evidence.text:
Cyta reports major investments and digital overhaul

Board points to stronger finances and digital progress

The Cyta board of directors on Thursday presented its report covering its February 2024 to July 2026 term, describing the period as one marked by major transformation, strategic reforms and significant investments aimed at strengthening the organisation’s role in Cyprus’ digital future.

The board reported that its work focused on reinforcing Cyta’s position as a reliable connectivity provider while preparing the organisation to play a broader role in the country’s digital development.

It said that investments in digital transformation, telecommunications infrastructure and technology services laid stronger foundations for improved customer services, created additional opportunities for the economy and supported Cyprus’ wider digital progress.

One of the most significant developments during the board’s tenure was the expansion of the institutional and legislative framework governing Cyta’s operations.

The board reported that the addition of the technology and energy sectors to Cyta’s remit opens new opportunities for growth, strengthens the organisation’s competitiveness and enables it to broaden both its contribution to customers and its role within the country.

In terms of long-term planning, the board approved Cyta’s Corporate Strategy 2025 to 2027 , alongside the creation of a portfolio of 21 strategic projects designed to ensure coordinated implementation, systematic monitoring and clear oversight of progress.

The report also highlighted the launch of what it described as the largest business transformation project in Cyta’s history , involving the modernisation of the organisation’s information technology systems.

The company said implementation has already begun and that the programme is intended to upgrade systems and business processes, simplify customer service, increase automation, accelerate the development of new services and improve the overall customer experience.

On telecommunications infrastructure, the board reported that the rollout of fibre optic networks accelerated during its term, while the capabilities of the mobile network continued to expand and Cyta’s international telecommunications links were strengthened.

According to the report, these investments are expected to deliver faster, more reliable and higher-quality services, enhance business capabilities and reinforce Cyprus’ position as a regional digital connectivity hub .

The board also pointed to Cyta’s expansion in the data centre sector through strategic acquisitions.

It said this strengthens the organisation’s ability to provide critical digital infrastructure for the state, businesses and the wider economy through services including data hosting, cloud computing, disaster recovery and high-availability solutions .

The report further stated that Cyta strengthened its role as a trusted technology partner for both the public and private sectors through the delivery of integrated ICT projects.

It added that artificial intelligence became more systematically embedded in the organisation’s strategic planning, contributing to improved services, more efficient internal processes and the development of new capabilities.

The board also highlighted Cyta’s involvement in major public sector projects, including the upgrade of Air Navigation Services and the relocation of the Area Control Centre to Kokkinotrimithia .

According to the report, these projects demonstrated Cyta’s technical expertise and reinforced its position as a strategic partner of the state.

Internally, the board reported that the organisation completed the selection process for a new senior executive management team.

It also established new ICT and Digital Evolution directorates , introduced a new recruitment and promotion system and renewed a significant proportion of the management structure.

The report stated that efforts to strengthen corporate governance focused on greater transparency and accountability.

It added that Cyta continued projects aimed at improving its environmental and social impact, completing its Holistic ESG Management project while taking important steps to reduce emissions.

The board reported that Cyta’s true positive impact was measured during 2025 and said the organisation continued initiatives designed to promote digital inclusion across Cyprus.

Financially, Cyta reported maintaining a strong performance throughout the board’s term.

Revenue increased from €405.5 million in 2023 to €444.2 million in 2025 , while EBITDA reached €150.6 million , according to the report.

The company said this financial performance enabled it to continue investing heavily in critical infrastructure and service improvements without resorting to bank borrowing.

During 2024 and 2025 , Cyta invested almost €189 million , with the company reporting that the entire amount was financed from its own resources.

Reflecting on its tenure, the board concluded that it leaves behind “a Cyta that is better prepared, stronger and more outward-looking,” the board said.

“An organisation that continues to strengthen its core role in telecommunications while developing the digital infrastructure and technology services Cyprus will need in the years ahead,” the board added.

evidence.title: Молдова: Moldtelecom завърши проект за оптимизация на мрежата на 4G и 5G несамостоятелна C-лентова ...
evidence.text:
Молдова: Moldtelecom завърши проект за оптимизация на мрежата на 4G и 5G несамостоятелна C-лентова инфраструктура

Moldtelecom и Kenmei завършиха проект за оптимизация, обхващащ 4G мрежата на оператора и нововъведения 5G несамостоятелен C-band слой.

Молдова, 8 септември 2026 г. — Moldtelecom и Kenmei Technologies приключиха втория си съвместен проект за оптимизиране на мрежата, обхващащ многолентовата LTE производителност и обединяването на носителите, балансирането на мобилността и натоварването, взаимодействието между 4G и 5G слоевете, първоначалната настройка на глас през LTE и идентифицирането на недостатъчно ефективни клетки, заедно с първоначална оптимизация на 5G несамостоятелната C-лентова мрежа на оператора.

Работата се основаваше на анализ на собствените мрежови данни на Moldtelecom, като препоръките бяха прегледани от инженерния екип на оператора преди внедряването и измерени след това. Процентът на успеваемост при предаване между обектите и между честотите се стабилизира на 99,9%, а най-слабата коригирана клетка се подобрява от 14% до 91% успеваемост при предаване. Анализът на пропускателната способност в права посока показа, че наличният капацитет надхвърля това, което потребяват настоящите тарифи, като предоставя количествена информация за търговската стратегия на оператора. Проектът също така подобри качеството на радиото, забавянето на пакетите, достъпността и несамостоятелната производителност на 5G, като същевременно остави на оператора базова линия за измерване за по-нататъшно внедряване на 5G.

evidence.title: Moldtelecom deschide un nou magazin-concept în centrul Chișinăului, unde tehnologia poate fi testată pe loc
evidence.text:
Moldtelecom deschide un nou magazin-concept în centrul Chișinăului, unde tehnologia poate fi testată pe loc

Moldtelecom deschide un nou magazin pe bd. Ștefan cel Mare și Sfânt 12, un spațiu modern, creat nu doar pentru alegerea serviciilor și produselor, ci pentru ca vizitatorii să poată testa direct tehnologiile și performanța rețelelor Moldtelecom.

Noul magazin aduce un concept de experiență, în care serviciile pot fi descoperite și testate înainte de conectare. Spațiul este organizat în cinci zone interactive: 5G MAX, Internet și TV Acasă, MCamera, Gadget-uri și Gaming.

Cea mai extinsă rețea 5G și posibilitatea de a o testa gratuit

În ultimii ani, Moldtelecom a realizat investiții majore în dezvoltarea infrastructurii de telefonie mobilă. Astăzi, compania dispune de cea mai extinsă rețea 5G din Republica Moldova și oferă abonamente 5G MAX, inclusiv opțiuni cu internet mobil nelimitat.

Pentru ca utilizatorii să se poată convinge singuri de calitatea și performanța rețelei, Moldtelecom oferă posibilitatea de a o testa gratuit. Prin oferta eSIM, utilizatorul își poate activa online un număr digital Moldtelecom și beneficia de 10 GB de internet mobil gratuit, valabili timp de 7 zile, suficient pentru a testa rețeaua în activitățile de zi cu zi.

În noul magazin, vizitatorii pot testa pe loc viteza și experiența oferite de 5G MAX, de la streaming și social media până la aplicații care necesită conexiuni rapide și stabile.

Investiții în fibră și o capacitate demonstrată de aproximativ 42 Gbps

Investițiile Moldtelecom au vizat în egală măsură infrastructura de internet fix. Compania deține cea mai extinsă rețea de fibră optică din Republica Moldova, cu peste 430.000 de clienți conectați la serviciile sale.

În 2026, Moldtelecom a testat în premieră infrastructura 50G-PON, demonstrând o capacitate reală de transfer de aproximativ 42 Gbps. Este un nou nivel de performanță pentru infrastructura de comunicații din Republica Moldova și un pas important către rețelele capabile să susțină volume tot mai mari de trafic, servicii cloud, inteligență artificială, IoT și aplicațiile digitale ale viitorului.

Iar tehnologia nu rămâne doar în laboratoare. În noul magazin Moldtelecom de pe bd. Ștefan cel Mare și Sfânt 12, vizitatorii pot testa internetul la viteze de până la 8 Gbps și pot vedea concret ce înseamnă o conexiune de nouă generație.

„Ne-am dorit ca acest magazin să fie mai mult decât un punct de vânzare. Este un loc în care oamenii pot veni și testa tehnologia înainte să o aleagă. Am investit foarte mult în rețelele noastre mobile și fixe, iar acum vrem ca fiecare client să poată vedea și simți diferența. Nu vrem doar să vorbim despre viteză și calitate. Vrem să le demonstrăm”, declară Rodica Hurmuzache, Director Marketing Moldtelecom.

Cinci zone în care tehnologia poate fi experimentată

Noul magazin este organizat în cinci zone interactive:

Zona 5G MAX, unde poate fi testată performanța rețelei mobile Moldtelecom.

Zona Internet și TV Acasă, unde vizitatorii pot experimenta internetul de mare viteză, Wi-Fi și serviciile de televiziune.

Zona MCamera, dedicată soluțiilor de supraveghere video și controlului direct de pe smartphone. Zona Gadget-uri, unde pot fi testate smartphone-uri și alte dispozitive conectate. Zona Gaming, unde viteza și stabilitatea conexiunii pot fi experimentate într-unul dintre scenariile cu cele mai mari cerințe de performanță.

La evenimentul de inaugurare participă parteneri de business, parteneri de comunicare și reprezentanți ai companiei, alături de Emilian Crețu și Satoshi, protagoniști ai campaniilor recente Moldtelecom.

Deschiderea vine și cu un beneficiu exclusiv pentru clienți.

Până pe 17 octombrie 2026, clienții care se conectează la Internet și TV în magazinul Moldtelecom de pe bd. Ștefan cel Mare și Sfânt 12 beneficiază de 3 luni gratuite de servicii, suplimentar promoției comerciale aflate în vigoare.

Astfel, noul magazin devine nu doar un punct de conectare, ci un spațiu în care oamenii pot descoperi, compara și testa tehnologia înainte de a lua o decizie.

Prin investițiile în 5G MAX, fibră optică și tehnologii de nouă generație, Moldtelecom continuă dezvoltarea infrastructurii digitale a Republicii Moldova și aduce această tehnologie mai aproape de oameni.

evidence.title: Moldtelecom, din nou în căutarea unui director general. APP a relansat concursul
evidence.text:
Moldtelecom, din nou în căutarea unui director general. APP a relansat concursul

Concursul pentru funcția de director general al S.A. „Moldtelecom” a fost relansat, după ce procedura anterioară s-a încheiat fără desemnarea unui câștigător, scrie BANI.MD . Dosarele de participare pot fi depuse până miercuri, 30 septembrie 2026, ora 16:00, anunță Agenția Proprietății Publice (APP).

Noul concurs se desfășoară în baza unui regulament aprobat de Consiliul S.A. „Moldtelecom” la 7 septembrie 2026, care prevede un proces competitiv, transparent, nediscriminatoriu și bazat pe merit, cu păstrarea confidențialității identității candidaților pe durata selecției.

Pentru această procedură, Comisia de selectare a decis să atragă un expert independent specializat în recrutare și executive search. Acesta va sprijini identificarea și evaluarea candidaților, inclusiv prin căutarea directă pe piața națională și internațională. Expertul nu va avea însă drept de decizie, alegerea finală urmând să aparțină Consiliului S.A. „Moldtelecom”.

Regulamentul prevede formarea unei liste scurte de 3-4 candidați calificați, iar Comisia de selectare va păstra competența de a verifica eligibilitatea, de a confirma lista scurtă, de a stabili finaliștii și clasamentul final și de a formula recomandarea către Consiliul Societății.

Astfel, pentru funcția de director poate candida o persoană cu studii superioare și cel puțin șapte ani de experiență în funcții manageriale, care cunoaște fluent limba română și cel puțin o limbă de circulație internațională la nivel B1. Sunt prevăzute și condiții privind integritatea, antecedentele penale, incompatibilitățile și conflictele de interese.

Selecția va avea trei etape: verificarea eligibilității și formarea listei scurte, interviul de evaluare a competențelor și, ulterior, Business Case-ul și interviul final. Candidații vor fi evaluați, între altele, în funcție de capacitatea strategică, orientarea financiară și comercială, leadership, cunoștințele în domeniul tehnologiei și digitalizării, comunicare, precum și înțelegerea guvernanței corporative, a riscurilor și auditului.

Dosarele pot fi depuse fizic, în plic sigilat, la sediul S.A. „Moldtelecom” de pe bulevardul Ștefan cel Mare și Sfânt, 10, sau în format electronic, la adresa indicată în anunțul concursului.

Amintim că, anterior, concursul pentru ocuparea funcției de director general al S.A. „Moldtelecom” s-a încheiat anticipat, după ce ambii candidați admiși în etapa de selecție au decis să se retragă din competiție. Deocamdată, APP nu a comunicat motivele care i-au determinat pe cei doi candidați să renunțe la cursa pentru conducerea uneia dintre cele mai importante companii de telecomunicații controlate de stat.

În concurs fuseseră admiși Viorel Motorniuc și Andrei Preașcă.

evidence.title: Punct și de la capăt. Fotoliul de director al Moldtelecom, scos, din nou, la concurs: Care este termenul de depunere a dosarelor
evidence.text:
Moldtelecom a lansat un nou concurs pentru funcția de director general. Dosarele candidaților pot fi depuse până la 30 septembrie, iar procesul de selecție va fi sprijinit de un expert independent din România.

Potrivit Agenției Proprietății Publice, selecția se va desfășura în baza unui Regulament actualizat, care pune accent pe criteriile de competență și transparență.

Pentru prima dată în cadrul acestui proces, Comisia de selectare va fi asistată de AMROP România, printr-un expert independent specializat în executive search. Acesta va sprijini identificarea și evaluarea candidaților, inclusiv pe piața internațională.

Dosarele pot fi depuse electronic, la adresa [email protected] , sau fizic, în plic sigilat, la sediul S.A. „Moldtelecom” de pe bd. Ștefan cel Mare, 10, Chișinău.

Cerințele pentru candidați și lista documentelor necesare sunt prevăzute în Regulamentul aferent concursului.

Concursul precedent pentru ocuparea funcției de director general al S.A. „Moldtelecom” s-a încheiat anticipat, după ce ambii candidați admiși în procesul de selecție și-au retras candidaturile.

La 1 iulie, Guvernul a dispus suspendarea unui alt concurs pentru selectarea directorului companiei Moldtelecom, până la clarificarea tuturor aspectelor apărute în spațiul public. Anunțul a fost făcut de fostul premierul Alexandru Munteanu, care a precizat că măsura este luată în contextul verificărilor privind activitatea unor întreprinderi de stat.

Ulterior, A genția Proprietății Publice a confirmat că, concursul pentru șefia Moldtelecom a fost suspendat, la solicitarea fostului premier Alexandru Munteanu . „Reprezintă o măsură cu caracter procedural și nu constituie o concluzie cu privire la legalitatea sau corectitudinea etapelor desfășurate până în prezent. Candidaților înregistrați au fost informați, iar concursul va rămâne în vigoare până la clarificarea tuturor circumstanțelor relevante”, precizează APP.

Potrivit legislației, suntem obligați să cenzurăm comentariile ce incită la ură , reprezintă atac la persoană sau conțin cuvinte necenzurate .

evidence.title: Moldtelecom relansează concursul pentru funcția de director general, după ce procedura precedentă a eșuat
evidence.text:
S.A. Moldtelecom caută din nou un director general, la mai puțin de două săptămâni după ce concursul precedent s-a încheiat fără rezultat. De această dată, selecția se va desfășura după un regulament actualizat, iar o companie specializată în recrutarea managerilor va participa la identificarea și evaluarea candidaților.

Dosarele pot fi depuse până pe 30 septembrie, ora 16:00, anunță Agenția Proprietății Publice (APP).

Pentru noul concurs a fost atrasă compania AMROP România, reprezentată de The Searchers Advisory Group SRL. Aceasta va avea rol de expert independent și va căuta potențiali candidați atât în Republica Moldova, cât și peste hotare. Decizia finală va aparține Consiliului Moldtelecom. Potrivit APP, noul regulament pune accent pe o selecție competitivă și bazată pe merit. Identitatea candidaților va rămâne confidențială pe durata procedurii.

Dosarele pot fi transmise electronic sau depuse fizic la sediul companiei din Chișinău. Cerințele pentru candidați și lista actelor necesare sunt publicate pe site-ul APP împreună cu regulamentul concursului.

Amintim că precedentul concurs pentru șefia Moldtelecom s-a încheiat anticipat pe 4 septembrie, după ce ambii candidați rămași în cursă și-au retras dosarele. Era vorba despre directorul general interimar Viorel Motorniuc și fostul director B2B al Orange Moldova Andrei Preașcă.

Procedura respectivă fusese lansată pe 2 iunie. La începutul lunii iulie, concursul a fost suspendat după apariția unor suspiciuni în spațiul public în contextul scandalului de la MoldATSA. Ulterior, selecția nu a mai fost reluată în formula inițială.

Moldtelecom este condusă interimar de Viorel Motorniuc din decembrie 2023 , după plecarea fostului director general Alexandru Ciubuc.

evidence.title: VIDEO Summer Fest 2026 a adunat peste 23.000 de vizitatori, alături de Orange Moldova în calitate de Partener Oficial
evidence.text:
VIDEO Summer Fest 2026 a adunat peste 23.000 de vizitatori, alături de Orange Moldova în calitate de Partener Oficial

Pe 22 și 23 august, Summer Fest 2026 a adunat peste 23.000 de vizitatori la Grădina Botanică din Chișinău. Și în acest an, Orange Moldova a fost Partener Oficial al festivalului, continuând colaborarea începută în 2019.

Dintre cei peste 23.000 de participanți, mai mult de 14.000 au fost utilizatori Orange, ceea ce arată cât de bine se întâlnesc publicul Summer Fest și comunitatea Orange într-unul dintre cele mai mari evenimente muzicale ale verii.

Pentru Orange Moldova, parteneriatul cu Summer Fest se înscrie într-o direcție mai amplă de susținere a muzicii și culturii. Compania sprijină proiecte și evenimente care oferă publicului acces la muzică, de la festivaluri contemporane până la proiecte dedicate muzicii clasice și scenei lirice.

La ediția din acest an, publicul a descoperit Zona Orange x Samsung, realizată împreună cu Samsung. Ideea zonei a pornit de la conexiunile dintre oameni și s-a regăsit în activitățile pregătite pentru festival. Una dintre provocări a pus la încercare cât de bine se cunosc două persoane venite împreună la festival. „Sticker Match” a continuat ideea într-un mod diferit: participanții primeau o parte dintr-un mesaj și trebuiau să găsească persoana care avea continuarea potrivită.

În orele călduroase, Cooling Zone a oferit un loc de răcorire între concerte, iar Samsung a adus în aceeași zonă noua generație de dispozitive pliabile Galaxy. Participanții au putut descoperi și testa Galaxy Fold8 Ultra, Galaxy Fold8 și Galaxy Flip8 direct la festival.

Tot în Zona Orange x Samsung s-a desfășurat un concurs cu un Samsung Galaxy Fold8 drept premiu. Participanții au fost invitați să testeze dispozitivul și să publice experiența pe Instagram, cu menționarea paginilor Samsung Moldova și Orange Moldova. Câștigătorul a fost desemnat prin tragere la sorți și anunțat pe 25 august pe pagina de Instagram Samsung Moldova.

Pentru clienții Orange, veștile plăcute despre Summer Fest au început încă înainte de eveniment. Aceștia au primit prin SMS un promo code care le-a oferit 5% reducere la bilete, disponibil pentru o perioadă limitată.

Parteneriatul dintre Orange Moldova și Summer Fest continuă din 2019, iar ediția din acest an a adus din nou împreună un public numeros și o comunitate Orange bine reprezentată în cele două zile de festival. Cu peste 23.000 de vizitatori, dintre care mai mult de 14.000 de utilizatori Orange, Summer Fest rămâne unul dintre proiectele prin care Orange Moldova continuă să susțină muzica și evenimentele culturale relevante pentru public.

evidence.title: Summer Fest 2026 собрал более 23 000 посетителей, а Orange Moldova выступила официальным партнёром фестиваля (P.)
evidence.text:
Summer Fest 2026 собрал более 23 000 посетителей, а Orange Moldova выступила официальным партнёром фестиваля (P.)

22 и 23 августа Summer Fest 2026 собрал в Кишинёвском ботаническом саду более 23 000 посетителей. Orange Moldova и в этом году выступила официальным партнёром фестиваля, продолжив сотрудничество, начавшееся в 2019 году.

Из более чем 23 000 участников свыше 14 000 были пользователями Orange. Это ещё раз показывает, насколько заметно сообщество Orange среди аудитории одного из крупнейших музыкальных событий лета.

Для Orange Moldova партнёрство с Summer Fest является частью более широкой работы по поддержке музыки и культуры. Компания поддерживает проекты и события, которые дают широкой аудитории возможность быть ближе к музыке – от современных фестивалей до инициатив, посвящённых классической музыке и оперной сцене.

На фестивале этого года гости могли посетить зону Orange x Samsung, созданную совместно с Samsung. Её идея была связана с общением и связями между людьми и получила продолжение в активностях, подготовленных специально для Summer Fest.

Одна из них предлагала двум участникам проверить, насколько хорошо они знают друг друга. В рамках Sticker Match каждый получал часть сообщения и должен был найти человека, у которого была его подходящая вторая часть.

В жаркие часы Cooling Zone стала местом, где можно было освежиться между концертами. В этой же зоне Samsung представил новое поколение складных устройств Galaxy. Участники фестиваля могли познакомиться с Galaxy Fold8 Ultra, Galaxy Fold8 и Galaxy Flip8 и протестировать их прямо на месте.

В зоне Orange x Samsung также прошёл конкурс, главным призом которого стал Samsung Galaxy Fold8. Для участия посетителям предлагалось протестировать устройство и поделиться своим впечатлением в Instagram, отметив страницы Samsung Moldova и Orange Moldova. Победитель был определён случайным образом и объявлен 25 августа на странице Samsung Moldova в Instagram.

Для клиентов Orange приятные новости о Summer Fest начались ещё до самого события. Они получили по SMS промокод, который давал скидку 5% на билеты в течение ограниченного периода.

Партнёрство Orange Moldova и Summer Fest продолжается с 2019 года. В этом году фестиваль вновь собрал большую аудиторию, среди которой были хорошо представлены и пользователи Orange. Более 23 000 посетителей, из которых свыше 14 000 — пользователи Orange, ещё раз подчёркивают значимость Summer Fest как одного из проектов, через которые Orange Moldova продолжает поддерживать музыку и культурные события, интересные широкой аудитории.

(P.) Этот материал является коммерческой рекламой

O vizită la stomatolog, care trebuia să fie una obișnuită, a schimbat pentru totdeauna viața unui băiat de 8 ani. Au urmat 15 ani de suferință, paralizie și luptă pentru viață, pe care, în cele din urmă, a pierdut-o. Ce s-a întâmplat în cabinetul stomatologic? Unde au fost greșelile și cine trebuia să răspundă? De ce a fost nevoie de un verdict al CEDO pentru ca acest caz să primească un răspuns? La AMPRENTE, sâmbătă, ora 20:00, căutăm răspunsuri, responsabilitate și soluții. Amprente Un caz cutremurător readuce în atenție problema violenței în familie și a protecției victimelor. Au existat semnale de alarmă. Au existat instituții care trebuiau să intervină. Unde s-a rupt însă lanțul protecției? Ce nu a funcționat? Cine trebuia să prevină tragedia? Și, mai ales, ce trebuie schimbat pentru ca o asemenea dramă să nu se repete? La AMPRENTE, căutăm răspunsuri, responsabilitate și soluții. Amprente Doi copii au fost loviți violent pe o trecere de pietoni, la Strășeni. Unul dintre ei și-a pierdut viața. Celălalt a supraviețuit, dar luptă în continuare cu urmările cumplite ale accidentului. Cine poartă responsabilitatea pentru această tragedie? Unde au fost autoritățile și ce au făcut pentru a preveni astfel de tragedii? Și, mai ales, ce trebuie schimbat pentru ca viețile oamenilor să nu mai fie puse în pericol? Răspunsurile le aflați în prima ediție a emisiunii „Amprente”. Amprente O nouă emisiune la TV8 despre destine și evenimente care lasă urme. Aducem în prim-plan mărturii care ridică întrebări importante. Insistăm pe răspunsuri și soluții reale. evidence.title: Cellnex stock gains on BlackRock stake increase
evidence.text:
Cellnex Telecom stock (ISIN ES0105066007) is drawing investor attention after BlackRock increased its stake in the Spanish towers group to 6.398%, corresponding to 42.49 million shares valued at about EUR 1.094 billion as of September 19, 2026, according to Bolsamania .

According to Bolsamania on September 19, 2026, BlackRock has raised its participation in Cellnex from 5.001% to 6.398%. This represents an increase of about 1.397 percentage points in the asset manager's share of the company compared with its previous reported level in Spain.

The same report states that BlackRock now controls 42.49 million Cellnex shares, with the stake valued at around EUR 1.094 billion based on recent market prices, making it the largest position the asset manager has held in the Spanish infrastructure company since May 2017. Bolsamania For investors, the size and timing of this move underline that a major institutional holder is prepared to commit additional capital to the stock.

Operational scale and recent fundamentals

Cellnex has become one of Europe’s leading independent tower operators, owning and operating more than 100,000 wireless towers across markets such as Spain, France, Italy, the United Kingdom and Poland, as a result of sustained acquisition activity since its initial public offering in 2015, according to Multiples VC .

A separate comparative overview values Cellnex at about USD 19 billion enterprise value, with approximately USD 4.7 billion of annual revenue and around USD 3.4 billion of EBITDA, implying an EV to EBITDA multiple of 9.3 times on those figures, as presented by Multiples VC . While these values are presented in a comparative context rather than a specific reporting period, they illustrate the scale at which Cellnex now operates compared with peers in the telecom infrastructure space.

The combination of a large, diversified tower portfolio and long term contracts with mobile network operators helps support relatively predictable cash flows. That, in turn, is a key reason why long term investors such as BlackRock may be prepared to increase exposure, even as the broader European telecoms sector has faced volatility, with telecommunication stocks recently posting notable single day declines in regional indices, as reported by The Business Times .

On the Spanish market, Cellnex stock is listed on Bolsas y Mercados Espanoles (BME) in euros. As of recent trading in mid September 2026, the company’s market capitalization is described as being close to EUR 1.094 billion for BlackRock's 6.398% stake alone, implying an overall equity value several times higher, based on the proportion that stake represents, according to Bolsamania . For retail investors, the BlackRock transaction offers a concrete data point about institutional confidence in the stock.

From a strategic perspective, the towers model remains capital intensive but backed by multi year inflation linked contracts in many jurisdictions. The valuation metrics cited by Multiples VC suggest that the market continues to price Cellnex as a growth infrastructure name rather than a mature utility, with an EV to EBITDA ratio in the high single digit range compared with lower multiples often seen in traditional telecom operators.

Cellnex stock and current market context

While the precise intraday price, prior close, 52 week range and trading volume for Cellnex stock on BME on September 19, 2026 are not detailed in the available sources, the valuation of BlackRock's stake at EUR 1.094 billion indicates that the shares continue to trade at levels where institutional investors see long term value, as reflected in the percentage increase of BlackRock’s holding from 5.001% to 6.398% cited by Bolsamania .

For investors, the key takeaway on September 19, 2026 is that Cellnex stock remains underpinned by a combination of large scale infrastructure assets, recurring contractual revenue and visible interest from major asset managers. Against a backdrop of sector volatility, the latest stake increase provides a fresh signal that at least one global institution is prepared to commit more capital to the name, even as valuation metrics remain firmly tied to the company’s ability to sustain revenue and EBITDA growth over the medium term.

evidence.title: Cellnex Telecom Slides To Loss In Q3
evidence.text:

evidence.title: Cellnex Telecom Reports Strong Financial Performance for Nine Months of 2023
evidence.text:
Cellnex Telecom Reports Strong Financial Performance for Nine Months of 2023

Cellnex Telecom has announced its financial results for the first nine months of 2023, showcasing robust growth and strategic initiatives. Financial Highlights:

Cellnex Telecom’s revenue for the first nine months of 2023 increased by 16 percent, reaching EUR 2,248 million. Including pass-throughs, the growth was 17 percent.

Cellnex Telecom said Adjusted EBITDA witnessed a significant uptick to EUR 2,248 million, reflecting both organic growth and the consolidation of the telecom tower company’s geographic footprint.

Cellnex Telecom said free cash flow surged to EUR 436 million compared to a negative EUR 774 million in the same period last year, driven by the sale of sites in France as per the French Competition Authority’s remedies.

Cellnex strategically concluded the sale of 2,353 sites in France to Phoenix Tower International and a joint venture with Bouygues Telecom, generating EUR 631 million. An additional EUR 360 million is expected after the transfer of the remaining sites in 2024.

A 49 percent stake in Cellnex Sweden and Cellnex Denmark was sold to Stonepeak for EUR 730 million, contributing to debt reduction.

The company announced an agreement with Boldyn Networks to sell its private networks business unit, including Edzcom, with the transaction set to conclude in the first quarter of 2024.

The Group’s net debt, excluding lease liabilities, stands at EUR 17.6 billion, with 75 percent of the debt at a fixed rate.

A convertible bond issue for EUR 1 billion in July extended debt maturities and increased conversion price, contributing to a stable financial structure.

Infrastructure Services for mobile Telecommunications operators (TIS business) contributed 91.1 percent of revenue, with a year-on-year increase of 17.6 percent.

Broadcasting infrastructures activity contributed 5.7 percent of revenue, while the business focused on security and emergency service networks and solutions contributed 3.2 percent.

As of September 30, Cellnex had a total of 111,688 operational sites, with organic growth and expansion across various countries.

Cellnex confirms its outlook for the end of 2023, aiming for revenue between EUR 4 and 4.1 billion, EBITDA of EUR 2,950 – 3,050 million, and free and recurring cash flow between EUR 1,525 – 1,625 million.

Cellnex CEO, Marco Patuano, commented, “This period has been marked by excellent commercial performance and consistent operational execution. We are making good progress on reducing debt and achieving our financial targets, thanks to a strategic focus on core business and asset disposals.”
