evidence.title: Palfinger breaks ground on €70m Slovenia plant
evidence.text:
Palfinger breaks ground on €70m Slovenia plant

The company marked the start of the project with an official groundbreaking ceremony on 9 September 2026, attended by members of Palfinger’s supervisory and executive boards alongside representatives of the Slovenian government and the local community, who planted trees at the site to mark the occasion. The facility is scheduled to become operational in 2028.

Palfinger’s presence in Slovenia dates back to 1993, when the company opened its first manufacturing facility outside Austria in Maribor. The new Ormož site builds on that history.

“Sustainable growth requires continuous and smart investments in a high-performing global production and logistics network,” says Alexander Susanek, chief operating officer of Palfinger. “The new site in Ormož marks an important step in further developing our manufacturing footprint, improving operational efficiency, and creating additional value for our customers. Over the past three decades, we have built a strong foundation in Slovenia through our site in Maribor. With Ormož, we are expanding our presence in the region while strengthening our entire global network.”

Danijel Vrbnjak, mayor of the Municipality of Ormož, described the investment as “yet another extremely important milestone for the municipality. This investment represents [an] important building block in the municipality’s development. The project is in line with the municipality’s long-term development vision, which has already succeeded in attracting several high-profile investments in recent years. For this reason, the municipality itself helped prepare the necessary infrastructure. They will continue to invest in this area going forward, with the aim of strengthening existing partnerships and establishing new ones, to ensure further development of the municipality.”

Representatives of the Slovenian government, including Katja Koren, state secretary at the Ministry of the Economy, Labour and Sport, and Zdravko Počivalšek, state secretary in the cabinet of the prime minister, said the investment signalled trust in Slovenia and that it represented a driving force for the development of a strongly export-oriented country. They also praised the Municipality of Ormož and its mayor for their work, and said the government was committed to creating the conditions for Slovenia’s competitiveness and to supporting further phases of the investment.

The new facility is being built in the Glinokop industrial zone in Ormož, on a site covering more than 18.5 hectares. Construction is already under way, with production scheduled to start in the first quarter of 2028.

Once completed, the site will comprise an assembly hall, a coating facility, a logistics hub designed to optimise supply chains, and a training centre dedicated to the development and qualification of apprentices, employees and service technicians. Ormož will expand Palfinger’s manufacturing capacity for components used across the company’s different product lines.

The Ormož investment forms part of Palfinger’s Strategy 2030+, under which the company says it continues to optimise its global production footprint with a focus on efficiency, customer proximity and targeted investment in future growth markets. Together with Maribor and Palfinger’s other European production sites in Lengau, Austria, and Niš, Serbia, Ormož will become part of the company’s European manufacturing network.

Palfinger says the investment is a key pillar of that strategy, creating the foundation for future growth while increasing the resilience and competitiveness of its global operations.

Palfinger designs crane and lifting solutions and employs around 12,000 people across 30 international manufacturing sites, supported by a global distribution and service network. The company has been listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange since 1999 and reported revenue of €2.34 billion in 2025.

evidence.title: Rosenbauer Aktie: Erste Südamerika-Niederlassung eröffnet
evidence.text:
Mit einem strategischen Schritt auf die südliche Hemisphäre treibt Rosenbauer seine internationale Präsenz voran. Am 14. September eröffnete der Feuerwehrtechnikkonzern in Santiago de Chile seine erste eigene Niederlassung in Südamerika. Der Hersteller will mit der neuen Vertretung im chilenischen Markt die Betreuung lokaler Kunden verstärken und das Geschäft in der gesamten Region gezielt ausbauen.

Kräftiger Ergebnissprung im ersten Halbjahr

Die geografische Ausweitung folgt auf ein operativ verbessertes erstes Halbjahr 2026. In den ersten sechs Monaten steigerte das Unternehmen seinen Konzernumsatz um 3,5 Prozent gegenüber dem Vorjahreszeitraum auf 625,9 Millionen Euro. Deutlicher fiel die Erholung auf der Ertragsseite aus: Das operative Ergebnis (EBIT) hat sich mit 20,4 Millionen Euro gegenüber dem Vorjahr nahezu verdreifacht.

Gleichzeitig bleibt die Nachfrage nach den Spezialfahrzeugen und Ausrüstungen auf hohem Niveau. Der Auftragsbestand belief sich zur Jahresmitte auf 2.434,4 Millionen Euro, was dem Unternehmen eine umfangreiche Produktionsauslastung für die kommenden Quartale sichert.

Langfristige Finanzierung und neue Gremienstruktur

Zur Absicherung der geschäftlichen Aktivitäten vereinbarte Rosenbauer mit einem Bankenkonsortium einen syndizierten Kredit über 339 Millionen Euro. Damit stockte der Konzern die Kreditlinie gegenüber den 330 Millionen Euro aus dem Dezember 2025 leicht auf.

Zugleich wurde die Fristigkeit verlängert: Die Laufzeit läuft bis August 2029, nachdem die vorherige Vereinbarung bis März 2028 reichte. Der Vertrag enthält darüber hinaus eine Verlängerungsoption um zwei plus ein weiteres Jahr.

Auch auf personeller Ebene stellte sich das Unternehmen neu auf. Bereits auf der Hauptversammlung am 20. Mai wurden Martina Scheibelauer und Cornelia Zeinler neu in das Kontrollgremium gewählt. Den Vorsitz des Aufsichtsrats übernahm Gernot Hofer.

Die geschäftliche Entwicklung schlägt sich auch im Kursverlauf nieder. Am Dienstag ging die Aktie bei 63,40 Euro aus dem Handel. Auf Jahressicht behauptet der Titel ein deutliches Plus: Seit Jahresanfang steht ein Zuwachs von 39 Prozent zu Buche. Vom 52-Wochen-Hoch bei 68,20 Euro trennt das Papier damit nur eine moderate Konsolidierungsspanne.

evidence.title: Rosenbauer Konzern fährt IT nach Cyber-Attacke schrittweise wieder hoch
evidence.text:
Seit Wochenbeginn, 6. März 2023, fährt der Rosenbauer Konzern seine IT-Infrastruktur wieder schrittweise hoch. Diese wurde als Vorsichtsmaßnahme infolge einer Cyber-Attacke zwischen 21. und 23. Februar 2023 vorübergehend abgeschaltet.

Eine Task Force aus externen und internen Fachleuten hat in den vergangenen Tagen sämtliche Unternehmensbereiche durchforstet und den Hergang sowie das Schadensausmaß des Angriffes analysiert. An der Behebung der einzelnen Probleme wird mit Hochdruck unter strengsten Sicherheitsvorkehrungen gearbeitet, nächste Woche sollen wieder sämtliche IT-Systeme verfügbar sein.

„Obwohl es noch etwas dauern wird, bis wir wirklich zu einem störungsfreien Normalbetrieb zurückkehren, so haben wir doch diese Woche einige wichtige Meilensteine für die sichere Wiederherstellung unserer IT-Systeme passiert. Ich bedanke mich bei den Kolleginnen und Kollegen unseres IT-Bereiches, die hier in vielen Überstunden Außergewöhnliches geleistet haben, und bei allen Mitarbeitenden für ihre Geduld unter diesen schwierigen Arbeitsbedingungen“, sagt Sebastian Wolf, CEO der Rosenbauer International AG.

evidence.title: Rosenbauer eröffnet Niederlassung in Chile
evidence.text:
Rosenbauer verstärkt seine Aktivitäten in Lateinamerika und betreibt nach Mitteilung vom 14. September 2026 ab sofort die erste eigene Niederlassung am südamerikanischen Kontinent. Am neuen Standort in Pudahuel/Santiago bündelt das Unternehmen Vertrieb, Werkstatt, Ersatzteillager, Showroom und Experience Center zu einem vollumfassenden Leistungsangebot.

Zugleich dient die Niederlassung mit elf Mitarbeitenden als zentraler Servicehub für den lateinamerikanischen Markt. Mit einer Investition von 3,5 Mio. US-Dollar (rund 3 Mio. €) unterstreicht Rosenbauer sein langfristiges Engagement in der Region und schafft die Infrastruktur für eine noch engere Betreuung seiner Kunden vor Ort.

„Chile ist für Rosenbauer ein bedeutender Markt mit langfristigem Potenzial. Mehr als 300 Rosenbauer-Fahrzeuge sind hier bereits im Einsatz. Wir sehen attraktive Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, sowohl bei Fahrzeugen und Ausrüstung als auch im Servicegeschäft. Mit unserer eigenen Niederlassung stärken wir unsere Marktpräsenz vor Ort und können noch gezielter auf lokale Anforderungen und Entwicklungen im lateinamerikanischen Markt eingehen“, sagt Andreas Zeller, Vertriebsvorstand der Rosenbauer International AG.

„Mit dem neuen Standort können wir unsere Kunden künftig noch schneller und umfassender betreuen. Dank eigener Werkstatt, lokalem Ersatzteillager und qualifizierten Serviceteams verkürzen sich die Reaktionszeiten deutlich und die Verfügbarkeit von Fahrzeugen und Ausrüstung wird nachhaltig sichergestellt“, so Eduardo Viveros, Geschäftsführer von Rosenbauer Chile.

Die feierliche Eröffnung fand am 12. September 2026 im Beisein von rund 700 Gästen und zahlreichen Ehrengästen statt – darunter der österreichische Botschafter in Chile, Vertreter des chilenischen Feuerwehrverbands, Feuerwehrkommandanten aus dem ganzen Land, der Bürgermeister von Pudahuel sowie Vertreter der Wirtschaftskammer Österreich.

Mit der eigenen Niederlassung in Pudahuel ist Rosenbauer das erste Unternehmen in Chile, das einen professionellen Service speziell für Feuerwehrfahrzeuge und -ausrüstung vor Ort anbietet. Der Fokus liegt zunächst auf Rosenbauer-Fahrzeugen, schrittweise soll das Angebot auf Fahrzeuge anderer Hersteller ausgeweitet werden. Auf rund 500 m² befinden sich moderne Büroflächen, das Rosenbauer Trainingszentrum sowie ein Showroom. Insgesamt erstreckt sich der neue Standort über rund 2.000 m².

Neben der stationären Werkstatt verfügt Rosenbauer Chile über mobile Serviceeinheiten, ergänzt wird das Angebot durch Flying Engineers, die mit europäischen und nordamerikanischen Fahrzeug- und Technikstandards vertraut sind. Ein eigenes Ersatzteillager ermöglicht die rasche Versorgung der Feuerwehren im ganzen Land und soll künftig auch weitere lateinamerikanische Märkte bedienen. Für Produktpräsentationen stehen ein Showroom und ein Experience Center zur Verfügung.

Chile zählt aufgrund seiner politischen Stabilität, seiner starken europäischen Orientierung und seines hohen Qualitätsbewusstseins seit Jahren zu den bedeutenden Märkten von Rosenbauer in Lateinamerika. Eine Besonderheit des chilenischen Feuerwehrwesens ist, dass es nahezu vollständig auf freiwilligem Engagement basiert. Damit weist das System, eine tragende Rolle auf, wo freiwillige Feuerwehren und der Gemeinschaftsgedanke einen hohen Stellenwert besitzt.

Rosenbauer inaugura sede en Pudahuel con taller especializado y entrega cuatro carros de Bomberos

La compañía austriaca abrió en la comuna un nuevo centro de postventa y un taller especializado para la mantención de vehículos de emergencia. La ceremonia contó con la presencia del embajador de Austria en Chile, Werner Senfter, y del alcalde de Pudahuel, Ítalo Bravo.

Pudahuel, Santiago de Chile. 13 de septiembre de 2026. La compañía austriaca Rosenbauer Chile inauguró este sábado 12 de septiembre sus nuevas instalaciones en Pudahuel, recinto que contará con un centro de postventa y un taller especializado para la mantención de vehículos de emergencia.

La ceremonia incluyó el tradicional corte de cinta , actividad en la que participaron representantes de la empresa, autoridades y representantes de Bomberos de Chile.

Entre los asistentes estuvieron el embajador de Austria en Chile, Werner Senfter , y el alcalde de Pudahuel, Ítalo Bravo , además del gerente general de Rosenbauer Chile, Eduardo Viveros , y el presidente nacional de Bomberos de Chile, Juan Carlos Field .

Cuatro carros para Bomberos de La Araucanía

Durante la jornada, Rosenbauer realizó también la entrega oficial de cuatro carros multipropósito destinados a los Cuerpos de Bomberos de Lautaro, Gorbea, Cunco y Angol , en la Región de La Araucanía.

Los vehículos serán incorporados a las respectivas unidades bomberiles de esas comunas.

La actividad contempló además un acuerdo de colaboración entre Rosenbauer y la Municipalidad de Pudahuel , en el marco del programa «Cooperar para Crecer» .

Como parte de esta iniciativa, la empresa pondrá a disposición su sala de capacitaciones para actividades organizadas por la Sección Económico Laboral de la Municipalidad de Pudahuel .

El acuerdo incorpora así las nuevas instalaciones de la empresa a actividades de capacitación que se desarrollen en coordinación con el municipio.

evidence.title: Q3 review: operational turnaround in full swing: Rosenbauer's Q3 results show strong revenue growth ...
evidence.text:
Q3 review: operational turnaround in full swing: Rosenbauer's Q3 results show strong revenue growth ...

On Friday, Rosenbauer presented strong Q3 results. Here are the key takeaways:

Q3 revenue of € 346m, up 12.8% yoy , exceeded expectations of € 338m (eNuW), carried by all major product segments. Vehicle revenues rose by 15.7% yoy to € 270.8m, Fire & Safety by 16.6% yoy to € 28.4m and Customer service by 7.7% yoy to € 33m. Regionally, Americas improved by 30.5% yoy to € 105m, while Europe slightly declined by 2.7% yoy, denoting € 157m in revenue. Strong contributions from typically more volatile developing regions Middle East (+16.4% yoy, € 39.8m) and Asia-Pacific (+78.9% yoy, € 43.3m) aided in turning this Q3 from a typically seasonally weaker quarter into a strong one.

Q3 EBITDA came in at € 35.3m, soaring by 51.6% yoy . At the same time Q3 EBIT of € 26m was up 73.5% yoy despite a continued headwind from the Preventive Fire Protection segment, which remains in restructuring with a € 6.2m EBIT loss. Key drivers for the strong growth were efficiency gains thanks to improved supply chains, no further headwinds from tariffs in the US (Q3 margin of 8.9% vs -2.5% in H1) and an improving mix effect (i.e. stronger growth of higher margin regions APAC and MEA).

The order backlog at the end of Q3 reached a new all-time high of € 2.4bn, up 10.5 % yoy, providing strong visibility well into 2026, even as order intake came in 6.3% below last year's figure at € 458m. The temporary softness was visible across all segments, except for Asia-Pacific.

Adjustments on the FY 25 guidance became necessary, as visibility increased towards the end of the year. Rosenbauer delivered early on turning the operating cash flow positive (positive territories were already reached in Q3). Yet, roughly € 50m of sales were pushed into Q1 2026 to help smooth out seasonality and ease extra costs from running above capacity in the final quarter. FY25 revenue is now expected at €1.45bn, with the deferred € 50m coming in at slightly better margins . Assuming no further one-offs, the EBIT margin of 5.5% for FY 2025 was confirmed.

The working capital improved from € 512m in Q3 2024 to € 472m, due to efficiency measures taken. Net debt denoted at € 305m (Q3 2024: € 467.8m) and the equity ratio improved from 14% a year ago to 24.4% in Q3 2025 (thanks to the resolved capital increase), as the company continues to solidify its financial position .

Our take : With a record order backlog, management focusing on efficient deliveries and supply chains stabilizing, we expect further positive top-line developments. Margin improvements are to follow with further efficiency measures introduced (€ 10m additional savings from FY26e). As debt covenants are more easily met, managements freedom in decision making continues to improve. With PFP restructuring efforts under way, we expect its negative impact on EBIT margins to decrease in 2026. In sum, the company is well on track to further cement the ongoing operational turnaround . BUY with a € 54 PT, based on DCF.

Rosenbauer verzeichnete im Q3 ein Umsatzwachstum von 12,8% auf 346 Mio. Euro, getrieben von allen Produktsegmenten und starken Beiträgen aus Amerika und Asien-Pazifik. Das EBITDA stieg um 51,6% auf 35,3 Mio. Euro, der EBIT um 73,5% auf 26 Mio. Euro. Der Auftragseingang erreichte mit 2,4 Mrd. Euro ein Rekordniveau. Für das Gesamtjahr 2025 erwartet Rosenbauer einen Umsatz von 1,45 Mrd. Euro und bestätigt die EBIT-Marge von 5,5%. Die Nettoverschuldung sank auf 305 Mio. Euro, die Eigenkapitalquote verbesserte sich.

Rosenbauer America to Showcase Wildland Technology at 2025 Canadian Wildfire Conference

Wyoming, MN – Rosenbauer America, a leading manufacturer of fire apparatus, announced its participation at the 2025 Canadian Wildfire Conference in Kelowna, British Columbia, from Oct. 1-2. Rosenbauer will be showcasing its commitment to wildland firefighting with a display of specialized apparatus and essential equipment designed to meet the unique challenges of the wildland and forestry firefighting market.

Attendees are invited to visit Rosenbauer’s exhibit to explore the latest advancements in wildland firefighting technology and see firsthand how our products are engineered to provide maximum performance, safety, and efficiency. Our team of experts will be on hand to discuss the features of our apparatus and equipment and to demonstrate how Rosenbauer is helping to combat the growing threat of wildfires.

Featured at the conference will be two of Rosenbauer’s premier wildland apparatus: the Timber WARRIOR and the Maverick.

The Timber WARRIOR is a wildland-urban interface (WUI) powerhouse, combining the structural firefighting capabilities of a Type 1 pumper with the off-road agility of a wildland unit. It is a true all-in-one solution for departments that face a variety of fire threats.

The Maverick is a versatile, multi-purpose apparatus that excels in initial attack and water transport operations. Built for maneuverability and performance, the Maverick is a perfect solution for departments serving both rural and urban areas.

In addition to our apparatus, Rosenbauer will be featuring essential loose equipment that is critical for wildland firefighters:

Rosenbauer is also a proud sponsor of the Canadian Wildfire Conference evening reception on Oct. 1st at the Four Points Sheraton Hotel from 5-8 p.m., providing an opportunity for attendees and exhibitors to network and continue conversations in a relaxed setting.

Rosenbauer America is part of the Rosenbauer Group, which operates in more than 100 countries and is a trusted partner to fire services worldwide. evidence.title: Before you buy LEGO October 2026 sets: prices, pros and cons and verdicts
evidence.text:
Before you buy LEGO October 2026 sets: prices, pros and cons and verdicts

Everything you need to know about next month's new sets

There’s a lot to sink your teeth into this October, so here’s everything you need to know about next month’s brand new LEGO sets before you buy.

From the latest supersized LEGO Star Wars set to the annual Winter Village instalment, there’s plenty to check out at the LEGO Store (and LEGO .com) next week – but which sets are most deserving of your budget? That’s what we’re aiming to find out here, with input from across the community, pros and cons on each release and more.

Dive in below for a complete guide to what’s coming up from the LEGO Group this October.

Theme: Ideas Price: £89.99 / $99.99 / €99.99 Pieces: 1,038 Release: Oct 1, 2026

The LEGO Group and Aardman are finally joining forces for a Wallace & Gromit set in the form of 21371 Wallace & Gromit. The new LEGO Ideas model will release early next month for £89.99 / $99.99 / €99.99, depicting the duo as buildable figures.

21371 Wallace & Gromit follows many proposals for a model based on the franchise, and they’ve taken a wide variety of forms. While minifigures have been pitched countless times, Wallace and Gromit work best as buildable figures, as this set effortlessly demonstrates. – Jack

“The build looks deceptively simple, but the techniques are complex. Even if you aren’t a Wallace & Gromit fan, the techniques are worth checking out for the fresh ideas they bring. Not only does the set look fantastic from every angle, the arms, hands and head allow for a customisable display.”

Our verdict: LEGO and Wallace & Gromit are a match made in heaven, and the only thing to really wonder about with 21371 Wallace & Gromit is why it took so long. An easy day-one purchase with very little to criticise.

Theme: Icons Price: £119.99 / $149.99 / €129.99 Pieces: 1,690 Release: Oct 1, 2026

LEGO Icons has finally tackled the most obvious subject matter in its Book Nook subtheme, courtesy of the 1,690-piece 11379 Bookshop: Book Nook . As with previous such novel-based builds, the set can be displayed open or closed and features a packed interior that’s filled with crammed shelves, a winding staircase, a small café and plenty of literature-related Easter eggs waiting to be discovered.

The only real downside to the model is the limited selection of minifigures, which (although perfectly-suited to the set) could have been bolstered with the addition of more characters to really pack out the scene. Still, the latest LEGO Icons set is likely to find a cosy spot on many a dusty old bookshelf and deservedly so. – Matt

“Most bookcases are dark places, so you might want one of those aftermarket lighting kits or even some fairy lights you can sprinkle through if you want to showcase the interior. That said, I think this is going to be a very popular gift this Christmas. It's well suited to casual builders and it has a very wide appeal. It's not a particularly complicated set technique-wise, but it is a very dense one and it'll take most people a whole day to finish.”

Our verdict: The third entry in the LEGO Icons subtheme delivers the perfect choice for such a build, making 11379 Bookshop: Book Nook easily the most satisfying of those display models to date.

Theme: Icons Price: £99.99 / $119.99 / €109.99 Pieces: 1,354 Release: Oct 1, 2026

The Winter Village returns to its roots in a way with 11387 Holiday House , a residential home accompanied by a Christmas tree and sleigh that’s built on bringing ‘Jingle Bells’ to life. But rather than the sense of nostalgia it’s perhaps trying to induce, the biggest feeling it conjures up is one of mediocrity. There are some fun things going on with the side builds and external architecture, but it all just feels a bit bland.

If you enjoy poking around inside your Winter Village sets, that’s where 11387 Holiday House suffers most, with an especially shallow and spartan interior compared to previous houses in this subtheme. Winter Village completists will already be locked into a day one purchase, but if you’re more selective with these sets you might want to consider what else is out there. – Chris

“It doesn’t feel like bad value relative to its predecessors, but unless you’re a Winter Village completist you might not feel compelled to add 11387 Holiday House to your display. And if you’re limited on space? There are better options out there previously and will surely be better in years to come.”

Our verdict: The usually-reliable Winter Village Collection falters a bit here. It’s not a bad set by any means, but 11387 Holiday House might not get you in the festive spirit in the same way as previous entries.

Theme: Marvel Prices: £54.99 / $59.99 / €59.99 to £99.99 / $109.99 / €109.99 Pieces: 433 to 954 Release: Oct 4, 2026

The first Avengers movie in over seven years hits theatres this December, and the LEGO Group is celebrating with a range of three minifigure-filled playsets that finally give us some of the Marvel characters we’ve been desperate to see in LEGO form. Those are 76347 Avengers: Doomsday Quinjet , 76348 Epic Battle: Avengers: Doomsday , and 76352 Avengers: Doomsday New Avengers Tower .

While the builds vary in size and detail, the main reason we’re here is the fantastic selection of new and interesting minifigures, from the X-Men to the New Avengers, alongside some powered-up Fantastic Four characters. However, just because the minifigures are the main selling point, that doesn’t mean the builds themselves should be overlooked. The only catch is that the prices may be a little higher than you’d want. – Dylan

“I think [ 76348 Epic Battle: Avengers: Doomsday ] is an amazing set and definitely one of those rare sets where the build outshines the minifigures. Even though I do think that the minifigures are slept on in this set, the Sentinel build itself is just so amazing. I definitely plan on buying multiple to pose them all around my X-Mansion.”

Verdict: It’s great to see so many characters make their LEGO debut, and the range of builds is excellent. While the sets may be slightly overpriced, that shouldn’t put you off a day-one purchase if you’re particularly excited about the new minifigures.

Theme: Ideas Price: £269.99 / $349.99 / €299.99 Pieces: 4,711 Release: Oct 1, 2026

LEGO Ideas’ 81st set lands next month in the shape of 21373 Downton Abbey , a sprawling 4,711-piece recreation of Highclere House, the Grade I listed location from the fan-favourite period drama. The model presents a dollhouse-style build based on Sebastian Veselka's original submission, complete with intricately-crafted Gothic-revival style exterior and a detailed interior that boasts familiar and often-visited rooms from the TV show and movies.

21373 Downton Abbey manages to impress in a number of surprising ways, from its clever use of certain building techniques and a reasonable price tag for a licensed LEGO set to the fact that it essentially doubles up as an Architecture build and includes a 13-strong minifigure line-up. Oh, and there’s even potential for the model to double as a version of Wayne Manor too. – Matt

“In short, if you have fond memories of evenings spent watching the series, this set can be a way to relive the atmosphere and keep a memento on your shelves. If you need a base for a Malfoy or Batman mansion, this set will likely provide a starting point for improvisation, provided you can find it [on sale], which should be possible in a few months.”

Our verdict: With 21373 Downton Abbey , LEGO Ideas has crafted a classy love letter to the award-winning drama, one that perfectly reflects the grand architecture of its source material.

Theme: Pokémon Price: £229.99 / $299.99 / €259.99 Pieces: 2,386 Release: Oct 1, 2026

Since the start of LEGO Pokémon earlier this year, fans have been demanding minifigures and minifigure-scale Pokémon. 72154 Iconic Trainer Moments Poké Ball is one of two sets building on that concept, and it’s ultimately going to be the more tempting of the duo.

Get past the price tag, and this is the LEGO Pokémon set you’ve been waiting for. The minifigures are worthwhile, the build is sturdy, and everything works as it should. It’s hard not to love the tiny Eevee and Pikachu, too. – Jack

“On the whole, this is a really cool display piece that is well-made and fun to build – a real page turner! It’s hard to ignore the price: it’s high, but it’s a very complex construction with many large Technic and System elements.”

Our verdict: This is the LEGO Pokémon set fans have been waiting for, thanks in no small part to the minifigures and exclusive elements. The LEGO Group is acutely aware of this and has priced the set accordingly – this is one set to look out for on sale.

Theme: Star Wars Price: £649.99 / $799.99 / €749.99 Pieces: 6,130 Release: Oct 1, 2026

This year’s flagship LEGO Star Wars set designed for fans with the deepest pockets is the second Ultimate Collector Series rendition of Darth Vader’s capital ship. 75457 Executor Super Star Destroyer is roughly twice the size of 2011’s 10221 Super Star Destroyer (by piece count) and twice the price, too. But does that make it twice the set?

Sort of, yeah. The proportions are much more accurate, there’s a proper underside this time round, and it’s got a bumper minifigure selection with the full roster of bounty hunters from that one scene in Empire Strikes Back (‘no disintegrations’). Buy it day one and you’ll also get 40897 Darth Vader’s Lightsaber alongside a relatively big hole in your bank account. – Chris

“Even if you're a little bit taken aback by the design – a lot of people said it's too flat or there's not enough dark grey – in my personal opinion, I think it's well-rounded. It looks really good. It's accurate. It's extremely sturdy. And when you pick it up, it's just crazy looking. It really is crazy that this thing is possible.”

Our verdict: One for LEGO Star Wars fans with unlimited budget and unlimited space first and foremost. There are better and more interesting UCS sets out there, but if you have them all…

Theme: Seasonal Prices: £24.99 / $29.99 / €29.99 to £54.99 / $59.99 / €59.99 Pieces: 187 to 904 Release: Oct 1, 2026

The LEGO Group’s annual Christmas set selection has once again expanded beyond advent calendars with all kinds of décor for your home. It’s anything but business as usual for the five new sets, though, which include 40875 Up-Scaled Mrs . Claus Minifigure, 40865 Buddy the Elf, 40958 Christmas Stocking , 40866 Santa's Holiday Sleigh Adventure and 40874 Santa's Holiday Countdown .

There’s something for everyone in the new LEGO Christmas 2026 set selection, and for all budgets too. 40865 Buddy the Elf’s execution won’t be for everyone, but there’s no doubt that brand recognition alone will guarantee its success this holiday season. – Jack

“I genuinely don’t know if it would have been better or worse to go the Ronaldo/Messi single plate face route for Buddy. I’m sure it couldn’t be worse than what they ended up with. Actually, I’m wondering what one of those face plates would look like on this model.”

Our verdict: It's great to see some real variety in the LEGO Christmas 2026 sets, including a rare licensed build. While Buddy isn’t exactly recognisable with that face, the LEGO Group isn’t afraid to try something new this Christmas.

Theme: PlayStation Price: £139.99 / $179.99 / €159.99 Pieces: 1,911 Release: Oct 1, 2026

The LEGO Group is broadening its brick-built console horizons beyond SEGA and Nintendo next month with 72306 PlayStation, a 1,911-piece recreation of Sony’s first home gaming system. It’s essentially a 1:1-scale model and really looks the part, with the functionality to match: the power and open disc tray buttons can be pressed as you’d expect, even if there’s no disc inside. (Insert Sony disc joke here…)

What you will find squirrelled away inside the console are tiny dioramas celebrating first-party PlayStation titles Gran

evidence.title: We Build LEGO Mayor Manor: A Spooky, Not-So-Scary Halloween Build
evidence.text:
We Build LEGO Mayor Manor: A Spooky, Not-So-Scary Halloween Build

Set #11383 employs a cool optical illusion to appear crooked.

The new LEGO Midnight Valley Collection theme is the rough equivalent of the LEGO Winter Village Collection , only instead of centering around Christmas, this theme is based on Halloween. Assuming it follows the same trajectory as its predecessor, we'll likely see one major addition to this whimsical, haunted village each Autumn.

The Mayor Manor, out now, is the theme's debut set ( see it at Amazon ). It's an engaging, enjoyable build, with a cool visual motif for LEGO to elaborate upon in the years to come.

The Mayor Manor is not a "closed" building ; it is open in the back like a classic dollhouse, allowing the builder to observe and stage the interior to his or her liking. It comes in nine bags – paper rather than plastic, thanks to LEGO's ongoing sustainability initiative . The switchover has been gradual, starting in 2020 and ramping up considerably in the last two years or so.

[A note about the paper bags: Make sure you shake and flatten them out completely before discarding them. Paper is not as slippery as plastic (nor as see-thru), and so if you're missing a piece, it might be stuck in the scraps. It happened to me twice during this build.]

The design is very '90s Tim-Burton-meets-Addams-Family. You have traditional spires mixed with stained glass windows, along with a foreboding gargoyle perched on the roof. The tree leaves are off-color blue and green, which creates the impression that you're viewing this house in the twilight rather than the bright light of day.

The house interior is well-appointed, featuring a fireplace which functionally connects to the house chimney on the exterior – a nice bit of logical, functional coherency. On the second floor, there's a grandfather clock with a golden pendulum and a face stuck at midnight. There's also a bookshelf, with the books inserted at various depths, which gives the space a bit of quirk and whimsy. If you enjoy putting together little builds, which you then insert, as furniture or other knick-knacks, into a larger build to create a whole? Then you'll really enjoy what's going on here.

The designers draw a clear line of distinction between the facade of the house, versus the house itself . The house has structural integrity; it's a two-story, traditionally built structure with defined rooms, level floors, and straight lines. But the facade of the house – the way it presents itself externally – is skewed, as if it's actively falling apart. LEGO accomplishes this by clipping crooked walls and roofs onto the underlying building. It's a convincing visual effect that'll make you do a double take.

Because half of the house appears destroyed and half appears relatively intact, we can imagine, in our mind's eye, how the house once appeared when it was whole. And it's especially cool to contrast that to the ruined state of the house, and see how this jagged split in the wall over here matches – like a high-concept jigsaw puzzle – to the broken wall over there.

Have you ever seen Ripley's Believe it or Not! museums in tourist areas? They're these self-billed "Odditoriums" that capitalize, P.T. Barnum style, on the off-beat and strange: "Come see a real shrunken head!" "Gaze upon an Iron Maiden torture device from medieval times!" "Young lady, have you ever laid eyes on a two-headed goat?"

I used to love these museums growing up, and I especially loved looking at their optical illusion facades from streetview, which made them appear as if they were sinking into the ground or experiencing the aftershocks of an earthquake. The closer I walked, the less convincing the illusion. But that also taught me something about myself – that knowing the 'trick' behind these illusions deepened my love for them rather than diminishing it.

I thought about this while putting together the Mayor Manor, particularly its East Wing. LEGO tells a story through its presentation; a stubborn intrusive tree has grown into the house's foundations, and over time, it's punctured through the walls and wrapped itself around half of the second floor. It implies that the house is very, very old, but also that the inhabitants of the house – the pale-faced matron with the fur-lined shawl, and the maid and butler who wait upon her – are either indifferent to what's happening or are unable to prevent it.

Are they ghosts or the undead? Were they once inhabitants of this house when they were alive? How long have they roamed these hallways in the years since? They don't look unhappy, strictly speaking.

This sort of imaginative "what-if?" roleplay is essential, I think, to your full enjoyment of adult-geared sets like these. Because unlike many other 18+ sets, this is not a painstaking replica or a pop culture artifact; this is a playset, with the dimensions and features of one. Children have the ability to construct elaborate play scenarios—a skill we often lose as we grow older. LEGO sets like these give adults tacit permission to indulge in those joys once more.

But even if you don't have the suspension of disbelief to throw yourself into fantasy entirely, there is still childish joy and escapism in imagining the inner lives of these minifigures, and in staging dramatic scenarios when putting them out for display.

LEGO Mayor Manor, Set #11383, retails for $119.99, and it is composed of 1420 pieces. It is available for purchase now at Amazon and the LEGO Store .

Kevin Wong is a contributing freelancer for IGN, specializing in LEGO. He's also been published in Complex, Engadget, Gamespot, Kotaku, and more. Follow him on Twitter at @kevinjameswong.

evidence.title: New Doctor Doom LEGO Minifigure Just Leaked, And It Might Be Our Best Look Yet at RDJ’s Villain Before ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
evidence.text:
Marvel’s marketing campaign for one of its most anticipated films in years has taken a strange but familiar shape this summer, with toy leaks doing far more heavy lifting than the actual trailers. ‘ Avengers: Doomsday ‘ has released four trailers so far, yet its central villain has barely appeared on screen, making every merchandise reveal feel like a genuine event for fans desperate for details.

That pattern continued this week when a closer look at an upcoming LEGO minifigure gave fans their most detailed glimpse yet at the character. The figure is tied to a rumored set catalogued as 76345 Doctor Doom Bust, reportedly containing 379 pieces and expected to launch sometime around September, putting its release just a few months ahead of the film’s theatrical debut in December.

New images shared online show the minifigure up close, highlighting its dark green hooded cloak, silver iron mask, and armored torso plating, details that closely track the comics accurate design language Marvel has leaned into across every piece of Doctor Doom merchandise released so far. The figure marks the character’s first new Doctor Doom minifigure in over a decade, giving longtime LEGO collectors a reason to pay just as much attention as the film’s core fanbase.

Here’s a closer look at the new Doctor Doom minifigure that will be in 76345 Doctor Doom Bust! pic.twitter.com/Cr4eoO8IX9

If the set follows the format of prior entries in LEGO’s Marvel bust line, such as the Iron Spider-Man and Iron Man MK4 busts, both of which also included 379 pieces, it will likely function primarily as a display piece rather than a traditional playset, complete with a stand and detailed sculpting built around Doom’s signature mask and hood. That exclusive minifigure appears set to be a key selling point of the bust itself, with earlier reporting suggesting a separate, unprinted variant of the figure without arm detailing will likely appear across other sets in the broader ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ wave.

The timing of Doom’s rollout across merchandise has been notably deliberate given how little the character has actually appeared in official studio materials. Despite the barrage of trailers released so far, Robert Downey Jr’s version of the villain has only been glimpsed briefly and obscured in shadow, most notably during the post credits scene of ‘The Fantastic Four, First Steps.’ That scarcity has turned every toy reveal, from Hasbro’s Titan Series figures to LEGO’s own minifigure leaks, into a de facto preview of the character ahead of anything Marvel Studios has officially confirmed.

Interestingly, earlier reporting on Doom’s LEGO minifigure noted small design nods to both Thor and Captain Marvel built into the brick sculpting, a detail that has fueled ongoing speculation among fans about what role those characters, or their conspicuous absence, might play in the film’s plot. Whether that same detail carries over into the larger bust set’s design remains unclear based on the newly surfaced images, but it has given fans another thread to pull on while dissecting every inch of Doom’s look for hidden clues.

This LEGO reveal also arrives alongside other rumored additions to the wave, including a separate 76352 Avengers Tower playset reportedly containing 954 pieces, which appears to be a smaller alternative rather than a replacement for the existing modular Avengers Tower set already in LEGO’s lineup. Together, the reported sets suggest LEGO is preparing a fairly substantial merchandise push to coincide with the film’s release window.

For a character defined by his obsession with control and perfection, it feels fitting that fans are piecing together his on screen design one leaked plastic piece at a time rather than through official confirmation. With ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ still months away, expect these kinds of leaks to keep filling the information gap Marvel has left wide open.

evidence.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Switch 2 Review – Gotham Goes Portable
evidence.text:
LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Switch 2 Review – Gotham Goes Portable

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was released earlier this year on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, offering a much more ambitious take on the LEGO Batman formula. It features a full open world and a story that brings together different parts of Batman’s history, drawing from older games, comics, retro series and other interpretations of the character. As a Batman fan, I found this particularly impressive, as the story feels like a throwback to the classic Batman comics while bringing many of those influences together in a single game. From a gameplay perspective, it also takes clear inspiration from the Batman: Arkham series, adapting that style of gameplay to the LEGO formula.

I originally played the game on PS5 , but this review focuses specifically on the Switch 2 version. There are some visual compromises compared with the PS5 release, but they are not severe enough to make the Switch 2 version feel like a heavily downgraded experience. The biggest difference is resolution. On PS5, the game offers a 4K 30 FPS mode as well as a performance mode that uses dynamic resolution while targeting 60 FPS. The Switch 2 version does not have a 60 FPS option, instead targeting 30 FPS at a dynamic 1080p resolution.

There are some other reductions to the visual quality as well. Texture quality is slightly lower in certain areas, particularly environmental textures, while character models remain fairly similar to the PS5 version. Reflections have also been reduced in quality, and the level of detail has been scaled back. This is most noticeable in Gotham City, where the number of NPCs and vehicles has been reduced. Alongside the lower resolution and 30 FPS target, these are the most noticeable differences between the two versions.

Despite these compromises, the overall presentation remains surprisingly close to the PS5 version when the two are viewed side by side. Performance is also generally stable, with the game managing to maintain its 30 FPS target for the most part. I did notice some minor stuttering and slowdowns when destroying large numbers of LEGO bricks at once, so it is not a perfectly locked 30 FPS experience, but these issues are relatively minor.

I also played the new Joker and Harley Quinn DLC on Switch 2, and I was quite impressed with how it was handled. Rather than simply adding the two characters to the main game, it features a separate story mode that can be played independently of the main campaign. It focuses on Joker and Harley Quinn’s meeting and their subsequent escape, while also giving them a limited open world to explore. It is not a particularly large expansion, but the separate story and the dynamic between Joker and Harley make it an enjoyable addition.

Overall, LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a good Switch 2 port. The lack of a 60 FPS mode is disappointing, particularly when the PS5 version offers one, but given the game’s scale and visual ambition, the compromises made for Switch 2 are reasonable. The core experience remains intact, and outside of the resolution, reduced detail and lower frame rate target, the game still looks remarkably close to the PS5 version. If you have not played LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight yet, the Switch 2 version is a solid way to experience it, especially if you are a fan of Batman or the LEGO series.

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Game Information

LEGO Batman Legacy of the Dark Knight remains a strong adaptation on Switch 2, preserving its ambitious open world and Batman inspired gameplay. Visual compromises and the 30 FPS target are noticeable, but stable performance make it a convincing portable version despite lacking a 60 FPS option.

evidence.title: Beko Romania (fostul Arctic Găești), cel mai mare producător de electrocasnice din România, a fuzionat cu fosta Whirlpool Romania
evidence.text:
Beko Romania (fostul Arctic Găești), cel mai mare producător de electrocasnice din România, a fuzionat cu fosta Whirlpool Romania

Fuziuniea produce deja efecte juridice, de la 1 iulie 2026.

Fostul Arctic a înregistrat în 2025 o cifră de afaceri de 4,09 miliarde de lei, în creștere cu 16,5% față de anul precedent.

Rezultatul net a trecut pe plus, profitul atingând 2,3 milioane de lei, de la o pierdere de 103,6 milioane de lei în 2024, conform datelor analizate de Profit.ro.

Profit.ro a anunțat, în primăvara anului 2024, că grupul turc Arçelik a finalizat înțelegerea cu gigantul american Whirlpool pentru combinarea afacerilor europene, inclusiv a fabricilor din România, și lansarea companiei Beko Europe. Mai multe detalii AICI .

În ianuarie 2023, Ardutch B.V, o subsidiară deținută în totalitate de Arçelik, și subsidiara Whirlpool din Europa, Orientul Mijlociu și Africa , Whirlpool EMEA Holdings, au semnat un acord definitiv de contribuție pentru crearea unei noi afaceri de sine stătătoare în sectorul european al aparatelor electrocasnice.

Beko Europe are peste 20.000 de angajați și o capacitate de producție de aproximativ 24 de milioane de electrocasnice pe an, în 11 unități de producție.

75% din noua companie este deținută de Beko B.V. și 25% de Whirlpool Corporation.

La nivel global, Arçelik va deține operațiuni pe 57 de piețe și va avea aproximativ 55.000 de angajați. Veniturile combinate ale Arçelik ajung la aproximativ 11 miliarde de euro, pe baza rezultatelor din 2023. Capacitatea anuală de producție a companiei va crește, de asemenea, în mod semnificativ, numărul total de unități de producție ajungând la 45.

Totodată, a fost finalizat și acordul definitiv prin care Arçelik dobândește proprietatea deplină a operațiunilor Whirlpool din Orientul Mijlociu și Africa de Nord (MENA), într-o tranzacție separată.

Cu peste 55.000 de angajați la nivel mondial, Arçelik are subsidiare în 57 de țări și 45 de fabrici în 13 țări (Turcia, Marea Britanie, Italia, România, Slovacia, Polonia, Africa de Sud, Rusia, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Thailanda și China). Arçelik are 22 de mărci proprii sau utilizate cu licență limitată (Arçelik, Beko, Whirlpool, Grundig, Hotpoint, Arctic, Ariston, Leisure, Indesit, Blomberg, Defy, Dawlance, Hitachi, Voltas Beko, Singer, ElektraBregenz, Flavel, Bauknecht, Privileg, Altus, Ignis, Polar).

Fondat în 1955, Arçelik este unul dintre principalii jucători din industria internațională de electronice și electrocasnice.

Compania deține 12 branduri (Arçelik, Beko, Grundig, Blomberg, ElektraBregenz, Arctic, Leisure, Flavel, Defy, Dawlance, Voltas, Altus) și este listată la Bursa de Valori din Istanbul.

Arcelik este controlat de Koç Holding, cel mai mare grup industrial și de servicii din Turcia.

evidence.title: Türkiye's Arcelik wins S&P global sustainability award for 6th consecutive year
evidence.text:
Türkiye's Arcelik wins S&P global sustainability award for 6th consecutive year

T urkish white goods manufacturer Arcelik once again earned the highest score in the durable consumer goods sector, receiving 89 out of 100 in the 2024 S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment, marking its sixth consecutive victory.

According to a company statement, as of Nov. 22, Arcelik secured the top spot among 45 companies in the durable household products sector with its exceptional score of 89 in the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment.

The S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment evaluates companies’ performance in environmental, social and governance (ESG) dimensions. Arcelik has also been listed in the Dow Jones Emerging Markets Index for the eighth consecutive time.

Arcelik CEO Hakan Bulgurlu emphasized their firm steps toward a more sustainable future, stating:

In a period dominated by global challenges, maintaining our commitment to sustainability and once again achieving the top position in the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment makes this success even more meaningful for us.

Arcelik continues to implement numerous global projects in sustainability, ranking high across various indices. By the end of 2023, compared to the 2015 baseline, the company reduced energy consumption per product by 25.7% in production processes. Through 373 energy efficiency projects implemented in 2023, Arcelik saved approximately 95,680 gigajoules of energy and prevented 6,983 tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emissions.

By the end of 2023, Arcelik achieved a 64% green electricity usage rate in production operations and aims to increase this to 100% by 2030. The company also plans to encourage its suppliers to transition to 100% green electricity usage, contributing to a net-zero future.

Ali Koç konferansta Koç Holding’in son 5 yılda 17 milyar dolarlık yatırım yaptığını belirterek bunun Türkiye’ye duyulan güvenin göstergesi olduğunu vurguladı.

Ali Koç, “ Her fırsatta muhataplarımıza Türkiye’ye uzun vadeli yatırımın kazandıracağını anlatıyoruz ” ifadelerini kullandı.

Türkevi'ndeki toplantıda enerji, finans, teknoloji, havacılık, otomotiv ve tüketici ürünleri başta olmak üzere stratejik sektörlerde Türkiye-ABD ekonomik ilişkilerinin geliştirilmesi ve yeni yatırım olanakları ele alındı.

Pandemiyle birlikte iş hayatının kalıcı modellerinden biri haline gelen hibrit çalışmada yeni dönem başladı. Resmî Gazete’de yayımlanan düzenlemeyle, çalışanların hangi gün işyerinde, hangi gün uzaktan çalışacağı ve çalışma saatleri iş sözleşmesinde belirlenecek. Ancak düzenleme hibrit çalışmayı ilk kez getirmiyor; 2021’den beri mümkün olan modeli daha açık bir sözleşme hükmüne bağlıyor.

Futbolculuk kariyerinin ardından adını küresel bir markaya dönüştüren David Beckham'ın ticari faaliyetlerini yöneten DRJB Holdings, 2025'te rekor sonuçlara ulaştı. Şirketin geliri yüzde 20 artarak 110,5 milyon dolara, vergi öncesi kârı ise yüzde 46 artışla yaklaşık 65,8 milyon dolara çıktı. Güçlü bilanço Beckham'ın cebine 51 milyon dolar koydu.

evidence.title: Koç Holding (KCHOL) Haberleri
evidence.text:
Koç Holding, 1926 yılında kurulan ve Türkiye’nin en büyük sanayi ve ticaret gruplarından biri olarak, enerji, otomotiv, finans, dayanıklı tüketim malları ve diğer pek çok sektörde faaliyet göstermektedir. Türkiye’nin en güçlü holdinglerinden biri olan Koç Holding, aynı zamanda dünyanın önde gelen iş gruplarından biridir. Holding, sadece Türkiye’de değil, global pazarlarda da önemli bir oyuncu olup, farklı alanlarda lider konumda yer almaktadır. Koç Holding’in en bilinen şirketlerinden bazıları Arçelik, Tofaş, Yapı Kredi Bankası ve Ford Otosan'dır. KCHOL koduyla Borsa İstanbul’da işlem gören Koç Holding hisse senetleri, Türkiye ekonomisinin genel durumundan, şirketin finansal performansına kadar pek çok faktörden etkilenmektedir. Bu sayfa, yatırımcıların Koç Holding ile ilgili en güncel haberleri takip edebileceği, şirketin finansal raporları, yeni yatırımlar, büyüme stratejileri ve piyasa analizlerinin yer aldığı bir platform sunmaktadır. Koç Holding, güçlü bir finansal yapıya sahip olup, yıllık raporlarında gelir artışı, kâr-zarar durumu ve nakit akışı gibi önemli verileri düzenli olarak açıklamaktadır. Holdingin büyüme stratejileri arasında yurtdışındaki faaliyetlerini genişletmek, sürdürülebilirlik projelerine yatırım yapmak ve yenilikçi ürünlerle pazara sunulmaktadır. Şirketin operasyonel verimliliği, risk yönetimi ve dijital dönüşüm stratejileri de yatırımcılar için önemlidir. Koç Holding hisse senetlerinin fiyatları, şirketin faaliyet gösterdiği sektörlerin ekonomik koşullarına, döviz kuru dalgalanmalarına, faiz oranlarındaki değişimlere ve global krizlere duyarlıdır. Bu nedenle, yatırımcıların Koç Holding ile ilgili açıklamaları, finansal verileri ve piyasa hareketlerini dikkatle takip etmeleri gerekmektedir. Ayrıca, şirketin bağlı olduğu sektörlerdeki gelişmeler, yeni yatırımlar ve stratejik ortaklıklar da Koç Holding hisselerinin performansını doğrudan etkileyebilir. Yatırımcılar, Koç Holding’in yıl içinde açıklanan mali sonuçlarını, hisse senedi önerilerini ve analist raporlarını takip ederek, şirketin büyüme potansiyeli hakkında bilgi sahibi olabilirler. Koç Holding, özellikle yenilikçi teknolojiler ve dijital dönüşüm alanlarında yaptığı yatırımlarla dikkat çekmektedir. Bu sayfada, Koç Holding'in faaliyetleri, finansal durumu ve sektörel analizler hakkında en güncel haberleri takip edebilirsiniz. Koç Holding’in güçlü yönetim yapısı, mali stratejileri ve liderlik pozisyonu, şirketin gelecekteki büyüme hedeflerine ulaşmasına katkı sağlamaktadır. Bu sayfada, Koç Holding hisse senetlerine dair son dakika gelişmelerini, şirket açıklamalarını ve yatırımcılara yönelik önemli bilgileri bulabilirsiniz.

Hizmetlerimizi geliştirmek ve yasal mevzuata uygun şekilde çerezler kullanıyoruz. Detaylı bilgi ve iptal için Gizlilik Politikamızı inceleyebilirsiniz.

Borsanın Gündemi'nin haberine göre, BIST Temettü Endeksi’nde yer alan 99 şirketten 18’i 2026’nın ikinci çeyreği itibarıyla 100 milyar TL’nin üzerinde hasılata ulaştı. Şirketin 2026’nın ilk yarısındaki hasılatı geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 9 arttı. Trilyon liralık gelir sınırını aşan diğer şirket ise İş Yatırım oldu. evidence.title: Koç Holding, COP31 İklim Değişikliği Zirvesi’nin “Küresel İş Ortağı” oldu
evidence.text:
Koç Holding, COP31 İklim Değişikliği Zirvesi’nin “Küresel İş Ortağı” oldu

Koç Holding, Türkiye’nin ilk kez ev sahipliği yapacağı ve 9 - 20 Kasım 2026 tarihlerinde Antalya’da gerçekleştirilecek Birleşmiş Milletler İklim Değişikliği Konferansı’nın (COP31) “Küresel İş Ortağı” olmak üzere anlaşma imzaladı.

GAZETE PENCERE - COP31 Başkanı ve Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanı Murat Kurum ile Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Y. Koç arasında gerçekleştirilen görüşmede COP31 kapsamında yürütülecek iş birliği ve Koç Holding ile Koç Topluluğu şirketlerinin uluslararası konferansa sağlayacağı stratejik katkılar ele alındı.

Koç Holding, bu önemli zirveye desteği kapsamında; farklı sektörlere dayanan deneyimi, küresel pazarlara erişimi, geniş ekosistemi, stratejik ortaklıkları, teknoloji ve sürdürülebilir finansman konusundaki yetkinliği ile iklim taahhütlerini ölçeklenebilir ve somut adımlara dönüştürme konusundaki deneyimini paylaşacak.

100. yaşını kutlayan Koç Topluluğu’nun şirketleri de bu çerçevede ülkemizin ev sahipliğine katkı sağlayacak.

Koç Holding Türkiye’nin ilk kez ev sahipliği yapacağı ve 9-20 Kasım tarihlerinde Antalya’da gerçekleştirilecek COP31’in “Küresel İş Ortağı” oldu.

Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanı ve COP31 Başkanı Murat Kurum ile Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Y. Koç ve Koç Holding CEO’su Levent Çakıroğlu COP31 gündemiyle bir araya geldi.

Görüşmede, Koç Holding’in COP31 “Küresel İş Ortağı” unvanıyla yürüteceği çalışmalar ile sürdürülebilirlik, teknoloji ve inovasyon ekseninde konferansa sunacağı katkılar değerlendirildi.

KURUM: İKLİM KARARLILIĞINI DÜNYAYA GÖSTERECEĞİZ

Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanı ve COP31 Başkanı Murat Kurum, görüşmeye ilişkin değerlendirmesinde şöyle konuştu:

“Antalya’da ev sahipliği yapacağımız COP31’de kamudan özel sektöre, finans dünyasından sivil topluma kadar tüm paydaşlarımızla güçlerimizi birleştirerek Türkiye’nin iklim eylemindeki kararlılığını dünyaya göstereceğiz. Bu kapsamda ülkemizin en köklü kuruluşlarından ve bu yıl 100. yaşını kutlayan Koç Topluluğu, Koç Holding şemsiyesi altında, COP31’in ‘Küresel İş Ortağı’ oldu. Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Koç ile görüşerek bu süreçte birlikte neler yapabileceğimizi ele aldık. COP31’de özel sektörün katkısını ve iş birliklerimizi önemsediğimizi; Koç Holding’in de bu sürece katkı sunacak olmasından duyduğumuz memnuniyeti aktardık. COP31’de; ortak akılla, güçlü iş birlikleriyle ve somut adımlarla taahhütleri eyleme dönüştürecek adımları atacağız. Hayırlı olsun."

Koç Holding Yönetim Kurulu Başkan Vekili Ali Y. Koç, Türkiye’nin COP31’e ev sahipliği yapmasından memnuniyet duyduklarını belirterek şu değerlendirmede bulundu:

“Koç Topluluğu olarak 100 yıldır ülkemizin geleceğine duyduğumuz güvenle yatırım yapıyor, üretiyor, ekonomik ve toplumsal kalkınmaya katkı sağlıyoruz. İlk yüzyılımızda müşterilerimizden hissedarlarımıza, bayilerimizden iş ortaklarımıza kadar tüm paydaşlarımızla birlikte büyüdük, geliştik. Topluluğumuzun 2050 karbon nötr hedefi doğrultusunda sürdürülebilirlik yolculuğumuzda da iş ortaklarımızı gerekli dönüşüm için teşvik edecek, daima olduğu gibi omuz omuza ilerleyeceğiz. İkinci yüzyılımıza adım attığımız bu anlamlı dönemde, dünyanın en önemli iklim platformlarından COP31’in ‘Küresel İş Ortağı’ olarak ülkemizin temsiline güçlü şekilde katkı sunmaktan gurur ve memnuniyet duyuyoruz. Ülkemizin COP31’e ev sahipliği yapmasını, iklim hedeflerini hayata geçirme kararlılığını ve yeşil dönüşümdeki rekabet gücünü dünyaya göstermek açısından tarihi bir fırsat olarak değerlendiriyoruz.”

İklim değişikliğiyle mücadelenin çok boyutlu bir dönüşüm olduğuna dikkat çeken Ali Y. Koç, “İş dünyamızın iklim taahhütlerini somut ve ticari olarak uygulanabilir çözümlere dönüştürme gücüne sahip olduğuna inanıyoruz. İklim krizi; ciddi bir iş riski oluşturuyor, sanayinin rekabet gücünü ve geleceğini etkiliyor. Bu kapsamda da teknoloji ve inovasyon kapasitemizi güçlü bir şekilde kullanarak iklim değişikliğiyle mücadele etmeyi stratejik öncelik olarak ele alıyoruz. 60'tan fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 155'ten fazla ülkeye ihracat yapan ve gelirlerinin yüzde 95'inden fazlasını enerji, otomotiv, dayanıklı tüketim ve finans gibi dönüşümün merkezinde yer alan sektörlerden elde eden bir Topluluk olarak, ülkemizin iklim hedeflerine ulaşmasında önemli bir etki gücümüz bulunuyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Temiz enerji, elektrifikasyon, enerji ve kaynak verimliliği, iklim teknolojileri, döngüsel ekonomi ve sürdürülebilir finansman alanlarında yatırımlarını uzun yıllardır kesintisiz olarak sürdürdüklerini kaydeden Ali Y. Koç, “COP31’in bu çalışmalarımızı paylaşmanın yanı sıra ülkemizden ve dünyadan paydaşlarla yeni işbirlikleri geliştirebileceğimiz son derece değerli bir platform olacağına inanıyoruz” dedi.

Koç Holding ve bağlı şirketleri, küresel iklim gündemi kapsamındaki en önemli buluşma sayılan COP31’in master ortakları arasında yer alacak. Küresel iklim taahhütlerinin gerçekleşmesine katkı sağlayacak somut uygulamaların öne çıktığı bir dönemde Koç Holding, 2050 karbon nötr hedefi doğrultusunda topluluk şirketleriyle birlikte iklim çözümlerini somut iş sonuçlarına dönüştürme deneyimini ulusal ve uluslararası paydaşlarla paylaşma fırsatı bulacak.

Sektörel deneyimi, küresel pazarlara erişimi ve geniş ekosistemiyle Koç Holding; teknoloji, finans, stratejik ortaklıklar ve insan kaynağı konusundaki iyi uygulamalarıyla dönüşümü hızlandırma konusunda güçlü bir etki gücüne sahip.

evidence.title: Yeni iPhone 18 Pro serisi Turkcell mağazaları ve Pasaj’da satışa sunuldu
evidence.text:
Yeni iPhone 18 Pro serisi Turkcell mağazaları ve Pasaj’da satışa sunuldu

Apple’ın büyük ses getiren yeni modelleri iPhone 18 Pro ve iPhone 18 Pro Max, Turkcell mağazalarında ve Turkcell Pasaj’da satışa sunuldu. Müşteriler farklı ödeme seçeneklerinin yanı sıra, Turkcell mağazalarında geçerli değiş tokuş kampanyasıyla, eski cihazlarını değerlendirerek yeni modellere avantajlı fiyatlarla geçiş yapabiliyor.

En yeni teknolojileri kullanıcılarla buluşturmayı odağına alan Turkcell , Apple'ın yeni iPhone modellerini de satışa sunuldukları ilk andan itibaren müşterileriyle buluşturuyor. iPhone 18 Pro ve iPhone 18 Pro Max, 18 Eylül itibarıyla Turkcell mağazalarında ve Turkcell Pasaj'da yerini aldı.

Kullanıcılar, yeni modellere Turkcell güvencesiyle peşin veya peşin fiyatına kontratlı 12 ay vade seçeneğiyle ulaşabiliyor. Telefonunu yenilemek isteyen kullanıcılar ise Turkcell mağazalarında sunulan değiş tokuş kampanyasından yararlanabiliyor.

Apple'ın 9 Eylül'de tanıttığı ilk katlanabilir modeli iPhone Duo da ekim ayında Turkcell kanallarında satışa çıkacak.

evidence.title: Turkcell Maps Out Expansive Network of Telecom and Digital Service Subsidiaries
evidence.text:
Turkcell Maps Out Expansive Network of Telecom and Digital Service Subsidiaries

Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri AS ( (TR:TCELL) ) has provided an update.

Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri AŞ has detailed an extensive portfolio of subsidiaries covering telecommunications, TV broadcasting, IT and data services, customer management, tower and infrastructure operations, and international network investments in markets including Cyprus, Belarus, and Europe. These units underpin Turkcell’s integrated connectivity ecosystem and support its position as a leading regional operator.

Beyond core telecoms, the group highlights subsidiaries in payment services, electronic money, consumer finance, digital and traditional insurance, renewable energy, real estate, and digital content platforms such as music, TV, and messaging, as well as enterprise digitalization offerings. The disclosed structure shows Turkcell building a broad, vertically and horizontally integrated digital services and finance platform, with its minority stake in Türkiye’nin Otomobili signaling strategic alignment with Turkey’s emerging electric vehicle and smart mobility sector.

More about Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri AS

Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri AŞ is a diversified telecommunications and digital services group, with core operations spanning mobile and fixed telecoms, TV broadcasting, customer relationship management, and IT services. Through numerous wholly owned subsidiaries in Turkey, Europe, and the CIS, the group also operates in payments, consumer finance, insurance, data centers, renewable energy, and digital content, targeting both retail consumers and corporate clients.

The company’s structure includes units focused on network infrastructure, tower operations, R&D, and international telecom investments, as well as specialized brands for digital music, TV, messaging, search, and enterprise digitalization solutions. Turkcell further extends into adjacent sectors such as electricity trading, real estate, and meal card services, and holds an associate stake in Türkiye’nin Otomobili, the national electric car initiative, aligning its portfolio with broader technology and mobility trends.

evidence.title: Kulüpler Birliği Başkanı Doğan, Turkcell Başkanı Kazancı'yı ziyaret etti, gündemde Süper Lig yayın ihalesi vardı
evidence.text:
Kulüpler Birliği Başkanı Doğan, Turkcell Başkanı Kazancı'yı ziyaret etti, gündemde Süper Lig yayın ihalesi vardı

Süper Lig yayın ihalesi için Turkcell seçeneği konuşulurken, Kulüpler Birliği Başkanı ve Trabzonspor Başkanı Ertuğrul Doğan dikkat çeken bir ziyaret gerçekleştirdi. Ertuğrul Doğan, Türkcell Genel Müdürlüğü'nde Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Şenol Kazancı'yı ziyaret etti, görüşmede yeni yayın ihalesi değerlendirildi.

Patronlar Dünyası Genel Yayın Yönetmeni Toygun Atilla, ihale tarihi bile belli değilken 6 Ağustos’ta Turkcell çevresindeki dikkat çekici görüşme trafiğini ortaya çıkarmış ve Süper Lig’in yeni yayın ihalesinde Turkcell seçeneğini gündeme getirmişti.

YAYIN İHALESİ TARİHİ AÇIKLANDI, GÖRÜŞMELER BAŞLADI

Türkiye Futbol Federasyonu, 17 Eylül'de yaptığı açıklamada, Süper Lig yayın ihalesinin 13 Ocak 2027 tarihinde gerçekleşeceğini açıkladı.

Bu açıklamanın ardından, 21 Eylül'de Gençlik ve Spor Bakanı Osman Aşkın Bak, Turkcell'i ziyaret etti ve Turkcell Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Şenol Kazancı'yla bir görüşme gerçekleştirdi.

Bakan Osman Aşkın Bak'ın ziyaretinin hemen ardından Şenol Kazancı, TFF Başkanı İbrahim Ethem Hacıosmanoğlu ile buluştu. Patronlar Dünyası tarafından yakından takip edilen süreçte, TFF’nin açıklamasında Turkcell ile yapılan görüşme için ilk kez açıkça “yeni yayın ihalesi” ifadesi kullanıldı.

ERTUĞRUL DOĞAN İLE ŞENOL KAZANCI GÖRÜŞTÜ

Bakan Bak ve TFF Başkanı Hacıosmanoğlu ile görüşmelerin ardından bugün dikkat çeken bir ziyaret daha gerçekleşti. Kulüpler Birliği Vakfı ve Trabzonspor Başkanı Ertuğrul Doğan, Turkcell Genel Müdürlüğü’nde Turkcell Yönetim Kurulu Başkanı Şenol Kazancı’ya nezaket ziyaretinde bulundu.

Turkcell Genel Müdürlüğü’nde gerçekleşen görüşmede Trendyol Süper Lig ve Trendyol 1. Lig müsabakaları yeni yayın ihalesi konuları değerlendirildi.

evidence.title: ASELSAN Unveils SMASH 300 Naval Weapon System to Counter Surface Threats and Mini/Micro Drones
evidence.text:
ASELSAN Unveils SMASH 300 Naval Weapon System to Counter Surface Threats and Mini/Micro Drones

ASELSAN has introduced the SMASH 300, a 25mm remotely operated stabilized naval gun system designed to defend surface vessels against aerial and surface threats using AI-enabled targeting and smart munitions.

ASELSAN has unveiled the SMASH 300, a 25mm remotely operated stabilized naval weapon system engineered to defend surface platforms against surface threats and mini/micro unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The system integrates artificial intelligence for target detection and tracking, enabling rapid and accurate engagement of small, fast-moving aerial and maritime threats.

The SMASH 300 combines a stabilized 25mm gun with advanced electro-optical sensors and AI-driven fire control, allowing it to detect, track, and engage threats autonomously or under operator command. Its integration with ATOM smart munitions improves precision and effectiveness, while compatibility with AURA radar and other naval sensors enables layered defense architecture. The system is designed for easy installation on various naval platforms, from patrol boats to frigates.

For Turkey, the SMASH 300 represents a significant step in strengthening naval self-reliance amid rising asymmetric threats in regional waters. By deploying indigenous AI-enhanced defense systems, the Turkish Navy reduces dependence on foreign solutions and enhances its ability to protect assets in littoral environments where mini/micro UAVs and fast inshore attack craft pose growing risks. This advancement supports Turkey’s broader goal of modernizing its naval force with domestically developed, high-technology solutions.

evidence.title: Aselsan showcases integrated EW and ISR capabilities
evidence.text:
Aselsan has demonstrated the coordinated operation of three airborne electronic warfare and intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) systems from Bayraktar TB2 UAVs, in a high-impact live demonstration with the participation of 15 plus international defence delegations in Konya province.

The trials brought together electronic support, electronic attack and synthetic aperture radar capabilities in a single operational scenario, demonstrating how the systems can work together to detect, locate, engage and identify targets under real-world conditions.

The demonstration showcased the performance of three key systems deployed on the Bayraktar TB2 UAV: Antidot 2EA 200 Electronic Countermeasure (ECM) Pod, Antidot 2ES 100 Electronic Support Measures (ESM) Pod, and the Fulmar 200 AESA Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Pod.

In the first stage of the demo, ESM Pod detected and accurately geolocated a search radar emitter during a flight. The system then handed over target data to the ECM Pod, which executed a precision electronic attack.

At a designated point, the attack was temporarily suspended to allow the target radar to reacquire and lock-on to the UAV. Once UAV is locked, the ECM system applied necessary DRFM based countermeasure techniques, successfully disrupting the track radar’s performance, as well.

In the second stage of the demo, the ESM Pod again detected and located the emitter, providing real-time situational awareness while Fulmar 200 SAR Pod generated high-resolution synthetic aperture radar imagery of the target area.

According to the company, the resulting imagery enabled detailed ground mapping, target identification and geolocating with metres-level accuracy, demonstrating the system’s suitability for day-and-night, all-weather ISR missions.

Together, the trials demonstrated an end-to-end operational cycle on UAVs, combining detection and localisation, electronic attack and high-resolution imaging.

According to Aselsan, the demonstration highlighted the ability of its airborne systems to deliver Suppression of Enemy Air Defense (SEAD) and Destruction of Enemy Air Defense (DEAD) capabilities through a single UAV platform for operations in increasingly contested environments.

evidence.title: ASELSAN unveils next-generation ‘SMASH 300’ remote weapon system
evidence.text:
ASELSAN unveils next-generation ‘SMASH 300’ remote weapon system

Turkish defense giant ASELSAN has demonstrated enhanced capabilities for its "SMASH 300" remote-controlled weapon station designed for naval platforms.

The upgraded SMASH 300 system integrates artificial intelligence support and ATOM smart ammunition technology, enabling it to engage surface targets as well as mini and micro unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).

During firing tests, the weapon system successfully demonstrated high operational effectiveness against both single and multiple aerial targets.

The upgraded platform features critical enhancements, including improved target detection and tracking, advanced object classification, expanded electro-optical surveillance capabilities, and an increased ammunition capacity.

In an official statement, ASELSAN emphasized that the primary goal of the SMASH 300 is to bolster the defensive capabilities of the Turkish Naval Forces and the Coast Guard Command using locally engineered, national technologies.

evidence.title: Türkiye’s Aselsan showcases advanced electronic warfare, radar payloads
evidence.text:
Türkiye’s Aselsan showcases advanced electronic warfare, radar payloads

Aselsan demonstrated new electronic warfare and radar systems integrated into Baykar’s Bayraktar TB2 drones, showing live detection, jamming and high-resolution imaging of radar targets.

Turkish defense firm Aselsan showcased its new electronic warfare and radar systems integrated into Baykar's Bayraktar TB2 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) during a live demonstration attended by delegations from around the world in central Türkiye.

Two Bayraktar TB2 drones were equipped with Aselsan's Antidot 2ES 100 electronic support pod and Antidot 2EA 200 electronic warfare pod. The second drone was fitted with a Fulmar 200 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) pod.

The Antidot systems detected a live target radar system midflight, pinpointing its location and executing an autonomous electronic strike during the first phase of the exercise, which allowed the drone to approach stealthily.

The second phase showed interoperability between payloads by demonstrating the Antidot suite locating a separate target and relaying coordinates to the Fulmar 200 pod, which allowed high-precision, high-resolution radar image capture of the site.

The demonstration marked the first time that Aselsan's Antidot family of products was tested against real radar systems aboard the Bayraktar TB2 platform, combining detection, jamming and high-resolution imaging in a single operational cycle.

The Antidot 2ES 100 pod records incoming signals to expose enemy air defenses while determining threat direction. The system then transmits critical intelligence to ground control stations through the drone's communications band.

The compact, lightweight Antidot 2EA 200 analyzes signal characteristics, identifies threats and autonomously engages enemy search and tracking radars via preprogrammed electronic attack techniques, complementing the support pod.

The lightweight, low-power Fulmar 200 serves as an active electronically scanned array radar capable of executing Spotlight and Stripmap imaging functions in all weather and light conditions. It can be mounted under a wing or directly onto an airframe to operate seamlessly alongside existing electro-optical and infrared camera systems.

The demonstration showcased the seamless performance of three key systems deployed on the Bayraktar TB2 UAV: ANTIDOT 2EA 200 Electronic Countermeasure (ECM) Pod, ANTIDOT 2ES 100 Electronic Support Measures (ESM) Pod, and the FULMAR 200 AESA Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Pod. In the first stage of the demo, ESM Pod detected and accurately geolocated a search radar emitter during a flight. The system then handed over target data to the ECM Pod, which executed a precision electronic attack. At a designated point, the attack was temporarily suspended to allow the target radar to reacquire and lock-on to the UAV. Once UAV is locked, the ECM system applied necessary DRFM based countermeasure techniques, successfully disrupting the track radar’s performance, as well.

In the second stage of the demo, the ESM Pod again detected and located the emitter, providing real-time situational awareness while FULMAR 200 SAR Pod generated high-resolution synthetic aperture radar imagery of the target area. The resulting imagery enabled detailed ground mapping, target identification and geolocating with meters-level accuracy, demonstrating the system’s suitability for day-and-night, all-weather ISR missions.

Together, the trials demonstrated an end-to-end operational cycle on UAVs, combining detection and localization, electronic attack and high-resolution imaging. The last stage of this combat proven operational concept, normally ends with designation of air defense systems via ASELFLIR 500 and destruction with a laser guided munition. The demonstration highlighted the ability of ASELSAN’s airborne systems to deliver Suppression of Enemy Air Defense (SEAD) and Destruction of Enemy Air Defense (DEAD) capabilities through a single UAV platform for operations in i

evidence.title: Türkiye’s Aselsan Unveils Advanced Electronic Warfare, Radar Systems
evidence.text:
Turkish defense company Aselsan demonstrated its latest electronic warfare and radar systems integrated with Baykar’s Bayraktar TB2 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) during a live exercise attended by international delegations in central Türkiye.

Two Bayraktar TB2 drones were equipped with Aselsan’s Antidot 2ES 100 electronic support pod and Antidot 2EA 200 electronic warfare pod. The second drone also carried a Fulmar 200 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) pod, The Caspian Post reports, citing Anadolu Agency .

During the first phase of the exercise, the Antidot systems detected a live radar target while the drone was in flight, determined its location and carried out an autonomous electronic attack. This enabled the UAV to approach the target covertly.

The second phase demonstrated interoperability between the systems. The Antidot suite detected and located a separate target before transmitting its coordinates to the Fulmar 200 pod. The radar then captured high-resolution images of the area with high precision.

The demonstration marked the first time the Antidot family had been tested against live radar systems aboard the Bayraktar TB2 platform. The exercise combined radar detection, electronic attack and high-resolution imaging within a single operational cycle.

The Antidot 2ES 100 pod intercepts and records incoming signals to help identify enemy air-defense systems and determine their direction. It then transmits critical intelligence to ground control stations through the UAV’s communications link.

The compact and lightweight Antidot 2EA 200 analyzes signal characteristics, identifies threats and can autonomously engage enemy search and tracking radars using preprogrammed electronic attack techniques. It is designed to complement the Antidot electronic support pod.

The lightweight, low-power Fulmar 200 is an active electronically scanned array radar capable of Spotlight and Stripmap imaging in various weather and lighting conditions. It can be mounted beneath a wing or directly on an aircraft and is designed to operate alongside existing electro-optical and infrared camera systems.
