evidence.title: Laurent Bouvet
evidence.text:
Laurent Bouvet: «Aux origines du tournant identitaire»

GRAND ENTRETIEN - L’universitaire et fondateur du Printemps républicain n’est guère surpris par les polémiques actuelles sur le supposé racisme de la police et de l’État. Dans Le Péril identitaire (Éditions de l’Observatoire), essai aussi court que dense, il synthétise des décennies de travaux sur la question du communautarisme et revient aux sources du malaise occidental.

Laurent Bouvet: «Il faut aller bien plus loin si l’on veut réellement combattre ‘l’hydre islamiste’»

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Le co-fondateur du Printemps républicain déplore la réticence d’Emmanuel Macron à employer le terme communautarisme. Selon lui, la lutte contre l’islamisme doit faire l’objet d’un projet d’ensemble plutôt que de mesures circonstanciées.

Le Printemps républicain va se transformer en parti politique pour «peser» en 2022

Défenseur de la laïcité, le mouvement veut nourrir une plateforme programmatique, sans toutefois présenter de listes aux municipales.

Marche du 10 novembre: «Le jour où des élus de la République ont défilé contre la République»

FIGAROVOX/TRIBUNE - Pour Céline Pina, «la marche contre l’islamophobie» du 10 novembre représente une trahison des élus. Une gauche dévoyée s’est faite l’alliée objective des islamistes.

«Manif contre l’islamophobie»: le déshonneur d’une certaine gauche

FIGAROVOX/ANALYSE - Une partie de la gauche, radicale mais pas seulement, a choisi d’apporter sa caution à cette nébuleuse islamiste, explique notre journaliste Alexandre Devecchio.

Laurent Bouvet: «En parlant de “culture blanche”, Lilian Thuram diffuse un discours essentialiste»

FIGAROVOX/ANALYSE - L’ancien footballeur Lilian Thuram a déclaré qu’«il y a du racisme dans la culture blanche». Soutenir une telle idée n’est pas sans risque, estime le politologue Laurent Bouvet pour qui une lutte efficace contre le racisme devrait plutôt se fonder sur l’humanisme et l’universalisme.

Laurent Bouvet: «La laïcité, l’islam et l’immigration divisent profondément la majorité»

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Pour le professeur de science politique, la position du ministre de l’Éducation nationale sur le voile est conforme aux valeurs républicaines. Il regrette cependant qu’elle ne soit pas partagée par tous les élus de la majorité.

Quand le voile islamique divise une fédération laïque de parents d’élèves

ENQUÊTE - Depuis la polémique sur son affiche de campagne, la FCPE, déjà en perte de vitesse, accuse le coup.

Laurent Bouvet: «Aucune opinion, croyance ou religion n’est à l’abri de la critique»

GRAND ENTRETIEN - Le professeur de science politique* est poursuivi par une fédération de parents d’élèves, la FCPE, après avoir partagé sur les réseaux sociaux des détournements d’une affiche qui réclame le droit, pour les femmes voilées, d’accompagner des sorties scolaires. L’affaire, loin d’être anecdotique, révèle un climat d’intimidation, argumente l’universitaire.

Polémique après la diffusion d’une affiche de la FCPE avec une mère voilée

La Fédération des conseils de parents d’élèves (FCPE) a récemment diffusé une affiche de campagne défendant le droit pour les mères voilées de participer à des sorties scolaires.

Laurent Bouvet: «L’aveuglement sur l’immigration est l’une des raisons de l’échec historique de la gauche»

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Dans son discours devant la majorité lundi soir, le chef de l’État a emprunté à Laurent Bouvet certaines de ses analyses, pointant notamment le sentiment d’ «insécurité culturelle» des Français.

Laurent Bouvet: «En parlant de “culture blanche”, Lilian Thuram diffuse un discours essentialiste»

FIGAROVOX/ANALYSE - L’ancien footballeur Lilian Thuram a déclaré qu’«il y a du racisme dans la culture blanche». Soutenir une telle idée n’est pas sans risque, estime le politologue Laurent Bouvet pour qui une lutte efficace contre le racisme devrait plutôt se fonder sur l’humanisme et l’universalisme.

Laïcité: La République en marche va se réunir pour «déterminer une ligne»

INFO LE FIGARO - Alors que plusieurs députés de la majorité se sont écharpés sur la polémique du hidjab de Decathlon, le mouvement présidentiel va organiser un «débat» interne le 20 mars prochain au siège du parti, à l'initiative de Marlène Schiappa.

Mark Lilla/Laurent Bouvet: «La France résistera-t-elle au multiculturalisme américain ?»

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Dans son dernier livre, La Gauche identitaire (Stock), l'universitaire américain Mark Lilla met en garde la gauche française contre le piège de la politique des minorités qui a causé la perte du Parti démocrate américain. L'essayiste et professeur de science politique Laurent Bouvet dénonce, lui aussi, depuis plusieurs années, cette dérive communautariste. Dialogue entre penseurs venus des deux rives de l'Atlantique. Publiés le 19 octobre, ces propos permettent d'éclairer sous un jour neuf les résultats des élections de mi-mandat aux États-Unis.

«Pourquoi les peuples d'Europe centrale refusent nos leçons de morale»

TRIBUNE - Polonais, Hongrois et Tchèques sont, tout comme nous, attachés aux valeurs de l'Europe, mais de quelles valeurs parle-t-on ?, argumente la professeur de philosophie politique Chantal Delsol.

Charlie Hebdo contre Médiapart : l'affrontement entre deux gauches irréconciliables

FIGAROVOX / ENTRETIEN - Laurent Bouvet dénonce l'indécence des propos d'Edwy Plenel et l'aveuglement d'une certaine gauche sur les enjeux dits « identitaires ». Pour lui, deux «gauches irréconciliables» s'opposent.

Interdiction d'Autant en emporte le vent : jusqu'où ira la guerre culturelle aux Etats-Unis ?

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Après la chasse aux statues, la guerre culturelle qui semble s'être emparée des États-Unis depuis Charlottesville s'est récemment attaquée au cinéma, avec l'interdiction dans le Tenessee d'une projection d'Autant en emporte le vent. Laurent Bouvet réagit à ces événements.

Bouvet : « Que des universitaires défendent Houria Bouteldja est un crime contre l'esprit »

FIGAROVOX/GRAND ENTRETIEN - En réaction à un article de Jean Birnbaum sur les dérives de l'antiracisme, une vingtaine d'intellectuels a pris la défense, dans une tribune du Monde parue le 20 juin, de Houria Bouteldja, porte-parole des Indigènes de la République citée par Birnbaum. Laurent Bouvet réagit à cette affaire.

Élections Législatives : la Berezina des vieux partis politiques

FIGAROVOX/TRIBUNE - Le triomphe de La République en marche lors des législatives risquent d'entraîner la disparition des vieux partis politiques. Jean-Baptiste FORRAY, auteur de La République des apparatchiks (Fayard, 2017), analyse les raisons d'un naufrage.

L'appel de 17 intellectuels: «Que la vérité soit dite sur le meurtre de Sarah Halimi»

TRIBUNE - Dans un texte publié en exclusivité dans Le Figaro , Alain Finkielkraut, Michel Onfray, Jacques Julliard, Élisabeth Badinter, Marcel Gauchet et d'autres personnalités* appellent à ce que toute la lumière soit faite sur la mort de cette Française de confession juive tuée aux cris d'«Allah akbar». Ce crime d'une barbarie rare, qui a eu lieu en pleine campagne présidentielle, a reçu peu d'attention des médias.

Festival afro-féministe : une dérive identitaire de l'antiracisme

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Après la polémique autour du festival afro-féministe organisé par le collectif Mwasi, le politologue Laurent Bouvet analyse les ressorts idéologiques de la « non-mixité » brandie par certaines associations antiracistes.

Laurent Bouvet : « Valls anticipe l'éclatement du PS »

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN- Laurent Bouvet analyse le choix de Manuel Valls, qui a déclaré vouloir être investi par En Marche ! pour les législatives.

Damien Le Guay : « Pour combattre le racisme, il faut déradicaliser l'antiracisme »

FIGAROVOX/GRAND ENTRETIEN- A l'occasion de la publication de son dernier ouvrage La guerre civile qui vient est déjà là, Damien Le Guay a accordé un entretien fleuve à FigaroVox. Pour lui, le désir inavouable d'une guerre civile qui trancherait le noeud gordien des identités irréconciliables est peut-être déjà dans les esprits.

« Peuple guyanais » : l'expression incorrecte de la ministre des Outre-mer

LE SCAN POLITIQUE - Ericka Bareigts a présenté jeudi ses « excuses au peuple guyanais ». Or selon la Constitution française, la France est une République indivisible et il n'y a qu'un seul peuple, le peuple français.

«Faire barrage au FN» : la stratégie suicidaire de la gauche castor

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN- Manuel Valls a publiquement affiché son soutien à Emmanuel Macron. Pour Laurent Bouvet, ce ralliement achève une fracture de la gauche annoncée depuis longtemps.

Laurent Bouvet : «Le quinquennat Hollande a mis fin à l'illusion de l'unité de la gauche»

FIGAROVOX/GRAND ENTRETIEN - Dans son dernier livre, La gauche zombie, chroniques d'une malédiction politique , Laurent Bouvet fait l'état des lieux de la gauche française cinq ans après la victoire de François Hollande, décrypte les raisons d'un échec historique et dresse des perspectives sombres.

Laurent Bouvet : la gauche survivra-t-elle à François Hollande ?

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Il y a un mois le politologue, Laurent Bouvet, et le FigaroVox s'interrogeaient : «le PS et plus largement la gauche peuvent-ils survivre au fiasco du quinquennat Hollande ?» Alors que le président de la République vient de renoncer à se représenter, la question est plus que jamais d'actualité.

Mathieu Bock-Côté: «Pour la gauche française Christiane Taubira a un rôle quasi-prophétique»

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Nous republions cet entretien de Mathieu Bock-Côté, initialement paru en 2016, dans lequel il explique pourquoi Christiane Taubira est l'égérie de la gauche multiculturelle et progressiste.

Laurent Bouvet : «Hollande doit dissoudre l'Assemblée ou organiser un référendum»

FIGAROVOX/GRAND ENTRETIEN - François Hollande joue dans la crise actuelle non seulement le bilan de son quinquennat mais aussi la trace qu'il laissera dans l'histoire de la gauche et, du pays, estime Laurent Bouvet.

Laurent Bouvet : « Pourquoi le voile tient une telle place dans le débat en France »

FIGARO/DÉBATS - Manuel Valls s'est dit favorable à l'interdiction du voile dans les universités, avant d'être désavoué jeudi 14 avril par François Hollande. La laïcité à la française demeure un des traits de notre pays, argumente l'universitaire Laurent Bouvet, d'où l'extrême sensibilité du sujet.

Hollande, Cambadélis et la primaire à gauche : des militants désespérés pour un PS laminé

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Jean-Christophe Cambadélis a évoqué la possibilité que les cadres du Parti socialiste puissent choisir ou non que François Hollande se représente à la présidentielle de 2017. Un signe de la décomposition accélérée du PS et de la crise d'autorité que traverse la président.

Martine Aubry l'européenne est-elle aussi socialiste qu'elle le clame ?

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Des membres de la gauche du PS se sont élevés dans une tribune contre la politique du gouvernement. Alors que ceux-ci ont été de fervents partisans de la construction européenne, Laurent Bouvet trouve difficile de voir dans ce texte autre chose qu'un mouvement d'humeur.

Cologne, «islamophobie» : ce que révèle l'affaire Kamel Daoud

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Accusé d'islamophobie, le journaliste Kamel Daoud a décidé d'arrêter le journalisme. Pour Laurent Bouvet, ce terme sert avant tout à disqualifier et à mettre en accusation ceux qui émettent des critiques contre l'islamisme politique et ses alliés.

Laurent Bouvet : «Bartolone réduit la politique au clientélisme»

INTERVIEW - Laurent Bouvet, auteur de L'Insécurité culturelle (Fayard, 2015), réagit aux accusations de Claude Bartolone contre Valérie Pécresse.

Laurent Bouvet : l'union de la gauche ne suffira pas à cacher son implosion

FIGAROVOX/ENTRETIEN - Laurent Bouvet analyse l'état dans lequel se trouve le Parti socialiste et les perspectives d'un programme commun de la gauche.

Laurent Bouvet : au Parti socialiste, le moulin à prières tourne à plein régime

FIGAROVOX/E

evidence.title: Cyber : Jérôme Bouvet rejoint Check Point France comme Country Manager
evidence.text:
La cybersécurité reste un enjeu critique pour les organisations françaises, confrontées à une hausse marquée des incidents. Selon les chiffres publiés par l’ANSSI, 4 386 incidents de sécurité ont été recensés en 2024, soit une augmentation de 15 % par rapport à 2023. Les rançongiciels représentent la majorité des cas, avec 3 004 attaques recensées, impactant particulièrement les secteurs de la santé et de l’énergie. Dans ce contexte, la nomination d’un nouveau responsable pour la France s’inscrit dans une volonté de renforcer la proximité avec les entreprises locales et leurs partenaires technologiques.

Jérôme Bouvet : un parcours ancré dans l’IT et le développement commercial

Check Point met en avant une stratégie centrée sur la sécurité hybride mesh et l’intégration de l’intelligence artificielle dans ses solutions. Lors du dernier CPX 2025, l’éditeur a souligné l’importance d’une approche proactive, capable de répondre à des attaques de plus en plus sophistiquées. L’IA est ainsi mobilisée pour la détection, la prévention et la remédiation, à travers une plateforme qui combine notamment SASE, Zero Trust et Extended Prevention & Response.

Jérôme Bouvet rejoint Check Point avec une expérience de plus de 20 ans dans la gestion d’équipes commerciales et la conduite de stratégies de croissance dans le secteur technologique. Il a exercé des responsabilités de direction au sein de plusieurs grandes entreprises IT. Dans ses nouvelles fonctions, il aura pour mission d’accélérer le développement de Check Point en France, en renforçant les relations avec les partenaires de distribution – revendeurs, intégrateurs et MSP – et en accompagnant les clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique sécurisée.

« Rejoindre Check Point est une opportunité unique. La cybersécurité est désormais un sujet stratégique pour nos clients, profondément influencé par les dynamiques géopolitiques actuelles. Je suis fier de contribuer à leur offrir des solutions robustes et innovantes pour construire une résilience numérique durable », déclare Jérôme Bouvet.

Pour Roberto Pozzi, Regional Director South Europe chez Check Point, cette nomination reflète une ambition claire sur le marché français : « L’arrivée de Jérôme Bouvet illustre notre ambition de développement en France. Sa vision et son expérience seront déterminantes pour renforcer notre engagement auprès des clients et partenaires, dans un paysage de menaces en constante évolution. »

Zero Trust et MSSP : protéger les données, renforcer la résilience et anticiper les risques

ChannelBiz.fr est le média des partenaires de distribution IT & Tech en France : Intégrateurs, revendeurs , et MSP/MSSP . Chaque semaine, nous proposons à nos 9000 abonnés 2 newsletters autour des actualités et des enjeux majeurs du Channel : infra & Cloud, Cybersécurité ; Workspace & AV ; Telecom; et Business Apps . Nous éditons également chaque trimestre « ChannelBiz : Le Mag » : un magazine de 60 pages, pour prendre du recul sur les tendances fortes du marché. evidence.title: Christian Bouvet nous a quittés
evidence.text:
Christian Bouvet nous a quittés à l’âge de 79 ans. Châteaubriant perd une de ses mémoires. Arrivé à Châteaubriant en 1969, Christian Bouvet fut tour à tour, professeur d’histoire au lycée Guy-Môquet, inspecteur de l’Éducation Nationale, historien. Il est l’auteur d’innombrables articles, livres, monographies et de manuels scolaires.

Samedi dernier, 1ᵉʳ février, au foyer-restaurant, lors de l’Assemblée Générale de l’association HIPPAC*, dont il était président, Christian Bouvet a fait un malaise, qui s’est avéré être un AVC. S’en est suivie une hospitalisation et un coma, jusqu’au décès ce mardi 4 février 2025.

Pour Gildas Salaün , adjoint à la maire de Nantes et responsable du Médailler au Musée Dobrée, très affecté par la perte de Christian Bouvet.

« J’ai rencontré Christian Bouvet dans le cadre de mes activités professionnelles. J’ai le souvenir d’un collègue bienveillant. Il faisait partie des personnes qui ont accompagné mes travaux. Dans ce milieu, ce n’est pas toujours comme cela, mais, il partageait les informations.

On ne se voyait pas très souvent, mais c’était toujours autour d’une bonne table. Il avait ses adresses.

On se côtoyait lors de réunions de la Société Archéologique et Historique de Nantes et de Loire.

Je lui avais apporté mon concours pour la rédaction de Châteaubriant durant la révolution qui fut publié en 2021.

Je garde, de Christian Bouvet, l’image d’un homme très investi, très engagé, avec son caractère… »

Christian Bouvet était président de l’Hippac. Cette association de sauvegarde du patrimoine de Châteaubriant et de ses alentours compte à ce jour, presque une centaine de membres.

Christian Bouvet, auteur de dizaines de livres

Un des membres de l’Hippac, se souvient particulièrement bien de Christian Bouvet. Il s’agit de Claude Reuzé, imprimeur, aujourd’hui à la retraite. En 2009, l’auteur vint lui rendre visite, car il n’avait plus d’imprimeur sous la main, l’imprimerie Rondeau venait de cesser son activité. Claude Reuzé et Christian Bouvet trouvèrent rapidement une complicité sur les sujets d’Histoire locale. L’imprimerie Reuzé, mis en page, imprima, brocha, relia une vingtaine d’ouvrages signés Christian Bouvet.

Christian Bouvet nous a quittés, il laisse derrière lui une foultitude d’écrits, de livres,…

Une cérémonie sera célébrée jeudi 13 février 2025, à 16 h 30, au crématorium du cimetière Parc de Nantes, dans l’intimité familiale.

*Histoire et patrimoine du pays de Châteaubriant.

evidence.title: Creating “One Bouvet” across multiple locations
evidence.text:
Bouvet is a leading Scandinavian consultancy offering services in IT and digital communications, including technology and enterprise management. It supports private and public sector clients with digitalization and technological development, relying on a team of more than 2,000 employees scattered throughout 17 Norwegian and Swedish locations.

However, with clients and employees spread out over various regions, the company wanted to preserve and grow its culture. As a value-based organization, Bouvet needed one source of communication and information that would support its shared goals and vision.

“My priority was to have one platform where we all could collaborate, talk to each other, and share information,” says Henriette Høyer, Director of Communications at Bouvet. With Slack, Bouvet can connect its people, collaborate, and even create social links between employees in different regions.

“Slack is an important tool for our culture of sharing and for each employee to express their opinion. We have a flat structure and everyone talks to each other on the same level.”

Building ‘one culture’ is crucial to Bouvet and improved communications play a huge role in achieving this goal. In fact, almost 1,600 active Slack channels are a testament to the fact that employees use them for social reasons as well as work. “There is even a knitting channel with knitting meetups,” comments Høyer. “We have the whole spectrum. It was really important to me that people could just thrive, start channels, and do whatever they needed, because that’s the social glue between our employees.”

Høyer uses this personal activity as an example of how people from different offices and regions can build and maintain relationships on Slack which develops into closer collaboration and original new ideas and projects. “It’s great that they actually talk to each other and are social in the same tool that we use to have job discussions,” she comments.

With Slack, people can more easily talk to each other across regions and countries, as it’s simpler for them to find each other. A designer in one office might have worked alone before, but now they have access to other designers throughout the company and can talk to them as much as their coworkers in their own office.

“Our ambition is to be a credible consultancy with the most satisfied employees and the most satisfied clients,” says Høyer. “This means we put employees first. With Slack everyone has the opportunity to share and talk to each other, and we’ve started seeing all these groups collaborate in new ways. Throughout 17 offices, two countries, and several regions, Slack is helping us be one Bouvet.”

Communication and collaboration across two countries

Interestingly, this story began after a technical server glitch prevented internal communications for a short time and many employees chose to adopt Slack as a fail-safe measure. “The decision was made to use Slack throughout the company then, and I saw how we could connect it to the intranet and build an ecosystem for information and collaboration,” says Høyer.

Høyer wanted the intranet to become the hub for finding information, be it related to employees’ jobs, finding specific colleagues, or simply asking questions. With this foundation of information, Slack channels provided a platform for interaction with the intranet. “Slack is our communication and collaboration tool, but despite all the active channels, employees are only required to follow five,” stresses Høyer.

These five main channels provide everyone with information about the company, local news, and IT updates, while offering them a chance to reach out for support. The company has also connected Slack to CMS, SharePoint, and HR platforms to create an even more closely linked environment. “Everything is pinged back to Slack,” comments Høyer. “When we post an article to our intranet, an automatic notification is sent to the related channel. It’s quite cool.”

This ecosystem played a big role when the pandemic hit and the culture of collaboration allowed for building teams across regions, finding the best people to serve clients remotely, and leaning on Slack Connect to communicate with them. It also resulted in more opportunities for the business that’s no longer tied to local talent.

The company IT is using Slack to improve its workflow, while a crowdsourcing channel allows employees to ask IT questions and get answers from colleagues before deciding to create a ticket. What’s more, one of the five main company channels is dedicated to IT and security. This is where announcements and new information are shared about policy changes, maintenance, security updates, and vulnerabilities people need to be aware of, making sure everyone in the company is up to date.

Jira, GitHub, and Coda integrations and Slack bots help streamline everyday tasks while user-built custom apps speed up processes. All these apps are user-focused and so easy to create that they are being built in large numbers by employees across the company. In fact, Bouvet even designed an approval process to manage the numbers.

Workflows also help resolve issues faster and more efficiently. For example, the team created an IT support workflow for situations when a high-priority question comes up or a ticket takes longer than it should. It gives employees a chance to create a “push” that is sent into the IT channel as a more urgent matter. Another workflow, created for the Jira integration, speaks to Bouvet’s focus on security. When people log a security incident, it pings a specific channel with several people dedicated just to this issue.

However, even for IT, the main benefits of Slack match the ones named by Høyer. “I think it’s simply collaboration,” says Basic. “And Slack also makes it easier to communicate information to people. We know if they’ve received updates.”

Høyer plans to keep building on Slack and encourages the use of Canvas and Clips. But, in the meantime, the platform allows Bouvet to create a closer community that fosters relationships, communicates better, and collaborates more closely. It can be innovative and playful while enabling business growth. In fact, a group of designers and developers within the company created a game on the Intranet where people guess an employee’s name from their photo. They often recognize each other from Slack, even if they don’t work in the same office or area, and the game is an example of the drive of employees themselves to create a more connected environment.

Overall, one of the main points of pride for Bouvet is that employees are always informed and responsive, which means that news isn’t just shared but also discussed. There is always a conversation happening between employees and the company, as opposed to information being fed to people who aren’t engaging with it. Høyer and her team are also proud of the ability to “take the temperature” of the organization. It’s easier to know what people are concerned with, what makes them interested and engaged, and what worries them. A bigger organizational picture emerges thanks to Slack.

“We have very high employee satisfaction within Bouvet,” concludes Høyer. “We let people speak their minds and do things on their own. I think the freedom part of our values is really important within Slack. And I think that Slack, playing a big role in our internal strategy, is a part of that satisfaction.”

Gofore Plc Other information disclosed according to stock exchange rules 11 September 2026 at 3.00 pm EET

Gofore Plc’s Business Review for August 2026: Net sales 19.3 million euros

Gofore's net sales were 19.3 (14.7) million euros in August 2026. The 12-month pro forma net sales were 231.4 million euros. At the end of August, the Group employed a total of 1,879 (1,373) people.

“Net sales in August were 19.3 (14.7) million euros. Organic growth accelerated in Finland, amounting in total to four percent compared to August last year. Our number of employees increased by 17 experts and there were as many as 48 new starters in August, some of which started during the month and cannot be fully seen in the August full-time equivalent number. The number of working days in August was the same as last year.

In August, we won important agreements from existing customers. Gofore was selected among the top three suppliers for the national railway VR Group’s framework agreement for backend development services. This strengthens our position in the transport and infrastructure sector. The agreement provides an opportunity for long-term cooperation in the development of VR’s digital services and systems and lays the foundation for additional growth. According to our estimate, the agreement will generate around 3 million euros in net sales for Gofore over the next six years.

The Finnish Transport Infrastructure Agency has decided to exercise the three-year option period in its agreement with us concerning the service package for identity and access management. This is a vote of confidence in our ability to deliver business-critical services and support the agency’s long-term digitalisation. If the service order volume remains at its current level, the agreement is estimated to bring us around 2.1 million euros in net sales over three years.

Among the good news in August is also Tampere University’s AI platform procurement, in which Gofore was chosen as the sole partner to develop the university’s AI platform and the AI solutions implemented on it. The cooperation covers the platform’s architecture and technology development, the implementation of AI solutions, and the long-term development and maintenance of related processes and governance and operating models.

The sale of the Product Design & Technical Documentation business to CoE Group, which we announced in June, was completed as planned on 1 September 2026. The effects of the transaction on net sales (LTM 8.2 million euros) and headcount (107) will be visible in the figures for September. Information on the other financial impacts was provided in our interim report for January–June on 18 August 2026.”

The numbers are unaudited. Key figures from the Esentri AG acquisition are included in the Group's figures as of the closing date, 2 January 2026.

In its monthly Business Review, Gofore discloses its monthly net sales, last twelve-month pro forma net sales and number of employees, as well as other indicators that help track the company’s growth strategy execution with comparison figures, such as the Full Time Equivalent (FTE) numbers that describe overall capacity and the ratio of subcontracting. Gofore publishes IAS34 compliant Interim Reports quarterly.

Gofore’s financial communications calendar for 2026 is available on Gofore’s IR website at https://gofore.com/en/invest/investor-calendar/ ﻿ .

We achieved positive organic growth for the second consecutive quarter and significantly improved our profitability compared to the previous year. Net sales grew by 32.4 percent to 58.5 million euros, driven by investments as well as organic growth (+1.8 percent). Adjusted EBITA increased significantly to 4.2 million euros, which corresponded to 7.2 percent of net sales.

Positive organic growth throughout the first half of the year is a strong signal that we have chosen the right direction. We have consistently prioritised a return to sustainable organic growth while integrating acquired companies and strengthening our position in strategically important market segments. Now that this work is yielding results, we can fully leverage the investments made over the past 12 months to deepen our foothold in our selected customer sectors.

Our work to improve profitability has also yielded results. Integration synergies, developing and renewing our competence structure, and enhanced delivery capabilities reflect our investments in sales, offering, and future expertise.

These investments have a short-term negative impact on profitability, but they are important for long-term growth opportunities and market position. However, there is still room for improvement in profitability, and we will continue to take determined actions to strengthen it.

From a market perspective, we saw encouraging developments in our strategic sectors. In the Digital Society area, customer activity remained at a good level, and recent wins, such as the National Land Survey of Finland mentioned in this report, bring stability and predictability to our business. The public sector continues to be an important market for Gofore, where our long-term customer relationships and our ability to deliver tangible results support our competitiveness.

Although the market segment is affected by constraints in public finances, the shift towards artificial intelligence and agent-based workflows presents us with a clear market opportunity for the coming years.

In the Intelligent Industry area, we see clear signs of improvement in the operating environment of our manufacturing industry customers, creating a more favorable setting for investments in digitalisation and product development. During the quarter, simulator technology sales continued strong growth.

For example, the requirements of the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) also act as a driver behind customer needs. Thanks to the recovery of the economy and exports, we believe that the Intelligent Industry area will support our growth outlook for the coming quarters.

Defence & Space continued its strong development and remains one of the most attractive growth opportunities in our portfolio. During the review period, we continued to develop this offering and our delivery capabilities, and we expect the market to remain an important driver of growth going forward.

In June, we announced the planned divestment of the Product Design & Technical Documentation business to CoE Group. This decision is based on our desire to focus on Gofore's strategic strengths, specifically in the areas of digitalization and digital technology. The cooperation agreement signed with CoE Group ensures that our customers will continue to have access to a full and comprehensive range of services, while Gofore concentrates its resources on its core strategic areas. The transaction is expected to be completed on 1 September 2026.

As we move into the second half of the year, the market environment as a whole appears more attractive than before. In my view, Gofore enters the second half of the year from a strong position. We have a solid integration foundation, a clear focus, and overall, we are well positioned to take advantage of the opportunities ahead. This strengthens our confidence in our ability to accelerate growth and deliver value both to our customers and to Gofore employees."

evidence.title: Gofore übernimmt esentri AG und stärkt Präsenz im DACH-Raum
evidence.text:
Gofore übernimmt esentri AG und stärkt Präsenz im DACH-Raum

ETTLINGEN, DE / ACCESS Newswire / December 22, 2025 / Gofore hat heute den Kaufvertrag über den Erwerb sämtlicher Aktien der esentri AG unterzeichnet. esentri ist ein wachsendes IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit Schwerpunkt auf Strategie, Digitalisierung und Nachhaltigkeit. Zu den Kunden zählen Organisationen aus den Bereichen Finanz- und Versicherungsdienstleistungen, produzierende Industrie sowie der öffentliche Sektor. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt rund 110 Expert:innen und ist in Deutschland, der Schweiz und Liechtenstein tätig. Beide Organisationen verbindet ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Qualität und eine konsequent menschenzentrierte Herangehensweise an digitale Transformation: Technologie wird als Mittel verstanden, um Organisationen, Mitarbeitende und Gesellschaft nachhaltig zu stärken - nicht als Selbstzweck.

Gofore hat heute den Erwerb sämtlicher Anteile an der Esentri AG vereinbart. Der Unternehmenswert von Esentri beträgt 10 Millionen Euro. Der Vollzug der Transaktion ist für den 2. Januar 2026 vorgesehen. Der Kaufpreis wird zu 70 Prozent in bar und zu 30 Prozent in Aktien beglichen. Er basiert auf einem schuldenfreien Unternehmenswert von 10 Millionen Euro sowie einem Netto-Cash- und Working-Capital-Adjustment von rund 1,7 Millionen Euro. Für den Aktienanteil wurde eine gezielte Kapitalerhöhung beschlossen, die separat kommuniziert wurde.

Mit der Akquisition setzt Gofore seine Wachstumsstrategie in ausgewählten Branchen in der DACH-Region konsequent fort. Gemeinsam wird das Unternehmen künftig mit mehr als 200 Expert:innen in allen deutschsprachigen Ländern präsent sein und einen Umsatz von rund 25 Millionen Euro erzielen. Der Zusammenschluss stärkt insbesondere die Position von Gofore im Finanz- und Public-Sektor sowie im Industrieumfeld und erweitert das Leistungsportfolio unter anderem in den Bereichen Managementberatung, Cloud sowie Data & AI. Strategische Ergänzung für Wachstum und Portfolio im DACH-Raum

esentri ergänzt Gofore sowohl fachlich als auch organisatorisch. Die Akquisition erweitert gezielt Fähigkeiten und Kapazitäten in einem Markt, in dem Erfahrung, Skalierbarkeit und interdisziplinäre Kompetenz zunehmend Voraussetzung für den Zugang zu komplexen Projekten und öffentlichen Ausschreibungen sind. „Mit esentri gewinnen wir einen Partner, der unsere Art zu arbeiten teilt. Der Bedarf an digitaler Transformation wächst - insbesondere im öffentlichen Sektor und in der Industrie. Ausschlaggebend war für uns neben den fachlichen Kompetenzen vor allem die kulturelle Passung: Wir beide stellen den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt und verstehen Digitalisierung als gestaltbaren Veränderungsprozess.", so Dr. Marc Fuchs , DACH CEO von Gofore.

esentri erweitert das Portfolio von Gofore insbesondere in den Bereichen Managementberatung, Data & AI, Cloud- und Softwareentwicklung sowie IoT. Robert Szilinski , CEO von esentri, ergänzt: „Für esentri ist diese Akquisition ein bedeutender Meilenstein - und der richtige Schritt zur richtigen Zeit. Unsere Kunden suchen Orientierung in komplexen Veränderungsprozessen. Gemeinsam können wir ihnen diese Klarheit noch besser bieten - als europäisches Team mit einem menschenzentrierten Anspruch." Größere Reichweite und regionale Nähe

Durch den Zusammenschluss verdoppelt Gofore seine Mitarbeiterzahl im DACH-Raum und erweitert zugleich seine geografische Präsenz. esentri ist mit einem Schwerpunkt in Baden-Württemberg tätig, in unmittelbarer Nähe zur Schweiz und zu Frankreich. Mit der erweiterten Aufstellung stärkt Gofore insbesondere seine Position in der Schweiz, einem strategisch wichtigen Markt, in dem lokale Nähe und Marktverständnis eine zentrale Rolle spielen.

evidence.title: Siili Solutions: The Insider "Buy" That Isn't One — the Factor Stack Is the Real Signal
evidence.text:
Catch pre-market movers with AI signals.

Siili Solutions: The Insider "Buy" That Isn't One — the Factor Stack Is the Real Signal

- Maria Niiniharju's €2,050 Siili Solutions stock purchase was part of a routine employee savings plan, not a discretionary 861073 -- investment.

- Siili's revenue fell 13% in H1 2026, with adjusted EBITA at -0.7% versus peers' 8.8-18% margins, showing deteriorating fundamentals.

- The stock trades near 52-week lows despite a "cheap" valuation illusion, as earnings collapse makes low multiples misleading.

- Management guidance cuts and CEO turnover highlight structural challenges, with recovery dependent on revenue stabilization and EBITA turnaround.

A "Managers' Transactions – Niiniharju" headline crossed the wire on the afternoon of 27 August, and if you have trained yourself to scan for insider buys, the shape looks familiar: a senior manager bought stock. Here is everything the disclosure actually says. Maria Niiniharju, an "other senior manager" at Siili Solutions, acquired 680 shares at €3.015 per share on Nasdaq Helsinki on 26 August — about €2,050 in total — and, in a paired notice, accepted 680 stock options in the company's 2026A programme at a price of zero .

Put the purchase in perspective before reading anything into it: 680 shares against roughly 8.2 million outstanding is about 0.008% of the company. And the option rights are the giveaway that this is plan mechanics, not conviction. The options were issued under the SiiliX Share employee savings plan the board reauthorized in December , under which employees buy shares with their own savings and receive exchangeable options as a match . The subscription price for the 2026A options was set at €3.68 against a share price around €2.98 — a strike sitting above the market, with the subscription window not even opening until August 2028. Niiniharju filed the same category of notice a year earlier, in August 2025 . This is an annual, automatic, immaterial event, not a person quietly backing their own judgment with fresh money.

Which is convenient, because the factor story is the part of this stock that actually reprices.

Siili is a Helsinki-listed digital-consulting firm worth roughly €25–27 million — AI-powered software development , data and managed services, about a quarter of revenue international. The report card coming into this year: revenue of €122.7 million in 2023, €111.9 million in 2024, €108.1 million in 2025 — organic growth negative in both of the last two years. EBIT margin fell from 3.0% in 2024 to 0.1% in 2025 , then went through the floor in the first half of 2026: revenue down 13.0% to €50.1 million, EBIT of −€1.8 million (−3.6% of revenue), adjusted EBITA of −€0.4 million (−0.7%), and EPS of −€0.30 . Guidance has been a one-way street — the year began pointed at €102–126 million of revenue and €3.7–6.9 million of adjusted EBITA , and on 6 August management cut both to €95–105 million and €0.5–3.3 million . A December profit alert, citing postponed customer decisions and an accounting correction , had already sheared the 2025 number. Management is shrinking the cost base — headcount down to 823 from 900 a year earlier , temporary layoffs in June — and the CEO departed in May, with an interim in place and a permanent search under way.

Now the comparison set, because no factor grade means anything in isolation. Siili's nearest listed neighbors in the same Nordic IT-services pond are Gofore and Netcompany, with Digia a step further out. Gofore, the closest comp — same country, same pure-play consulting niche — put up an 8.8% adjusted EBITA margin for 2025 and finished the year at 14.0% in the fourth quarter while its organic slide flattened. Netcompany grew organically 7.9% for 2025 at an adjusted EBITDA margin near 18% . Digia is expected to hold near-flat revenue at a margin around 9% . Against that set, Siili's grades write themselves:

My framework has one question that decides what a stock like this is for: is the report card improving or eroding? Siili's is eroding on every factor that matters — growth, profitability, revisions, and momentum all point down against the peer set — and the €2,050 insider buy changes none of that, because it was never a discretionary bet. The disciplined read is that this has no place in a growth sleeve and no reason to be bought on the insider tick alone. It earns a place only on a watch list, and the trigger that moves it off that list is observable rather than hopeful: revenue stabilizing (management said it saw signs late in the second quarter), adjusted EBITA recovering into the positive H2 it has guided to, net debt-to-EBITDA coming back toward the below-2 target from its current 2.79 versus 0.45 a year earlier, and a permanent CEO named. If those numbers start inverting, this becomes a genuinely interesting, small, sector-relative turnaround — precisely because the insider column is empty and everything rides on the factors. Until then, this week's disclosure deserves exactly the attention it earns: a glance.

evidence.text:
Siili Solutions Plc establishes a new share-based incentive plan for key employees

Siili Solutions Plc establishes a new share-based incentive plan for key employees

Siili Solutions Oyj Stock Exchange Release 29 January 2026 at 16:45 EET

The Board of Directors of Siili Solutions Plc has resolved to establish a new share-based incentive plan for key employees of the group. The purpose of the plan is to align the interests of the company’s shareholders and key employees to increase the company’s value in the long-term, to commit key employees to implement the company's strategy, objectives and long-term interest and to offer them a competitive incentive plan based on earning and accumulating the company’s shares. The plan will continue the share-based incentive plan 2023-2027 for key employees.

The Performance Share Plan 2026-2030 consists of three performance periods, covering the financial years 2026-2028, 2027-2029 and 2028-2030 respectively. The Board of Directors will resolve annually on the commencement and details of a performance period.

In the plan, the target group has an opportunity to earn Siili Solutions Plc’s shares based on performance. The potential rewards from the plan will be paid within five months after the end of each performance period.

The target group in the performance period 2026-2028 consists of approximately 60 key employees, including the members of the Management Team and the CEO. The performance criteria of the performance period 2026-2028 are tied to the revenue and EBITA of 2026 and the development of shareholder value 2026-2028. Payment of the rewards is also conditional to achieving a threshold level for net income of 2026 set by the Board.

The value of the rewards to be paid on the basis of the plan corresponds to a maximum total of 185,000 shares of Siili Solutions Plc, including also the proportion to be paid in cash. The potential rewards will be paid partly in Siili Solutions Plc’s shares and partly in cash. The cash proportion of the reward is intended to cover taxes and statutory social security contributions arising from the reward to the key employee. As a rule, no reward will be paid if the key employee’s employment or director contract terminates before the reward payment.

The Management Team members must hold all shares received from the plan, until the value of the Management Team member’s total shareholding in Siili Solutions Plc equals to 50 per cent of their annual base salary for the calendar year preceding the payment of the reward. This number of shares must be held as long as the membership in the Management Team continues.

evidence.title: Major cyber security incident disrupts Swedish retailer Dustin, takes systems offline
evidence.text:
Major cyber security incident disrupts Swedish retailer Dustin, takes systems offline

Swedish online technology retailer Dustin reported a major data security incident that forced several of its systems offline and disrupted its operations.

Headquartered in Nacka, Sweden, Dustin is a leading online IT solutions provider and reseller serving businesses, public-sector organisations, and consumers across the Nordic and Benelux markets. Dustin has evolved into a major e-commerce provider, offering around 280,000 technology products and services while helping businesses improve their IT infrastructure and digital operations.

In a data security incident notice on its website, Dustin said that it recently identified unauthorised access within its internal network. The IT solutions provider immediately launched an investigation, with assistance from external cyber security experts, to determine the nature and scope of the incident.

It also took steps to contain the incident, secure the affected network and notified relevant law enforcement authorities about the same.

“The incident is considered serious and measures have been taken to limit the effects of the incident, including a temporary shutdown of certain systems,” Dustin said.

Dustin said its investigation into the incident remains ongoing, and the company has not yet determined what data may have been compromised. It is working with leading IT security and forensic experts to assess the potential impact. The system shutdown also disrupted the company’s ability to place and receive orders.

The IT solutions provider has submitted an initial notification regarding the potential personal data breach to Sweden’s data protection authority and reported the incident to the relevant government authorities.

“We are working intensively together with external experts to investigate the cause and extent of the incident. In parallel, we are working hard to safely re-open all systems,” Dustin added.

In a recent update, Dustin Group said it has started the phased restoration of affected systems, following a controlled and secure approach aimed at minimising customer disruption. The company added its complete order process is now operational, enabling customers to submit orders via phone and email. evidence.title: 'Stranger Things' finale: Dustin's speech had a poignant nod to Eddie Munson you may have missed
evidence.text:
Now that the dust has settled on the Stranger Things finale — which had more than a few fans up in arms — we're beginning to see a fair few Easter eggs and theories emerge.

A lot of these concern the fate of Eleven (Millie Bobby Brown) — did you spot that book shelf clue in the final scene, for instance? — but there's also a poignant throwback in the final epilogue that you may have missed.

We're talking about the Hawkins High School graduation speech made by Dustin (Gaten Matarazzo), who took over the ceremony with a rousing tirade against the system that had his fellow students cheering and Principal Higgins (Bill Winkler) scrambling for the mic.

The thing is, Dustin's speech wasn't quite as out-of-the-blue as it may have seemed. It was actually a poignant throwback to Eddie Munson (Joseph Quinn), the leader of the Hellfire Club, who died to save Dustin and his friends in the Upside Down in Season 4 .

How does Dustin's graduation speech pay tribute to Eddie?

"Screw the school, screw the system, screw conformity, screw everyone and everything trying to hold you back and tear us apart because this, this is our year!" screams Dustin at the end of his grad speech, before dropping the microphone, grabbing his diploma from Higgins, and flipping off the exasperated principal.

Dustin's actions are pretty much a play-by-play re-enactment of what Eddie says he's going to do when he graduates from Hawkins High, back in the Season 4 scene where we first meet his character.

"I'm gonna walk that stage next month, I'm gonna look Principal Higgins dead in the eye, I'm gonna flip him the bird, I'm gonna snatch that diploma and I'm gonna run like hell outta here," yells Eddie, striding around the school cafeteria as his D&D crew, including Dustin and Mike (Finn Wolfhard), laugh in admiration.

Clearly, his words stuck with Dustin. And given that Dustin is still grieving Eddie throughout Season 5, the graduation speech is really a tribute to his friend's memory.

evidence.title: Dustin & Suzie’s Fate in Stranger Things Season 5 Revealed
evidence.text:
The conclusion of Stranger Things has prompted renewed discussion around status of Dustin Henderson 's long-distance relationship with Suzie . The Season 5 finale does not directly address their romance on-screen. However, Gaten Matarazzo has provided a clearer picture of Dustin's love story.

Gaten Matarazzo on if Dustin and Suzie broke up in Stranger Things

Gaten Matarazzo recently addressed speculation surrounding Dustin Henderson's relationship with Suzie following the Stranger Things series finale.

The Netflix series concluded on December 31, 2025, providing closure for most of its core characters. While Dustin is shown moving forward after the events of the finale, the absence of Suzie raised questions among fans.

In an interview with Business Insider , Matarazzo revealed that there was no explicit discussion with creators Matt and Ross Duffer regarding the fate of Dustin and Suzie's relationship. However, the actor shared his personal interpretation.

He said, "I think, unfortunately, what can be assumed is that in Dustin's yearlong unhealthy grieving process — I mean, if he's cutting out the friends that are day-to-day spending time with him, you can imagine he probably cut out a long-distance relationship."

Matarazzo also offered a candid reflection on Dustin's behavior and how he believes the breakup may have happened. He said, "I would like to think he did so nicely. I don't think he did so nicely, because he wasn't very nice at that point in his life." The breakup is not explicitly shown on screen. However, Matarazzo said he personally believes Suzie may have been the one to end things.

The actor said, "Or maybe she was sick of his s—. Maybe she was just like, 'I'm not dealing with this.' And that would be very tremendously fair of her. So I can imagine she was like, 'I don't have time for any of this.' So I like to think she probably broke up with him." Matarazzo also expressed optimism about Dustin's future.

ECONOCOM company press release from 16/07/2026 - UGAP SELECTS ECONOCOM EXAPROBE FOR ITS NETWORK CYBERSECURITY AND ASSOCIATED SERVICES OFFERING

Econocom Group announces that Econocom Exaprobe has been selected by UGAP, France's leading public procurement agency, under its cybersecurity framework agreement for the provision of network security solutions and associated services. Effective from 16 July 2026 for an initial three-year term, the agreement gives UGAP's 20,000 public-sector customers, including local authorities, government agencies, public institutions, and healthcare and social care organisations, access to Econocom Exaprobe's network cybersecurity solutions and related expertise.

Angel Benguigui, CEO of Econocom, said : " At a time when cyber threats are growing in scale and sophistication, and digital sovereignty is rising up the public agenda, cybersecurity has become a critical strategic priority for public sector organisations. Econocom Exaprobe's selection by UGAP is a strong endorsement of our expertise and our ability to support public institutions in meeting their most complex cybersecurity challenges »

A comprehensive ecosystem of complementary solutions for end-to-end protection

The UGAP contract covers the entire operational spectrum of network cybersecurity: solution supply, integration, deployment, operation, monitoring, and architecture security support. Through this agreement, Econocom Exaprobe strengthens its role as a trusted cybersecurity partner for public sector organisations, helping them secure critical network infrastructure and communications.

The offering deployed by Econocom Exaprobe is built on an ecosystem of leading technological capabilities , selected for their complementary capabilities and comprehensive coverage of protection, monitoring and infrastructure security requirements.

For network segmentation and advanced protection, the offering includes next-generation firewall solutions from Cisco , Fortinet , and Stormshield . The latter also provides equipment suited to Restricted Distribution level environments and architectures.

Advanced threat detection is provided by Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions from French vendor Gatewatcher .

Access security for services and applications is covered by F5 solutions through Load Balancing, Reverse Proxy (WAF), and SSL VPN access modules.

Addressing service reliability is based on DNS, DHCP, and IPAM solutions from EfficientIP .

For secure internet browsing, the offering relies on Next-Gen Secure Web Gateway solutions from Fortinet .

Finally, sensitive data and communications protection is ensured by encryption solutions from Eviden .

Addressing the public sector's cyber emergency through proven expertise

In a context marked by intensifying cyber threats and organizations' growing dependence on information systems, securing network infrastructure has become a strategic imperative for the public sector.

With over 20 years of experience integrating complex solutions for critical environments, Econocom Exaprobe relies on 220 specialized consultants and engineers across six sites in France. Certified ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001, and ITIL, the company is committed to continuously improving its practices, particularly in security, infrastructure resilience, and eco-design.

Alexandre Murati, Managing Director of Econocom Exaprobe, said: "Econocom Exaprobe's teams, alongside their technology partners, are proud to bring their expertise to protecting public sector infrastructure. In an ever-evolving threat environment, cybersecurity is more than ever a structuring challenge, at the intersection of digital sovereignty, operationalresilience, and trust in public services."

It provides a broad range of solutions and services that can be accessed directly by local authorities, government agencies, hospitals and healthcare organisations. UGAP manages the entire procurement process on behalf of its customers, from tendering and supplier selection to contract management, invoicing, delivery and dispute resolution, ensuring a streamlined and compliant purchasing experience. As a key driver of responsible public procurement policies, UGAP is recognised for its measurable commitment to environmental and social responsibility. In 2025, environmental criteria were included in 100% of its contracts, while 73% incorporated social impact provisions. Nearly 68% of its suppliers* are SMEs, and 96.4% of contracted suppliers are based in France. Since 2013, UGAP has held the "Responsible Supplier Relations and Procurement" label, recognising its commitment to sustainable purchasing practices. evidence.title: Cegeka wordt soevereiniteitspartner van Microsoft in Brussel
evidence.text:
Itdaily - Cegeka wordt soevereiniteitspartner van Microsoft in Brussel

Cegeka wordt soevereiniteitspartner van de Microsoft Innovation Hub in Brussel. Samen begeleiden beide bedrijven organisaties van een soevereiniteitsstrategie tot de dagelijkse werking van cloudomgevingen, met aandacht voor data, infrastructuur, applicaties en veranderende regelgeving.

Digitale soevereiniteit staat steeds hoger op de agenda door Europese regelgeving en bezorgdheid over afhankelijkheden. Vooral organisaties in financiën, gezondheidszorg en de overheid zoeken naar een aanpak die per workload bepaalt hoeveel controle nodig is. Cegeka kondigt aan dat het de soevereiniteitspartner wordt van Microsoft in zijn Innovation Hub in Brussel. Microsodt huldigde eind 2025 de eerste Belgische Azure-regio in.

Tussen de publieke hyperscaler en de server in de eigen kelder ligt een heel spe…

Cegeka en Microsoft willen organisaties helpen om risico’s en vereisten per workload te beoordelen. Een corebankingsysteem heeft bijvoorbeeld niet dezelfde bescherming nodig als een publieke website. Overal maximale controle invoeren kost flexibiliteit en budget, terwijl te weinig bescherming voor een kritiek systeem risico’s creëert voor compliance en continuïteit.

In de Innovation Hub werken klanten met specialisten van beide bedrijven aan hun eigen situatie. Microsoft brengt kennis over het platform, de producten en het beleid. Cegeka vertaalt die input naar architectuur, beveiliging, governance en dagelijks beheer.

Het traject start met een quick-scan workshop rond een beperkt aantal workloads. Organisaties krijgen zo zicht op prioriteiten, risico’s en een mogelijke architectuurrichting. Voor concrete projecten volgt een Sovereignty Assessment van Cegeka, die uitmondt in een roadmap.

Die roadmap kan Cegeka omzetten in een proof of concept. Daarna is ook volledig operationeel beheer mogelijk, zelfstandig of samen met de eigen teams van de klant. Monitoring en rapportering moeten aantonen dat de afgesproken controles werken en ondersteunen organisaties bij hun compliance, ook wanneer regels wijzigen.

Cegeka ondersteunt het volledige Sovereign Cloud Continuum-portfolio van Microsoft. Dat omvat Sovereign Public Cloud, Azure Local in verbonden of niet-verbonden vorm en een private cloudomgeving voor organisaties met strikte vereisten rond datalocatie, toegang en operationele controle.

Microsoft kiest Cegeka wegens expertise in soevereiniteit, cybersecurity, datacenterinfrastructuur en bedrijfskritieke omgevingen. Cegeka beheert eigen infrastructuur in Europa en levert rechtstreeks publieke en hybride cloudservices, waardoor klanten advies, implementatie en beheer bij één partner kunnen onderbrengen. Met een lokale partner aan boord, krijgen Microsofts claims over soevereiniteit ook echt betekenis.

Microsoft bundelt zijn soevereiniteitsaanbod onder de noemer Microsoft Sovereign…

Cegeka ontwikkelde daarnaast een soevereiniteitsdashboard voor Microsoft-omgevingen. Dat toont waar workloads draaien en signaleert nieuwe soevereiniteitsrisico’s wanneer de omgeving verandert. Zo krijgen klanten een voortdurend beeld in plaats van enkel een eenmalige beoordeling.

De samenwerking moet organisaties helpen om controle af te stemmen op hun risico’s zonder innovatie volledig af te remmen. Welke cloudvorm uiteindelijk geschikt is, hangt af van de workload, de regelgeving en de vereisten rond operationele controle.

Met de Innovation Hub koppelen Microsoft en Cegeka strategie, technologie en beheer. Organisaties kunnen starten met een beperkte analyse en doorgroeien naar een beheerde omgeving met rapportering over de toegepaste controles.

Volgens Gartner overweegt de helft van enterpriseklanten te vertrekken uit VMware tegen 2029. Alternatieven staa…

evidence.title: Cegeka acquisisce 3Point e consolida la posizione nei settori difesa, intelligence e sicurezza critica
evidence.text:
Questa acquisizione rappresenta un importante passo avanti nella strategia di Cegeka , uno dei principali player europei nei servizi IT e cloud, volta a consolidare una posizione di leadership nei settori della difesa, dell’intelligence e delle infrastrutture critiche. Unendo la profonda competenza e la consolidata esperienza di 3Point in ambienti ad alta riservatezza alle dimensioni e alla capacità operativa di Cegeka, l’azienda sta rafforzando in modo significativo la propria capacità di supportare questi settori nell’affrontare sfide sempre più complesse e mission-critical.

Rafforzare la posizione di Cegeka nei settori della difesa e degli ambienti ad alta sicurezza

Koen Deryckere , ceo di Cegeka, ha dichiarato: “Questa acquisizione segna un’importante pietra miliare nella nostra strategia. Stiamo consolidando la nostra leadership nei settori della difesa, dell’intelligence e degli ambienti ad alta riservatezza. La sicurezza e la sovranità dell’Europa dipendono sempre più da un’infrastruttura digitale resiliente e da partner affidabili in grado di proteggerla. Con 3Point, stiamo consolidando la posizione di Cegeka come partner a lungo termine per i settori della difesa, dell’intelligence e della sicurezza pubblica, proprio in quegli ambienti in cui la fiducia e la discrezione sono fondamentali».

Lorenzo Greco , amministratore delegato di Cegeka Italia, ha dichiarato: «Anche per il mercato italiano questa acquisizione rappresenta un’importante opportunità di crescita. In un contesto in cui cybersecurity, resilienza delle infrastrutture critiche e trasformazione digitale sono sempre più strategiche, è fondamentale poter contare su competenze altamente specializzate. L’integrazione con 3Point rafforza ulteriormente la nostra capacità di affiancare clienti pubblici e privati con soluzioni avanzate per la protezione degli asset critici e la realizzazione di progetti complessi, contribuendo a rafforzarne sicurezza, resilienza e sovranità digitale».

3Point, che ha sede ad Anversa, fornisce servizi di consulenza e servizi basati su progetti nell’ambito dell’architettura di sicurezza, delle operazioni di difesa informatica e delle soluzioni IT personalizzate. L’azienda ha inoltre sviluppato soluzioni proprietarie di monitoraggio delle minacce, come Pointguard, che supportano le aziende nella protezione delle loro infrastrutture e operazioni critiche. La soluzione Pointguard di 3Point rafforzerà ulteriormente le capacità di Cegeka nel monitoraggio preventivo delle minacce. Nel panorama odierno, in cui le minacce alla sicurezza informatica sono sempre più amplificate dall’uso dell’intelligenza artificiale, disporre di informazioni complete e aggiornate sui potenziali vettori di attacco è fondamentale. Pointguard consente un monitoraggio avanzato, che include l’analisi del dark web e la ricerca delle minacce, permettendo alle aziende di rilevare e rispondere in modo proattivo alle minacce informatiche fin dalla fase iniziale.

Esperienza e dimensioni per rispondere alla crescente domanda

3Point si è costruita una solida reputazione nell’ecosistema belga della difesa e della sicurezza pubblica, operando in ambienti altamente sensibili e riservati e sostenendo iniziative nazionali di primaria importanza. Con questa acquisizione, Cegeka ottiene accesso immediato a competenze specialistiche, personale in possesso di autorizzazioni di sicurezza e una profonda conoscenza ed esperienza nei settori della difesa e della sicurezza pubblica. Allo stesso tempo, 3Point trarrà vantaggio dalla portata, dalla struttura operativa e dalla presenza internazionale di Cegeka per accelerare ulteriormente la propria crescita.

Questa combinazione consentirà a entrambe le società di rispondere meglio alla crescente domanda di progetti IT e di sicurezza informatica su larga scala e ad alta sicurezza, trainata dai maggiori investimenti nella difesa e nelle infrastrutture critiche.

Potenziare le competenze nei settori della difesa, dell’intelligence e dello spazio

A seguito dell’operazione, 3Point lavorerà a fianco di Cegeka per espandere ulteriormente le proprie attività nei settori della Difesa, dell’Intelligence e dello Spazio. I team uniti si concentreranno sulla realizzazione di programmi complessi e altamente riservati e sul supporto a governi e aziende nella tutela delle loro operazioni più critiche.

Paul Meys , cofondatore di 3Point: «Questo rappresenta un passo importante nella prossima fase di crescita di 3Point. Unendo le forze con un partner come Cegeka, acquisiamo la portata, la presenza sul mercato e le competenze complementari necessarie per sviluppare ulteriormente il nostro know-how e supportare programmi più ampi e complessi in ambienti critici. Rimaniamo pienamente impegnati a mantenere gli stessi elevati standard di qualità, indipendenza e stretta collaborazione che i nostri clienti si aspettano da noi, creando al contempo nuove opportunità di crescita per il nostro personale e la nostra azienda nell’ambito di una piattaforma internazionale più ampia».

Stijn Haemhouts , cofondatore di 3Point: «Per i nostri clienti, questa fusione rafforza la nostra capacità di fornire un supporto end-to-end, preservando al contempo l’approccio affidabile e specialistico che da sempre contraddistingue 3Point. Il nostro lavoro si svolge spesso in contesti in cui affidabilità, sicurezza e profonda competenza settoriale sono essenziali, e tali principi rimarranno al centro del nostro modo di operare. Con Cegeka, saremo in grado di ampliare la nostra offerta, accedere a ulteriori competenze e continuare a supportare i nostri clienti con lo stesso impegno e la stessa vicinanza, ora sostenuti dalla forza di un gruppo internazionale più ampio».

evidence.title: Ict, Cegeka Group chiude il 2025 a 1,28 mld (-2,3%): Ebitda a 118,4 mln euro e nuovo ceo per rilanciare la crescita nel 2026
evidence.text:
Cegeka Group ha diffuso oggi i dati relativi al fatturato consolidato dell’intero esercizio 2025, pari a 1,28 miliardi di euro , sostanzialmente stabile rispetto al 2024, in un mercato Ict caratterizzato da incertezze geopolitiche, cicli decisionali dei clienti più lunghi e una spesa contenuta. La generazione di liquidità è rimasta solida e la solidità finanziaria di fondo è stata preservata. Nel corso dell’anno, il gruppo ha completato una serie di misure strutturali che dovrebbero portare benefici duraturi, ha rafforzato il proprio consiglio di Amministrazione e ha preparato la sua prossima fase di crescita sotto la guida del nuovo ceo Koen Deryckere , che ha assunto l’ incarico il 1° maggio 2026 .

La tecnologia digitale non è mai stata così centrale nel modo in cui le organizzazioni operano, competono e servono la società. L’intelligenza artificiale, la resilienza informatica e la gestione sovrana dei dati e dei sistemi critici sono passate dall’agenda IT al centro delle priorità dei consigli d’amministrazione in tutti i settori industriali, nei servizi finanziari, nella sanità, nel governo e nel settore pubblico. In tale contesto, il ruolo di Cegeka come partner tecnologico di fiducia a lungo termine per oltre 2.500 clienti in tre continenti non è mai stato così importante.

Il 2025 è stato un anno di transizione per Cegeka e la direzione ha scelto di concentrarsi su questo processo piuttosto che inseguire risultati a breve termine. Il fatturato è rimasto sostanzialmente stabile a 1,28 miliardi di euro – con una contrazione del 2,3% rispetto al 2024 – a dimostrazione della solidità della domanda per le attività principali del gruppo in un mercato cauto. L ’Ebitda è stato pari a 118,4 milioni di euro, rispetto ai 130,4 milioni di euro dell’anno precedente, con un Ebit rettificato (Ifrs) di 59 milioni di euro, contro i 74 milioni di euro. L’andamento della redditività riflette la cautela nella spesa dei clienti, i costi delle misure strutturali attuate nel corso dell’anno e una performance temporaneamente inferiore alle aspettative in diverse aree geografiche, che ora stanno tornando a stabilizzarsi. È importante sottolineare che la generazione di liquidità del gruppo è rimasta solida per tutto l’anno, a conferma della capacità di investimento e di un bilancio solido.

«In un mercato difficile, Cegeka ha registrato ricavi stabili, portando a termine al contempo una serie di misure strutturali i cui benefici si concretizzeranno nei prossimi anni. Affrontiamo il 2026 con una solida base finanziaria e un modello operativo più chiaro su cui continuare a costruire» afferma Stephan Daems , cfo di Cegeka Group.

Panoramica regionale: stabilizzazione in corso in tutte le aree geografiche

I risultati hanno registrato andamenti diversi all’interno del gruppo. Il Belgio e i Paesi Bassi – i mercati principali di Cegeka – hanno mantenuto un andamento sostanzialmente in linea con quello del settore europeo dei servizi Ict nel suo complesso, con cicli di vendita più lunghi che hanno pesato sulla crescita piuttosto che sulla posizione competitiva. L’Italia ha registrato un progressivo miglioramento nel corso dell’anno, tornando a una performance operativa positiva nel quarto trimestre. Negli Stati Uniti – pilastro importante del gruppo insieme alla sua presenza in Europa – i risultati sono passati da un utile a una perdita; l’acquisizione di nuovi clienti e l’accelerazione delle consegne nel quarto trimestre indicano una traiettoria di ripresa.

Nessuna di queste dinamiche è considerata strutturale. Entro la fine dell’anno si sono manifestati i primi segnali di stabilizzazione in tutto il perimetro operativo e il gruppo ha iniziato il 2026 con un portafoglio ordini più solido e una struttura operativa più snella.

Un’organizzazione più efficiente, grazie ai miglioramenti apportati dal nostro personale

Nel corso del 2025 Cegeka ha portato a termine una serie di iniziative di integrazione, semplificazione e ottimizzazione delle prestazioni a livello di gruppo. Le strutture dei team sono state snellite, l’eccellenza nell’erogazione dei servizi è stata rafforzata e il portafoglio è stato concentrato sulle attività con il maggior valore per il cliente e il potenziale a lungo termine. Si prevede che i benefici di queste misure si concretizzeranno progressivamente a partire dal 2026.

«Le decisioni di miglioramento che abbiamo preso insieme nel 2025 ci hanno resi più agili, ancora più collaborativi e meglio attrezzati per assistere i nostri clienti dove conta di più. I nostri collaboratori hanno portato avanti questa transizione con professionalità e impegno, e sono loro la ragione per cui entriamo nel 2026 con sincera fiducia» , aggiunge Bart Watteeuw , coo di Cegeka Group.

Il gruppo ha inoltre rafforzato la propria struttura di governance. Nel corso dell’anno il Consiglio di Amministrazione è stato potenziato e, il 1° maggio 2026, Koen Deryckere ha assunto la carica di chief executive officer, conferendo una leadership chiara alla prossima fase di crescita di Cegeka . Il nuovo ceo si baserà sulla cultura distintiva del gruppo, caratterizzata da spirito imprenditoriale, competenza professionale e attenzione al cliente.

La tecnologia non è mai stata così importante per i clienti di Cegeka

Il difficile contesto macroeconomico del 2025 non deve far passare in secondo piano il profondo cambiamento in atto in tutti i settori in cui Cegeka opera. Per le aziende dell’industria, dei servizi finanziari, della sanità, della difesa, dell’energia, della pubblica amministrazione e del settore pubblico, la tecnologia non è più una funzione di supporto , ma un presupposto fondamentale per la competitività, la resilienza e la fiducia. L’intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo in cui si lavora e si crea valore. La sicurezza informatica è diventata una questione di continuità operativa e di fiducia pubblica. E la questione della sovranità – sui dati, sui sistemi critici e sulla gestione della tecnologia stessa – è entrata a pieno titolo nell’agenda strategica sia dei consigli di amministrazione che dei governi.

Ciò è particolarmente vero ora che le organizzazioni stanno entrando nell’era dell’intelligenza artificiale, dove il vero valore sta nel combinare una maggiore potenza di calcolo con una gestione dei dati solida e sicura, per trasformare le opportunità nei loro settori di attività principali in casi d’uso concreti e in grado di creare valore. È in questo contesto che Cegeka ha consolidato la propria posizione per oltre trent’anni, lavorando fianco a fianco con i propri clienti in Europa e negli Stati Uniti come partner di fiducia impegnato a lungo termine. L’ambizione del gruppo per gli anni a venire è quella di rafforzare questo ruolo: aiutare le organizzazioni a trasformare il cambiamento tecnologico in un vantaggio duraturo, a condizioni affidabili.

Prospettive per il 2026: partire da fondamenta solide

Cegeka affronta il 2026 con fiducia. Il modello operativo è stato adeguato alle attuali condizioni di mercato, la struttura dei costi è stata ottimizzata, la solidità finanziaria è stata preservata e la direzione strategica del gruppo è chiara. Le misure adottate nel 2025 sono state concepite per anticipare i tempi piuttosto che rincorrerli, e il management prevede un progressivo ritorno alla crescita nel corso dell’anno, con un miglioramento dei margini nel 2026 e nel 2027 man mano che i benefici strutturali si concretizzeranno.

Sotto la guida del nuovo amministratore delegato Koen Deryckere, Cegeka continuerà a investire nei settori in cui la domanda dei clienti è più solida e in cui il gruppo si distingue maggiormente. Tra i principali ambiti strategici figurano, tra gli altri:

La nuova leadership avrà modo di definire e perfezionare ulteriormente le priorità strategiche del gruppo nel prossimo futuro.

«Cegeka si è evoluta nel corso di oltre trent’anni sulla base di una semplice convinzione: shaping digital together, al fianco dei nostri clienti, in una prospettiva di lungo termine. Questa convinzione è oggi più attuale che mai. Il 2025 ci ha fornito una solida base; il 2026 è l’anno in cui costruiremo su di essa – e continueremo a spingere Cegeka ad evolversi e trasformarsi in un settore in rapida evoluzione. I nostri team sono entusiasti, pienamente concentrati, impegnati e pronti per il futuro – e lo sono anch’io» , sottolinea Koen Deryckere, ceo di Cegeka Group.

«Anche in Italia il 2025 è stato un anno di scelte deliberate e coraggiose: abbiamo rafforzato le fondamenta puntando sulla qualità dei nostri servizi e sulla relazione con i clienti e partner. Con l’arrivo di Koen Deryckere si apre una nuova fase. In un contesto guidato da Intelligenza Artificiale, cyber resilience e sovranità digitale , Cegeka vuole guidare il cambiamento. In Italia siamo pronti a trasformare questa ambizione in risultati ed impatti concreti per i nostri clienti» , evidenzia Lorenzo Greco, managing director di Cegeka Italia.

Un messaggio ai nostri collaboratori, clienti e partner

I progressi compiuti nel 2025 sono stati, prima di tutto, il frutto del lavoro degli oltre 9.000 collaboratori di Cegeka in Europa, negli Stati Uniti e nel resto del mondo. Il loro impegno, la loro competenza e la loro professionalità hanno permesso al gruppo di superare un anno impegnativo e di gettare le basi su cui si aprirà il prossimo capitolo. A loro, e agli oltre 2.500 clienti e partner che hanno continuato a camminare insieme a Cegeka in un anno di cautela per il settore, il gruppo rivolge i suoi più sinceri ringraziamenti.

evidence.title: Cyber Resilience at a Glance: Cegeka Launches Cyber Resilience Dashboard
evidence.text:
Cyber Resilience at a Glance: Cegeka Launches Cyber Resilience Dashboard

Cybersecurity is higher on the agenda of organizations today than ever before. Geopolitical tensions, stricter regulations, and a more complex threat landscape have made cyber resilience a strategic theme. Yet many companies struggle with the same question: where do we stand today and how can we concretely demonstrate that we are making progress?

During the RSA Conference , the world's largest cybersecurity fair in San Francisco, Cegeka launches a cyber resilience dashboard as part of the Cegeka Security Advisory Framework (CSAF) . This framework combines assessments and advice in a modular approach that supports organizations in continuously improving their security strategy. The new dashboard translates those insights into a clear cyber resilience score and provides a snapshot of risks, priorities, and the impact of measures taken.

CISOs recognize the problem: they need to convince their boards of necessary investments but often lack the right language and numbers to have that conversation. Questions like 'How well are we doing?', 'Where are the biggest risks?' or 'Are we better protected than last year?' remain difficult to answer objectively. Without clear numbers, the debate remains based on gut feeling, and that is not enough. 'Cybersecurity has finally become a boardroom topic, but discussions often remain too abstract,' says Fabrice Wynants, Global VP Cybersecurity & Networking at Cegeka. 'Executives want to know where the organization stands, what actions are needed, and whether those actions actually contribute to higher cyber resilience. You can only demonstrate that with clear and consistent data.'

Also read: The Brand-Driven Chatbot as a Digital Front Office

The new dashboard consolidates the results of various security assessments into one overview. Organizations gain insights into their cyber resilience score, the maturity of individual security domains, and the progress of their security roadmap. The results are automatically linked to internationally recognized cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS, as well as relevant cybersecurity regulations. This allows organizations to objectively benchmark their current situation and invest more strategically in the right cybersecurity measures. According to Bart Van den Branden, Head of Product Management Security at Cegeka, the real added value lies in tracking evolution over the years. 'It's not about one absolute score,' he emphasizes. 'It's about the progress you make. CISOs need to be able to demonstrate that they are making the right choices, that their approach works, and that the organization is becoming more resilient step by step.' By making scores and trends visible over time, the dashboard supports that conversation with management in a concrete and substantiated way.

Also read: 10 Mobile Security Tips for Your Smartphone

Cegeka has long advocated for a shift from classic cybersecurity to full-fledged end-to-end cyber resilience. Protection is and remains priority number 1, but organizations must also be resilient enough to remain operational when something goes wrong: absorbing incidents, minimizing impact, and recovering quickly and in a controlled manner. This end-to-end approach to cyber resilience is at the core of the Cegeka Security Advisory Framework and the new dashboard. 'Organizations know they need to improve, but often lack an overview,' says Wynants. 'With this dashboard and scoring, we provide CISOs with a compass to measure and strengthen their cyber resilience step by step.'
