Barista
evidence.text:
Café Leon Dore is building a team of dedicated Baristas to join the team in London, reporting directly to the Café Manager. Our Baristas will be responsible for running all front of house operations whilst delivering an exceptional guest experience.

Duties & Responsibilities

Perform opening and closing procedures of the cafe i.e. dialing in the espresso for the day, brewing coffee and tea, dusting and cleaning all display cases and ensuring storefront is up to standard

Showcase an excellent understanding of the menu, delivering food and beverages as per brand expectations

Maintain all café standards from opening to closing whilst adhering to relevant health and safety standards

Qualifications

Minimum 1 year experience as a Barista

Keen attention to detail

Demonstrates a passion for exceptional customer service and experience

Computer and till system experience

Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to multi-task in a busy environment

Flexible working hours

Created in 2014, Aimé Leon Dore is a lifestyle, sport and ready-to-wear brand based out of Queens, New York. With a strong focus on simple yet powerful design, we are driven to create timeless work by portraying an aesthetic that is uniquely our own

For more information, view our Candidate Privacy Policy

evidence.title: Sales Associate
evidence.text:
Aimé Leon Dore is seeking a pro-active Part Time Sales Associate to join the team in London, reporting directly to the Store Manager. The Sales Associate will exhibit a friendly and outgoing attitude whilst delivering a best-in-class customer experience as part of our first international Flagship store team.

Duties & Responsibilities

Deliver and maintain an outstanding level of customer service at all times

Maintain the stores’ visual identity within brand guidelines through merchandising and stock replenishment

Showcase excellent product and brand knowledge

Work purposefully as part of a team to ensure daily objectives and goals are met

Create a welcoming environment by greeting and interacting with customers, responding to queries regarding products and purchases.

Provide recommendations based on product knowledge inline customer needs and preferences.

Successfully operate till systems and transactions

Act as an Aimé Leon Dore Brand Ambassador

Qualifications

A minimum of 2 year’s experience in Retail

A proven record in delivering excellent customer service within a similar retail environment

Keen attention to detail

A pro-active and motivated individual with the ability to take initiative

Computer and till system literate

Strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills

Flexible working hours

Physical Requirements

Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. frequently and occasionally over 50 lbs

Ability to climb, squat, stoop, kneel, crouch, bend, twist, reach, lift, grasp, push and pull on a frequent basis

Ability to stand and/walk for the duration of a scheduled shift (at least 8 hours).

Ability to withstand exposure to varying temperatures, humidity, and other elements while performing certain job duties including but not limited to curbside, truck unload, etc.

For more information, view our Candidate Privacy Policy

evidence.title: Concierge Associate
evidence.text:
Aimé Leon Dore is looking for a polished, customer-focused Concierge Associate to serve as the first point of contact for guests, providing a personalized, seamless, and memorable experience. The ideal candidate will anticipate customer needs, offer tailored services, and support store operations while delivering the highest level of service.

Duties and Responsibilities

Hosting / Traffic Management

Greet and welcome all guests in a warm, professional, and engaging manner.

Manage the traffic of the retail space / occasionally checking in on the experience within Café Leon Dore.

Responsible for advising on opportunities to increase / manage traffic.

Manage the wait list and proactively communicate accurate waiting times.

Ensuring and gauging capacity levels are met within the store at all times — knowing and communicating when to decrease or increase traffic.

Be a Brand Ambassador for all things ALD, leaning into the styling and brand values.

Monitor store appearance and ensure the front-of-house environment is immaculate and welcoming.

Offer local knowledge, including nearby amenities, restaurants, and attractions.

Collect and relay customer feedback to improve service quality.

Taking accountability of when anything needs maintenance and retouching. This should be communicated to management immediately. (Planters broken, doors not locking, paint retouches, pest control, etc.)

Client Experience

Offer guests an enjoyable experience that conforms to the company’s standards of excellence, professionalism and friendliness.

Anticipate guest needs and tailor each interaction to deliver a personalized and memorable experience reflective of the brand.

Must be courteous and gracious, maintaining a professional and positive demeanor at all times,

Speak to standard Q&A regarding menus, hours of operation and amenity availability/pricing and comfortable reaching out for support to ensure all inquiries are addressed and in a timely manner.

Engaging in proper and positive communications with guests throughout greeting, seating, and departure experiences, and as otherwise may be needed.

Assisting with any customer return inquiries at the door with great hospitality and professionalism.

Monitor the outdoor environment including music levels, ensuring they reflect the Aimé Leon Dore brand experience while remaining compliant with local council requirements and considerate of the surrounding community.

Community

Build relationships with members, F&F/VIP and guests and communicate any red flags and positive feedback to management to assess.

Being able to gauge potential VIP / F&F guest’s entry.

Assist VIP clientele with white-glove services such as personal shopping, gift wrapping, or delivery coordination.

Manage the wait list during any activations / brand partnership events, continuing to build on community and taking care of VIP / F&F attendees.

Physical Requirements:

Must be able to seize, grasp, turn and hold objects with hands.

Must be able to work on your feet for at least 8 hours.

Must be comfortable working at the storefront entrance in varying weather conditions throughout the year.

Must be able to work all operational hours.

Fast paced movements are required to go from one part of the space to others.

Must be able to move, pull, carry, or lift at least 18kg when required.

Occasionally kneel, bend, crouch as required.

evidence.text:
The mission of the LVMH group is to represent the most refined qualities of Western "Art de Vivre" around the world. Since its creation in 1987, LVMH has comprised a unique portfolio of over 70 prestigious brands. The Group is active in five different sectors: Wines & Spirits: the Group is the world leader in premium wines and spirits, with the help of prestigious brands such as Château d’Yquem, Dom Pérignon, Hennessy, Mercier, Moët & Chandon and Ruinart. Fashion & Leather goods: LVMH boasts an exceptional array of prestige fashion and leather goods brands, including Louis Vuitton, Marc Jacobs, Céline, Givenchy, Berluti and Kenzo. Perfumes & Cosmetics: with a unique portfolio that includes leading Houses and prestigious niche brands (Dior, Guerlain, Acqua di Parma, Loewe, Benefit Cosmetics…), LVMH is a major global player in perfumes and cosmetics for beauty care and makeup. Watches & Jewelry: this business group comprises upscale brands such as Bulgari, TAG Heuer, Chaumet and Hublot. Selective Retailing: the LVMH Selective Retailing sector covers the four corners of the world with Sephora, DFS, Franck et Fils, La Grande Épicerie, Le Bon Marché, Samaritaine and Starboard Cruise Services. In addition, LVMH is a key player in the media sector with Groupe Les Echos, overseeing several business, finance, arts and culture publications.

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités digitales, le groupe LVMH recherche un intégrateur HTML. Rattaché au Directeur des Systèmes d’informations, vous serez également en étroite relation avec :
- notre agence de design : vous en récupérerez le code HTML dont vous vous assurerez de la qualité du XHTML et de la comptabilité W3C. Vous assurerez également la structure du CSS et vous garantirez que la page HTML construite soit l’exacte réplique des éléments fournis par l’agence.
- l’équipe SEO afin d’en prendre toutes les recommandations.
- l’équipe de développement.
Vous garantissez également le niveau d’accessibilité demandé par le PO de l’équipe.

Vous avez une parfaite expertise d’HTML, XHTML, CSS3 et de très fortes connaissances en JavaScript orienté front, notamment React.JS. Des expériences passées solides en responsive et adaptative design sont également nécessaires.
Vous êtes autonome et êtes un très bon communiquant afin de pouvoir interagir avec toutes les parties prenantes et les coordonner.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Senior/Staff Software Engineer - AI Agents
evidence.text:
ABOUT MAXIMA

Nobody went into accounting to spend the first week of every month matching transactions by hand. Maxima was built so they don't have to. Our agents do the accounting work itself: journal entries, transaction matching, reconciliations, and flux analysis, continuously and with a full audit trail. Accountants review and approve. Nothing posts without a person signing off. We remove the grind, not the human.

Maxima is the agentic AI platform for enterprise accounting. Our three co-founders scaled finance at Rubrik from $5M ARR to a $15B NYSE IPO, built the reconciliation and billing systems behind Netflix's $32B in annual revenue, and built AI infrastructure serving two billion monthly users at Meta. We've raised $41M from Redpoint Ventures, Kleiner Perkins and Audacious Ventures, joined by former BlackLine executives and the CFOs of Rubrik and Vanta. To date we've processed more than $400B across 350M transactions at 100.00% accuracy, for customers including Scale AI, Rippling, Glean, Zendesk, Handshake, Zip, and Decagon.

We're early and moving fast. The playbook here gets written, not inherited, and the person closest to the work makes the call. We're looking for people who build from first principles and hold themselves accountable for what actually lands — people who'd rather build the category than join it. Everything you need to know is below.

THE ROLE

We are working on some of the hardest problems in enterprise automation, with an engineering team that includes staff-level talent from Robinhood, Glean, Google, Netflix, and Meta. The system handles high-volume financial data and complex accounting workflows, and every execution has to be accurate and reliable, because the output is a company's books.

As a Senior or Staff engineer on the AI Agents team, you will lead the building and scaling of the core agentic systems behind enterprise accounting automation: the agents that do the accounting work for our customers. You will own the full lifecycle of agent architecture, implementation, deployment, and optimization, and solve hard distributed systems and intelligent automation problems where software engineering, AI, and enterprise operations meet.

You will own mission-critical product and engineering areas, talk to customers regularly to understand what real-world requirements look like, and help drive the roadmap for the platform. We value engineers with strong technical foundations who show initiative, curiosity, and the ability to iterate quickly.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and evolve the agentic systems that perform and orchestrate complex accounting automation

- Scale the AI Agents platform to support large and rapidly growing enterprise workloads

- Architect durable, highly available, and scalable financial data processing layers to support the agents' work

- Build low-latency, extensible infrastructure for deploying and iterating on new agents

- Solve intricate enterprise accounting workflows through robust, composable abstractions

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Typically 5 or more years building backend systems at high-growth, high-scale technology companies

- Experience architecting, building, or maintaining AI agent harnesses and agentic platforms

- Strong familiarity with web development, relational databases, and distributed, data-intensive systems

- Ability to design, deploy, and iterate on scalable infrastructure and automation components for AI-driven workflows

- Deep interest in AI agent architectures, workflow engines, data pipelines, or mission-critical automation in domains like fintech or enterprise software

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, and an eagerness to work cross-functionally

WHERE AND HOW YOU'LL WORK

This role is based in our San Mateo office. We value in-person collaboration and are in office four to five days a week for our on-site roles.

WHY JOIN MAXIMA

- The work. Agentic accounting is a category being defined right now, and Maxima is one of the companies defining it. The product does the accounting work itself, so what you build, sell, or deploy shows up in a customer's books

- The people. Founders who ran the finance org at Rubrik and built the close systems at Twitter and Netflix. Engineers from Robinhood, Glean, Google, Netflix, and Meta. Controllers and accountants on the team who have closed books themselves. Small teams in San Mateo and Toronto that work in the same room, say what they think, and hold a high bar

- The benefits. Competitive salary, 401(k) for US employees, unlimited PTO, lunch in the office, and commuter benefits

- The process. A person reads every application, and we tell you where you stand at every stage

A note on AI

We build AI and we expect you to use it. Use it to research us and to prepare. In live conversations we want your own thinking in your own words, and if you use AI on a take-home exercise, tell us where it helped.

Equal opportunity

Maxima is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will arrange it.

ABOUT MAXIMA

Nobody went into accounting to spend the first week of every month matching transactions by hand. Maxima was built so they don't have to. Our agents do the accounting work itself: journal entries, transaction matching, reconciliations, and flux analysis, continuously and with a full audit trail. Accountants review and approve. Nothing posts without a person signing off. We remove the grind, not the human.

Maxima is the agentic AI platform for enterprise accounting. Our three co-founders scaled finance at Rubrik from $5M ARR to a $15B NYSE IPO, built the reconciliation and billing systems behind Netflix's $32B in annual revenue, and built AI infrastructure serving two billion monthly users at Meta. We've raised $41M from Redpoint Ventures, Kleiner Perkins and Audacious Ventures, joined by former BlackLine executives and the CFOs of Rubrik and Vanta. To date we've processed more than $400B across 350M transactions at 100.00% accuracy, for customers including Scale AI, Rippling, Glean, Zendesk, Handshake, Zip, and Decagon.

We're early and moving fast. The playbook here gets written, not inherited, and the person closest to the work makes the call. We're looking for people who build from first principles and hold themselves accountable for what actually lands — people who'd rather build the category than join it. Everything you need to know is below.

You will sit alongside Account Executives through complex deal cycles, run technical proofs of concept, and then build what each customer needs to launch: integrations to their transaction systems, custom modules, and prompt and model tuning so the AI performs the way their accounting requires. When something breaks in production, you are the one who fixes it.

This is engineering with a customer in the room. Communication matters as much as code.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work with Account Executives on complex deal cycles involving multiple stakeholders

- Run technical proof-of-concept processes and present tailored demos based on customer and business needs

- Lead technical discovery calls and write the implementation scoping document for each customer that launches with Maxima

- Tune prompts and models to get the right AI performance for each client

- Build integrations to transaction systems such as revenue, billing, and accounts payable, and the custom modules customers need to go live

- Partner with product and engineering to deliver on customer requests and advocate for customer needs

- Troubleshoot, debug, fix, and upgrade software for reliable performance in production, and support deployed solutions over time

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2 or more years in forward deployed engineering, sales engineering, implementation engineering, or solutions engineering

- Bachelor's degree in any engineering discipline; computer science preferred but not required

- Strong verbal and written communication skills and comfort working directly with customers

- Proficiency in languages such as Go, TypeScript, or Python

- Experience working with Account Executives on technical sales processes for enterprise customers

- Proactive, highly motivated, and able to handle the intensity and pace of a startup

Item 8.01.Other Events

On September 14, 2026, Medtronic plc, a public limited company organized under the laws of Ireland (“Medtronic”), commenced an offer to exchange (the “Exchange Offer”) up to 225,361,295 newly issued shares of common stock, par value $0.01 per share (“MiniMed Common Stock”), of MiniMed Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“MiniMed”), for outstanding ordinary shares of Medtronic, par value $0.0001 per share (“Medtronic Ordinary Shares”), upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in the Prospectus, dated as of September 14, 2026 (the “Prospectus”), which is included in the registration statement on Form S-4 (the “Registration Statement”) filed by MiniMed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended. If the Exchange Offer is oversubscribed, Medtronic currently intends to accept an additional number of Medtronic Ordinary Shares that are validly tendered and not validly withdrawn not to exceed two percent of the total outstanding Medtronic Ordinary Shares constituting all of Medtronic's remaining interest in MiniMed.

Following the commencement of the Exchange Offer, Medtronic discovered a typographical error in the description of guaranteed delivery procedures included in the Prospectus, which stated that an executed notice of guaranteed delivery would expire after 12:00 midnight, New York City time, at the end of the day on the second New York Stock Exchange (“NYSE”) trading day after the date of execution of such notice of guaranteed delivery.

Under the Exchange Offer’s guaranteed delivery procedures, the guaranteed delivery period applicable to an executed notice of guaranteed delivery will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on the second NYSE trading day after the date of execution of such notice of guaranteed delivery.

Medtronic is filing this Current Report on Form 8-K to correct the Prospectus as set forth below. For clarity, new text within restated disclosures from the Prospectus is highlighted with bold, underlined text, while deleted text is bold and stricken-through.

The information set forth in the Prospectus under the section entitled “The Exchange Offer—Procedures for Tendering—Guaranteed Delivery Procedures” is revised as set forth below:

“Guaranteed Delivery Procedures. If you wish to tender Medtronic Ordinary Shares pursuant to the Exchange Offer but (1) your certificates are not immediately available, (2) the procedure for book-entry tendering cannot be completed on a timely basis, or (3) time will not permit all required documents to reach the exchange agent on or before the expiration date of the Exchange Offer, you may still tender your Medtronic Ordinary Shares, so long as all of the following conditions are satisfied:

•you must make your tender by or through a U.S. eligible institution;

•on or before 12:00 midnight, New York City time, at the end of the day on the expiration date of the Exchange Offer, the exchange agent must receive a properly completed and duly executed notice of guaranteed delivery, substantially in the form made available by Medtronic, in the manner provided below; and

•by no later than 5:00 p.m. 12:00 midnight, New York City time, at the end of the day on the second NYSE trading day after the date of execution of such notice of guaranteed delivery, the exchange agent must receive (1) (A) share certificates representing all validly tendered Medtronic Ordinary Shares (other than Direct Registration Shares), in proper form for tendering or (B) with respect to shares delivered by book-entry tendering through DTC, confirmation of a book-entry tendering of those Medtronic Ordinary Shares into the exchange agent’s account at DTC, (2) a letter of transmittal for Medtronic Ordinary Shares, properly completed and duly executed (including any signature guarantees that may be required) or, in the case of shares delivered by book-entry tendering through DTC, an agent’s message, and (3) any other required documents.

Registered shareholders (including any participant in DTC whose name appears on a security position listing of DTC as the owner of Medtronic Ordinary Shares) may transmit the notice of guaranteed delivery by email transmission or mail it to the exchange agent. If you hold Medtronic Ordinary Shares through a broker, dealer, commercial bank, trust company, custodian, or similar institution, such institution must submit any notice of guaranteed delivery on your behalf. You must, in all cases, obtain a Medallion guarantee, in the form set forth in the notice of guaranteed delivery.”

Additional Information and Where to Find It

This Current Report on Form 8-K is not an offer to sell or exchange, a solicitation of an offer to buy or exchange any securities or a recommendation as to whether investors should participate in the Exchange Offer. MiniMed has filed with the SEC a Registration Statement on Form S-4 that includes a Prospectus. The Exchange Offer is made solely by the Prospectus. The Prospectus contains important information about the Exchange Offer, Medtronic, MiniMed and related matters, and Medtronic has delivered the Prospectus to holders of Medtronic Ordinary Shares. INVESTORS AND SECURITY HOLDERS ARE URGED TO READ THE PROSPECTUS, AND ANY OTHER RELEVANT DOCUMENTS FILED WITH THE SEC

BEFORE MAKING ANY INVESTMENT DECISION, BECAUSE THEY CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION. None of Medtronic, MiniMed or any of their respective directors or officers or the dealer managers appointed with respect to the Exchange Offer make any recommendation as to whether you should participate in the Exchange Offer.

Medtronic has filed with the SEC a Schedule TO, which contains important information about the Exchange Offer.

Holders of Medtronic Ordinary Shares may obtain copies of the Prospectus, the Registration Statement, the Schedule TO and other related documents, and any other information that Medtronic and MiniMed file electronically with the SEC free of charge at the SEC’s website at http://www.sec.gov. Holders of Medtronic Ordinary Shares may also obtain a copy of the Prospectus by clicking on the appropriate link on http://www.dfking.com/MDTSeparation.

Medtronic has retained D.F. King & Co., Inc. as the information agent for the Exchange Offer. To obtain copies of the Prospectus and related documents, or for questions about the terms of the Exchange Offer or how to participate, you may contact the information agent at (877) 361-7972 (toll-free for shareholders) or (646) 845-0146 (banks, brokers and all others outside the United States).

evidence.title: LEI record: MORGAN STANLEY INSIGHT FUND
LEI record: Nagarro Software AB
Conseiller(ère), Relations médias, positionnement corporatif et produits (Remplacement de congé de maternité)
evidence.text:
Lieu du travail

Montréal

À propos de nous

Le Cabinet de relations publiques NATIONAL, la plus importante firme-conseil en relations publiques au Canada, accompagne des organisations de premier plan dans la gestion de leurs enjeux de communication, de réputation et de positionnement.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) conseiller(ère), relations médias, positionnement corporatif et produits, afin de contribuer à des mandats d’envergure auprès de clients majeurs issus de secteurs variés, dont les affaires, les produits de consommation et le lifestyle.

La personne retenue aura l’occasion de travailler avec une équipe multidisciplinaire, des experts du bureau de Montréal et du réseau NATIONAL, ainsi qu’un portefeuille de clients évoluant dans des industries multiples.

Poste

Nous recherchons une personne capable de naviguer avec aisance entre créativité, rigueur et exécution concrète en relations médias, en positionnement de produits, et en collaborations avec des créateurs de contenu.

Au cœur des mandats, cette personne contribue à la réputation, à la visibilité et au positionnement de clients par l’entremise de programmes de relations médias, d’initiatives de positionnement de produits et de communications corporatives. Elle sait repérer les angles porteurs, structurer des approches claires et contribuer à transformer les priorités des clients en initiatives médiatiques pertinentes et percutantes.

Ce rôle s’adresse à une personne proactive, rigoureuse et curieuse, qui connaît bien l’écosystème médiatique québécois et canadien, et qui aime contribuer directement à la réalisation des mandats. La personne recherchée possède une plume stratégique et créative, suit de près l’actualité et les tendances, et sait évoluer dans des environnements rapides où la qualité, le jugement et la collaboration font toute la différence.

Responsabilités principales

Relations médias et positionnement

Contribuer au développement et au déploiement de programmes de relations médias produits et corporatifs pour des clients de différents secteurs

Identifier les angles, occasions médiatiques et approches de positionnement les plus pertinentes selon les objectifs des clients

Entretenir des relations régulières avec les médias, journalistes, chroniqueurs, créateurs de contenu et leaders d’opinion pertinents aux mandats

Assurer une connaissance active de l’écosystème médiatique au Québec et au Canada, notamment dans les secteurs des affaires, des produits de consommation et du lifestyle

Contribuer à la gestion de la réputation et du positionnement de produits, de marques et d’organisations dans des contextes variés

Exécution et gestion de mandats

Participer à la gestion de plusieurs programmes de communication simultanément, incluant les vigies, les relations médias, les suivis, les rapports, les partenariats et les livrables connexes

Assurer un suivi rigoureux des priorités, des échéanciers et de la qualité des livrables

Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe en place et les autres expertises de NATIONAL selon les besoins des mandats

Contribuer activement à l’exécution des mandats, de la planification à la livraison, en s’impliquant là où cela crée le plus d’impact

Participer à l’identification d’opportunités de développement auprès de clients existants ou potentiels

Compétences

Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en relations médias, positionnement corporatif et positionnement de produits, idéalement en agence

Diplôme universitaire en communication, relations publiques, marketing ou toute autre formation pertinente

Excellente connaissance de l’écosystème des médias au Québec et au Canada

Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, afin de rédiger des communications adaptées aux différents publics, et de collaborer efficacement avec nos clients, collègues et compagnies sœurs au Canada et à l’international

Capacité à assurer un suivi rigoureux auprès des clients et à coordonner plusieurs mandats simultanément

Aisance avec les outils numériques et d’intelligence artificielle, les vigies médiatiques et les pratiques actuelles en communication

Qualités personnelles

Rigueur, sens des responsabilités et souci constant de la qualité

Réflexes aiguisés en relations médias et en gestion de projets

Curiosité, jugement et compréhension fine de l’actualité, des tendances et des environnements clients

Autonomie, proactivité et capacité à saisir rapidement les occasions

Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément, dont certains dans de courts échéanciers

Bonne résistance au stress et aisance dans des environnements rapides et évolutifs

Volonté de se développer au sein d’une organisation collaborative et ambitieuse

Ce que nous offrons

Poste à temps plein, du lundi au vendredi (remplacement de congé de maternité, avec possibilité de prolongation)

Horaire hybride : présentiel du lundi au jeudi, possibilité de télétravailler le vendredi

Programme mensuel de remboursement pour le transport en commun

Rabais sur l'abonnement saisonnier de BIXI en été

Assurance collective et compte de soins de santé

Accès au service Dialogue

Programmes de santé et de mieux-être

Environnement stimulant et humain, avec activités sociales variées

Accès à un centre d’entraînement dédié aux employés de l’immeuble ($)

Lieu de travail exceptionnel au cœur du centre-ville de Montréal

NATIONAL aide les organisations à faire face à des enjeux complexes en leur apportant de la clarté et du sens. Grâce à des analyses de pointe, des communications stratégiques et créatives, nous aidons les dirigeants et les organisations à communiquer avec détermination, à bâtir la confiance et à réaliser leurs objectifs les plus importants. Forts d'une équipe de 300 consultants, nous accompagnons un large éventail d'organisations œuvrant dans différents secteurs pour mieux comprendre les défis auxquels elles sont confrontées et saisir les occasions qui se présentent à elles.

Depuis 50 ans, NATIONAL est au cœur des enjeux et des secteurs qui comptent et contribue aux changements d'aujourd'hui et de demain. Chef de file canadien en communications, NATIONAL a des bureaux à Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, Montréal, Québec, Saint-Jean, Halifax et St. John's. Son réseau comprend Time & Space, un chef de file en stratégie média, en analyse de données, en planification et en exécution.

Le Cabinet de relations publiques NATIONAL est une société d'AVENIR GLOBAL, la plus importante firme canadienne de communications, classée parmi les 25 plus importante au monde, disposant de bureaux dans 22 villes au Canada, aux États-Unis, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient. Pour en savoir davantage sur NATIONAL, visitez notre site Web ou suivez‐nous sur LinkedIn et X.

Cliquez ici pour lire notre politique de confidentialité.

evidence.title: Director, Public Affairs and Regional Lead
evidence.text:
About us

At NATIONAL, we are driven by purpose, creativity, and connection. For 50 years, our teams across Canada have been delivering strategic communications expertise that helps organizations shape conversations that matter.

NATIONAL is seeking a senior communications leader for Newfoundland and Labrador. While this opportunity is currently posted at the Director level, we welcome interest from experienced communications professionals and seasoned executives, with level, scope, and title to be considered based on experience, capability, and market presence.

This is a rare opportunity for someone who knows the province, understands how decisions are made, and can move confidently between public affairs, government relations, corporate communications, and marketing conversations.

Our Newfoundland and Labrador presence is an important part of our Atlantic and national network. We work with clients across sectors, regions, and issues, helping them navigate complex environments, build trust, and communicate with clarity. With a strong local and regional foundation and access to the full strength of NATIONAL’s offices across Canada, this role offers the opportunity to help shape what comes next in one of the country’s most distinctive and strategically important markets.

The role

This is a hands-on, senior market-building opportunity for someone who wants to be both strategic and practical, visible and grounded, independent and deeply connected to a national team. We are looking for an entrepreneurial leader who can help grow NATIONAL’s presence in Newfoundland and Labrador while contributing to client work across Atlantic Canada and the broader NATIONAL network. Whether you’re currently living in the region, or looking to return home, the ideal candidate is deeply connected to the province. They understand the local business, political, and community landscape, and they bring the judgment, presence, and credibility to advise executives, engage stakeholders, and represent NATIONAL in the market.

Our office is located within the Board of Trade in St. John’s, offering a strong connection to the local business community and an energizing space for client work, collaboration, and growth.

What you will do

As a key member of the Atlantic and Canadian Advisory and Public Affairs practice team, you will provide senior counsel to clients navigating complex communications, public affairs, and reputational challenges. Our roster of clients are closely connected to the biggest opportunities and challenges NL is facing. You will bring a strong understanding of government, business, community, and media environments in Newfoundland and Labrador, with particular interest in sectors such as energy, defense, economic development, healthcare and other areas shaping the future of the province. Ideally, your experience and skillset can contribute to client needs outside of NL and outside of Atlantic Canada.

You will help lead and grow client relationships, identify new opportunities, and connect clients with the right expertise from across NATIONAL. You will be expected to work independently, think strategically, and manage mandates with confidence, while also knowing when and how to bring in colleagues from other offices and practice areas.

You will represent NATIONAL in the Newfoundland and Labrador market, helping to strengthen our visibility, relationships, and reputation. You will be comfortable in a boardroom, at a community event, in a government relations discussion, or in a marketing strategy conversation. You do not need to be a specialist in every discipline, but you should be an integrated thinker who understands how public affairs, communications, marketing, stakeholder engagement, and reputation intersect. In this role, you will be part of the broader.

What you bring

You are someone excited about local and regional connectivity and are a trusted advisor with strong judgment, sound instincts, and the ability to build relationships across sectors. You are self-motivated and credible with executives, comfortable with elected officials and senior public servants, and able to speak naturally with people from a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.

You likely bring:

Senior experience in public affairs, government relations, strategic communications, crisis communications, public relations, or a related professional services environment

Strong knowledge of Newfoundland and Labrador’s political, business, community, and media landscape

Experience or strong familiarity with sectors such as energy, defense, infrastructure, natural resources, economic development, or other regulated or high-profile industries

The ability to lead client relationships, provide wise counsel, and manage complex mandates with limited day-to-day oversight

A practical understanding of marketing and integrated communications, with the ability to contribute meaningfully to broader brand, reputation, and campaign conversations

Strong writing, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills

An entrepreneurial mindset and interest in helping grow NATIONAL’s presence in Newfoundland and Labrador

The ability to collaborate across offices, especially with Atlantic Canada, Ottawa, and other teams across the NATIONAL network

A degree or equivalent experience in communications, public relations, political science, business, public policy, journalism, marketing, or a related field

How you work

You are strategic, but not removed from the work. You can see the larger picture, identify what matters, and turn advice into action. You are calm under pressure, clear in your counsel, and comfortable working in situations where the path forward is not always obvious. You have good judgement.

You build trust easily. You are good in a room, thoughtful in your approach, and able to move between senior executives, community leaders, public officials, colleagues, and clients with confidence and respect. You are a good writer and easily adjust to different mediums and audiences. You are collaborative, but highly self-sufficient. You can build something without needing a large local team around you, and you know how to draw on the strength of a national network when clients would benefit from additional expertise.

You are values-driven, discreet, adaptable, and committed to excellent client service.

What we offer

The opportunity to help shape NATIONAL’s value as a consultancy in Newfoundland and Labrador

A senior, market-facing role with room to grow based on experience, capability, and ambition

A connected national platform with strong Atlantic Canadian collaboration

Exposure to meaningful client work across public affairs, government relations, corporate communications, marketing, and reputation

A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with the support of one of Canada’s most respected communications consultancies

Competitive compensation, commensurate with level and experience

Hybrid flexibility with an expectation of meaningful presence in the St. John’s market

A commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all that we do

How to apply

Qualified candidates are invited to apply by submitting a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their interest in the role, connection to Newfoundland and Labrador, and relevant experience.

NATIONAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Should you require accommodation during the selection process, please inform us.

Please note that only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted. As part of our recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, and selection of applicants for this role. Thank you for considering a career with NATIONAL.

NATIONAL Public Relations provides creative communications solutions that move people in thought and actions. We bring together a team of 300 seasoned professionals, who are committed to helping organizations of all sizes and in all sectors understand their challenges and opportunities and solve the issues they are facing. For 47 years, NATIONAL has been at the center of issues and industries that matter, leading change for today and tomorrow.

NATIONAL is Canada’s leading public relations firm, with offices in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, Quebec City, Saint John, Halifax and St. John’s. Its network includes Time & Space, a leader in media strategy, data analysis, planning and execution.

NATIONAL Public Relations is an AVENIR GLOBAL company, the largest Canadian-owned global communications firm, ranked among the 25 largest in the world with offices in 23 locations across Canada, the U.S., Europe and the Middle East. evidence.title: Director, Corporate Communications
evidence.text:
Director, Corporate Communications

Work location
Toronto, Ontario (hybrid).

About us

At NATIONAL, we are driven by purpose, creativity, and connection. For 50 years, our teams across Canada have helped organizations navigate change, build trust, and shape conversations that matter.

As one of Canada's largest independent communications consultancies, we partner with leading public and private organizations to solve complex business challenges through strategic communications, corporate affairs, capital markets expertise, and creative thinking.

Our Toronto team is looking for a senior communications leader with a strong background in financial communications, capital markets, and investor relations. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys advising senior clients, making complicated business issues easier to understand, and working in a collaborative, fast-paced consulting environment.

If you are a trusted advisor who likes solving complex challenges, building lasting client relationships, and helping grow a dynamic practice, we would like to hear from you.

The role

This is a hands-on senior advisory opportunity for someone who wants to be both strategic and practical, commercially minded and collaborative, and comfortable advising clients when the stakes are high.

As Director, Corporate Communications, you will provide senior strategic counsel to executives, boards of directors, and investor relations teams. You will lead complex client mandates across corporate and financial communications, investor relations, capital markets initiatives, reputation management, crisis files, transaction communications, disclosure support, and special situations.

You will also play an important role in growing our practice. That means identifying and leading new business opportunities, expanding existing client relationships, mentoring colleagues, and connecting clients with the right expertise from across NATIONAL's practices and offices.

What you will do

As a senior member of the Toronto team, you will help clients communicate clearly in moments that matter to their business, their investors, their employees, their regulators, and other important stakeholders.

You will be expected to bring sound judgment, strong business instincts, and a clear understanding of how markets, media, investors, disclosure, and reputation intersect.

You will lead complex client mandates from planning through execution, making sure the work is thoughtful, high quality, delivered on time, and managed on budget.

You will build strong, enduring client relationships, identify opportunities to expand existing mandates, and lead new business opportunities that contribute to the growth of the Firm. You will also manage project planning, financial management, and resource allocation so that client objectives are met and the work runs smoothly.

You will collaborate with colleagues across NATIONAL's practices and offices to deliver integrated communications solutions that meet evolving client needs. You will mentor, coach, and develop team members, helping foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.

You will stay close to capital markets trends, regulatory developments, and emerging communications practices so that your counsel is current, practical, and grounded in the realities of the market. You will also help strengthen NATIONAL's presence in the Canadian capital markets and financial communications community.

What you bring

You are a trusted advisor with a strong grounding in financial communications. You understand how to translate complex financial, market, and business issues into clear advice, credible messaging, and practical communications plans.

You are comfortable in senior rooms, including engaging with executives, boards, investor relations teams, legal advisors, bankers, analysts, and other stakeholders who are often part of high-profile, sensitive, or crisis-related mandates. You do not need to be a specialist in every situation, but you should bring the judgment and experience to know what matters, what questions to ask, and how to bring the right people together.

You likely bring:

10+ years of experience in financial and corporate communications, capital markets, investor relations, strategic communications, or a consulting or corporate advisory environment.

Demonstrated experience providing strategic counsel to senior executives and leading complex communications or capital markets mandates, including crisis files.

Exceptional writing, presentation, and strategic communications skills, with the ability to develop compelling messaging across multiple channels.

Proven experience leading client relationships, managing budgets, and delivering complex projects in a fast-paced consulting environment.

A strong understanding of capital markets, financial communications, and the evolving media and digital landscape.

A bachelor's degree in Communications, Business, Finance, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related discipline. Experience advising publicly traded companies, investor relations teams or capital market participants is considered an asset. Familiarity with the Canadian capital markets landscape is also an asset.

Comfort using AI-enabled tools, for example, ChatGPT.

Nice to have: bilingualism in English and French.

How you work

You are strategic, but not removed from the work. You can see the larger picture, identify what matters, and turn advice into action. You are calm under pressure, clear in your counsel, and comfortable working in situations where the path forward is not always obvious.

You simplify complex issues, including financial and capital markets issues, and provide practical recommendations that clients can use. You bring a strong client-service mindset, build relationships naturally, and know how to manage stakeholders with confidence and discretion.

You are organized and comfortable managing budgets, timelines, resources, and tight deadlines. You can lead multiple priorities at once without losing sight of quality, detail, or client objectives.

You are collaborative, but highly self-sufficient. You can motivate teams, coach colleagues, contribute to an inclusive workplace, and draw on the strength of a national network when clients would benefit from additional expertise.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, adaptable, and committed to excellent client service.

What we offer

A hybrid work environment and a supportive, collegial Toronto office culture.

Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

Opportunities to work on high-profile mandates with leading organizations across sectors.

Professional development, coaching, and growth opportunities within a national team.

Occasional travel as required by client and team needs.

Expected Compensation

The expected salary for this role is $103,500 - $115,000 CAD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

How to apply

Qualified candidates are invited to apply by submitting a resume and a brief cover letter outlining their interest in the role, relevant experience, and fit for a senior financial communications, corporate communications, and capital markets advisory role. If you are up for a new challenge to join Canada's PR Firm, we would like to hear from you.

NATIONAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Should you require accommodation during the selection process, please inform us.

A vacancy currently exists for this position. As part of our recruitment process, we use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the screening, assessment, and selection of applicants for this role. Thank you for considering a career with NATIONAL. Please note that only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted.

NATIONAL Public Relations provides creative communications solutions that move people in thought and actions. We bring together a team of 300 seasoned professionals, who are committed to helping organizations of all sizes and in all sectors understand their challenges and opportunities and solve the issues they are facing. For 47 years, NATIONAL has been at the center of issues and industries that matter, leading change for today and tomorrow.

NATIONAL is Canada’s leading public relations firm, with offices in Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal, Quebec City, Saint John, Halifax and St. John’s. Its network includes Time & Space, a leader in media strategy, data analysis, planning and execution.

NATIONAL Public Relations is an AVENIR GLOBAL company, the largest Canadian-owned global communications firm, ranked among the 25 largest in the world with offices in 23 locations across Canada, the U.S., Europe and the Middle East. For more information about NATIONAL, please visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

evidence.text:
About us

At NATIONAL, we are proud to be Canada’s leading public relations firm, bringing together a coast-to-coast network of public affairs experts. In Toronto, our Public Affairs and Government Relations team partners with clients across a wide range of sectors to design, activate, and manage strategies that resonate with audiences and deliver measurable impact. As our team continues to grow, we are seeking a consultant with a passion for strategic communications, public affairs, government relations and, above and beyond, exceptional client service.

The role

As a Senior Consultant on NATIONAL’s Public Affairs and Government Relations team in Toronto, you will help clients understand and navigate complex political, regulatory and reputational environments. You will support high-profile mandates across sectors, helping to turn current events, policy developments and stakeholder dynamics into practical strategies that advance client goals.

This role is ideal for someone with strong political instincts, excellent client service skills and the ability to manage multiple moving pieces in a fast-paced agency environment. You may come from a public affairs agency, a political office, government, corporate communications or another client-facing advisory role.

Key responsibilities

Serve as the day-to-day, client-facing manager for accounts across multiple industry sectors

Collaborate with senior communications and public affairs leaders to deliver expert counsel and exceptional service

Design, manage, and execute impactful municipal and provincial government relations programs as well as stakeholder engagement and advocacy campaigns

Lead and support reputation management programs, issues and crisis management, and communications campaigns (earned, owned, and paid media strategies)

Monitor and analyze evolving political, economic, and social issues; proactively propose strategies to advance client goals

Oversee account management, including project work plans and budgets

Contribute to practice and Firm-wide business development initiatives, with a focus on issues/crisis management, reputation management, campaign strategy and activation, public engagement, and stakeholder relations

Work with colleagues across NATIONAL practices and offices to deliver integrated communications services

Qualifications

Three to six years of experience in public affairs, government relations, strategic communications, political offices, consulting, government or a related environment

Strong understanding of Ontario politics, municipal government and/or public policy

Post-secondary degree in public relations, political science, business administration, public administration, or a related field

Agency experience, political staff experience or experience supporting senior decision-makers considered a strong asset

Excellent writing, research and presentation skills

Strong client service instincts, including responsiveness, organization, judgment and attention to detail

Ability to monitor political, media and stakeholder developments and translate them into client-relevant insights

Comfortable managing multiple files, deadlines and relationships at once

Entrepreneurial, curious and motivated to help grow the practice

Abilities

Sound judgment and critical thinking, with the ability to assess complex situations and recommend practical courses of action

Ability to anticipate needs, identify emerging opportunities and challenges, and proactively bring forward solutions

Strong interpersonal and relationship-building abilities, with the ability to work effectively with clients, colleagues and external stakeholders

Ability to collaborate effectively as part of a team while taking ownership of work and driving assignments forward independently

Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and circumstances can change quickly

Commitment to continuous learning and staying current on political, policy, communications and industry developments

What we offer

A collaborative, entrepreneurial workplace culture that values curiosity, innovation and teamwork

The opportunity to work directly with senior advisors, clients and decision-makers on high-profile files at the intersection of business, politics, media and public opinion

Meaningful responsibility, mentorship and opportunities to accelerate your career in public affairs and government relations

Exposure to a diverse portfolio of clients, industries and public policy issues across Canada

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits

Expected Compensation

The expected salary for this role is $77,000-$87,500 CAD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.

How to apply

Submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your interest and fit for the role. If you’re up for a new challenge to join Canada’s PR Firm, we’d love to hear from you.

NATIONAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Should you require any accommodation during the selection process, please inform us.

A vacancy currently exists for this position. Please note that only candidates selected for further consideration will be contacted. We use artificial intelligence tools to assist in screening, assessing, and selecting applicants for this role. Thank you for considering a career with us.

On September 15, 2026, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of NIKE, Inc. (the “Company”) increased the size of the Board to twelve directors and appointed Alexandre Arnault as a director of the Company, effective immediately, for an initial term expiring at the Company’s 2027 annual meeting of shareholders. Committee assignments for Mr. Arnault have not yet been determined.

Alexandre Arnault, 34, has been the Deputy Chief Executive Officer of Moët Hennessy, the wines and spirits division of LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SE (“LVMH”), since February 2025, and has served on the board of directors of LVMH since April 2024. Mr. Arnault previously served as the Executive Vice President of Products and Communications at Tiffany & Co. from January 2021 until February 2025, where he developed and implemented the company’s communications and products strategy. He also served as Chief Executive Officer of RIMOWA from October 2016 to December 2020. In addition to his roles at LVMH, Mr. Arnault previously served on the boards of directors of Birkenstock Holding plc, Carrefour SA, and Moncler S.p.A.

There are no arrangements or understandings between Mr. Arnault and any other person pursuant to which Mr. Arnault was selected as a director, and no family relationships exist between Mr. Arnault and any director or executive officer of the Company. Mr. Arnault is not a party to any transaction to which the Company is or was a participant and in which Mr. Arnault has a direct or indirect material interest subject to disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K.

Mr. Arnault will participate in the Company’s standard director compensation program, which is described in “Corporate Governance-Director Compensation for Fiscal 2026” in the Company’s proxy statement for its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders (filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on July 15, 2026) (the “Director Compensation Program”). Pursuant to the Director Compensation Program, on September 15, 2026, Mr. Arnault was granted a sign-on award of restricted shares of the Company’s Class B Common Stock valued at $200,000. These shares are subject to forfeiture in the event that Mr. Arnault’s service as a director of the Company terminates prior to the first anniversary of the grant.

About Nintex:

At Nintex, we are transforming the way people work, everywhere.

As the global standard for process intelligence and automation, we're trusted by over 10,000 public and private sector organizations across 90 countries. Our customers, from industry giants like Amazon, Coca-Cola, and Microsoft, rely on the Nintex Platform to accelerate their digital transformation journeys by managing, automating, and optimizing business processes quickly and efficiently. We improve their lives through the technology we build.

We are committed to fostering a workplace that supports amazing people in doing their very best work every day. Collaboration is constant, our workplace is fun, the environment is fast-paced, and we value our people’s curiosity, ideas, and enthusiasm. Driven by passion and accountability, we take initiative, measure progress, and deliver results. Our culture fosters innovation and problem-solving, fueled by curiosity and a commitment to thinking big. Together, we move with agility, prioritize customer needs, and build unity through empathy, leaving a positive impact wherever we go.

About the role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) you will be responsible for effectively qualifying opportunities from inbound enquiries whilst also prospecting and building relationships within current Nintex customers within a defined territory. In this role you will learn how to master the fundamentals and gain experience working collaboratively with our sales team across the entire sales cycle. You will be responsible for identifying qualified prospects, generating appointments, delivering our value proposition and influencing qualified deals to close.

Your contribution will be:

Performing outbound sales calls. You will spend your day connecting with prospects using phone, social, and email to engage in a qualification/discovery process. You will be the 1st point of call for live chat sales enquiries. Coordinate closely with internal sales resources to align solution design with customers’ business requirements.

Lead qualification. You will qualify high quality opportunities and arrange follow up meetings with the sales team. To manage this process you will utilize document progress, notes, etc. in the Nintex CRM (SalesForce.com). You will learn and master Salesforce lead management, email management, and lead documentation, follow-up procedure. You will participate in providing feedback on how prospects are contacting Nintex and how they are reacting to current marketing efforts.

Evangelize the Nintex portfolio. You will gain and maintain up to date knowledge of Saleforce.com, SharePoint, O365, business process planning and Nintex products. Before we let you loose on the phones, you will learn to effectively communicate how all Nintex products are licensed and how they will benefit our customers. Further, you will proactively scope technical solutions using Nintex products required to address customer requirements, assess customers met and unmet needs, and recommend solutions that optimize value for both the customer and Nintex.

Fill the top of the funnel. In order for us to get leads to the buying phase, we first have to get people into the qualified leads funnel. You will provide assistance to existing and prospective customers during product trial periods and enable them, so they get the most out of the trial period. You will opportunistically pursue additional business development opportunities in the field, collaborate with other Business Development Representatives, and Account Managers to ensure these opportunities are advanced.

To be successful, we think you need:

2 years' sales experience

Prior experience with Salesforce CRM (desirable)

Marketing or Software as a Service (SaaS) sales experience (desirable)

Ability to work in a fast paced, entrepreneurial, results oriented culture where team members work together collaboratively

Excellent oral and written communication skills

A positive, self-starter attitude and desire to exceed expectations at every opportunity

Strong organizational skills and an absolute focus on quality of work

Proven ability to connect with people using telephone, email and online networking sites

This role will be supporting our teams in the Middle East & North Africa, so Arabic language skills preferred.

What’s in it for you?

Nintex has a hybrid working model, enabling us to build culture, learn, and grow together. We intentionally connect and collaborate, while emphasizing flexibility with a blend of at-home and in-office work. This role is a hybrid role in our local Nintex office.

While our offerings differ from country to country, we offer our entire global workforce an array of exciting perks and benefits, including

Global Gratitude and Recharge Days

Flexible, paid time off policy

Employee wellness programs and counseling resources

Meaningful peer recognition and awards

Paid parental leave

Invention/patenting assistance

Community impact, paid volunteer time, and opportunities

Intercultural learning and celebration

Multiple tools through which to learn and grow, and an incredible global community

View more about our benefits here: https://www.nintex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Global-Perks-and-Benefits.pdf.

About the role:

The Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr CSM) is responsible for driving product adoption, value realization, and retention at scale across a broader and more complex customer portfolio. The Sr CSM proactively manages customer health and engagement using usage telemetry, adoption signals, and actionable insights to prioritize intervention, mitigate risk, and drive growth. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and partners cross‑functionally to execute repeatable success plays and ensure consistent, data‑driven customer outcomes.

Your contribution will be:

Territory & Account Planning

Co-create success plans aligned with customer goals, lifecycle maturity, and long-term value realization

Senior Product Manager, Banking
evidence.text:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Novo is a venture-backed fintech that simplifies banking for small businesses. Since our Fall 2018 beta launch, we've expanded offerings from free checking accounts and debit cards to lending products, business tools (invoices, bookkeeping, and more), and integrations.Today http://integrations.Today, Novo is a powerfully simple banking platform that serves over 250,000 small businesses. In addition to providing smart tools built for entrepreneurs to better run and grow their businesses, Novo has processed billions in transactions in partnership with a number of established banking partners.

Our vision is to be the go-to platform serving small businesses – from launch to everyday – so business owners can focus on growing, while Novo provides seamless money movement, money storage, and access to capital. We'd like to look back 5–10 years from now and know that we helped new generations of small businesses succeed because of the work we did at Novo. Novo raised $170 million in venture capital and is backed by leading investors, including Stripes, Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, and Notable Capital (formerly GGV). Learn more at https://www.novo.co https://www.novo.co.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Novo is seeking a highly experienced and motivated product manager to own and scale our core banking experience — the accounts, money movement, cards, and program infrastructure that power banking for over 250,000 small businesses. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, usability, and depth of the products at the heart of Novo, supporting our rapidly expanding customer base and business operations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product leader who can set product direction for complex, regulated financial products, partner closely with Engineering, Design, Risk, and Compliance, and work hand-in-hand with banking partners to ship reliable, secure, high-quality experiences within a dynamic, regulated fintech environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

PRODUCT STRATEGY & LEADERSHIP

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Novo's core banking products, including deposit accounts, money movement, cards, and the underlying program infrastructure.

- Develop a clear point of view for each product — defining who it serves, what value it delivers, and why it resonates — so Novo serves the right small businesses deeply rather than building for everyone and no one.

- Serve as a key product partner to the executive team, translating company objectives and customer insight into a prioritized banking roadmap.

- Balance near-term delivery with the platform and product depth investments needed to support long-term growth and retention.

BANKING PRODUCTS & MONEY MOVEMENT

- Own the end-to-end experience for account opening, funding, deposits, and money-movement flows (ACH, wires, transfers, bill pay, and card transactions), partnering with Engineering on the ledger, payments rails, and card systems beneath them.

- Define and improve the products that drive deposits, money storage, and money movement, deepening engagement and increasing the number of Novo products each customer uses.

- Partner with the team to evaluate and improve partner-bank and program economics, ensuring the products we ship are both valuable to customers and sustainable for the business.

- Translate complex regulatory, banking-partner, and operational requirements into intuitive, simple experiences for small business owners.

DISCOVERY, EXECUTION & QUALITY

- Run a rigorous discovery process grounded in customer research, usage data, and cohort analysis to identify the highest-impact opportunities across the banking experience.

- Favor rigorous, cohort-based analysis over surface-level correlation when evaluating performance and prioritizing investment, while staying comfortable acting on directional data when speed and urgency demand it.

- Write clear specs, define success metrics, and partner with Engineering and Design to ship reliable, secure, high-quality features on a predictable cadence.

- Monitor product performance and key metrics, distinguish signal from noise, and drive timely iteration when results diverge from expectations.

RELIABILITY, RISK & COMPLIANCE

- Partner with Engineering, InfoSec, and Operations to ensure banking products meet the reliability, availability, and data-integrity bar required in a regulated financial environment.

- Embed risk, fraud, security, and regulatory requirements into the product process from the start, partnering with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to ship products responsibly.

- Support the reporting and product controls required by banking partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders.

- Treat trust as a first-class product requirement, recognizing that banking and financial products demand a higher threshold of trust than any consumer app.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

evidence.title: Senior Product Manager, SMB Platform
evidence.text:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Novo is a venture-backed fintech that simplifies banking for small businesses. Since our Fall 2018 beta launch, we've expanded offerings from free checking accounts and debit cards to lending products, business tools (invoices, bookkeeping, and more), and integrations.

Today, Novo is a powerfully simple banking platform that serves over 250,000 small businesses. In addition to providing smart tools built for entrepreneurs to better run and grow their businesses, Novo has processed billions in transactions in partnership with a number of established banking partners.

Our vision is to be the go-to platform serving small businesses – from launch to everyday – so business owners can focus on growing, while Novo provides seamless money movement, money storage, and access to capital. We'd like to look back 5–10 years from now and know that we helped new generations of small businesses succeed because of the work we did at Novo.

Novo raised $170 million in venture capital and is backed by leading investors, including Stripes, Valar Ventures, Crosslink Capital, and Notable Capital (formerly GGV). Learn more at https://www.novo.co.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Novo is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the platform surface area that connects, activates, and deepens value for small businesses in their first 90 days and beyond. This role spans our DDA onboarding to funding activation funnel, invoice workflow, external integrations ecosystem — three interconnected surfaces that together determine whether a new Novo customer becomes an engaged, transacting one. The role will also explore how to apply AI to enhance how SMBs interact with Novo. The ideal candidate is a hands-on product leader who combines platform and tooling depth with a growth mindset: someone who can own complex product workflows end-to-end, run rigorous experimentation, and is comfortable getting their hands dirty in LLMs. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of product tooling, ecosystem connectivity, and customer activation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

DDA ONBOARDING & ACTIVATION FUNNEL

- Own the DDA application, signup, and account-opening funnel — driving activation in the first 90 days of a customer's tenure by reducing friction, improving conversion, and getting customers to their first meaningful transaction faster.

- Run a steady cadence of onboarding and activation experiments using tools like LaunchDarkly, managing incentives, in-product moments, and lifecycle prompts that create compelling reasons for customers to deepen their engagement with Novo.

INVOICE WORKFLOW & TOOLING

- Own the end-to-end invoice experience creation and scheduling, PDF generation, branding and customization, reminders, dispute handling, payment collection via multiple rails, and reconciliation driving adoption as a core SMB financial tool.

- Identify and ship improvements that make the invoice workflow more intelligent: smart reminders, automated reconciliation, AI-assisted invoice creation, and workflow automation that reduces manual effort for busy business owners.

INTEGRATIONS & CONNECTED PLATFORM

- Own Novo's integration ecosystem across revenue (e.g., Stripe, Square), accounting (QuickBooks, Xero), payroll (Gusto), and utilities (Slack, Zapier) deepening existing integrations from basic data sync to richer, bidirectional workflows.

- Lead the vision for a Novo API strategy that enables LLM and third-party connectivity, allowing customers to query their banking and financial data through external AI assistants and business tools, while identifying new integration opportunities that address core SMB financial workflows.

EXPERIMENTATION & DATA

- Design, run, and scale a rigorous experimentation program across the platform — covering onboarding flows, invoice tooling, and integration adoption — with clear hypotheses, measurement plans, and ownership of outcomes.

- Define and own the platform KPIs that matter — activation rate, integration adoption, invoice volume, 90-day retention — building and maintaining the analytics instrumentation needed to measure the funnel end-to-end and give leadership a shared, realistic view of platform health.

AI-ENHANCED CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

- Apply AI to enhance how SMBs interact with Novo: smart invoice tooling, automated transaction categorization, agentic financial workflows, and personalized platform experiences that reduce the cognitive load of running a small business.

- Defying and leading the product vision for Novo's AI integration strategy (should we build an external API, agentic workflows?) while ensuring AI-driven features meet financial services privacy and regulatory standards.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP & EXECUTION

- Partner with Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing to ship platform improvements and productionalize experimental wins into durable, scalable features — running a consistent operating cadence that surfaces friction early and optimizes for the global maximum.

- Communicate progress, priorities, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and leadership, with the intellectual honesty to flag when a bet isn't working and redirect accordingly.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Demonstrated track record of owning and shipping platform, tooling, or integration products in fintech, financial services, or SMB-focused technology with the ability to define a compelling product vision for your area, translate it into a prioritized roadmap, and build buy-in across engineering, design, and leadership.

- Deep familiarity with SMB customer needs, financial workflows invoicing, accounting, payments, cash flow and the small business software ecosystem; recognized as a domain resource who can guide teams on what matters and why.

- Proven ability to turn customer insight into product decisions: experience running discovery, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and making prioritization tradeoffs that are defensible with data and grounded in user reality.

- Strong data proficiencyable to write clear measurement plans, instrument funnels, evaluate experiment results, and distinguish conclusive from directional signals with hands-on experience running A/B tests using modern tooling (e.g., LaunchDarkly, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar).

- Technical acumen sufficient to partner effectively with engineering: comfort with API concepts, integration architecture, and the ability to write clear specs and make informed tradeoff decisions without being the one writing the code.

- Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate product work generating content, analyzing data, prototyping features with sound judgment about where AI adds real value and where it introduces risk, particularly in a regulated financial services context.

- Experience shipping in a regulated environment, working with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to meet security, privacy, and financial services standards.

- Strong communication and cross-functional stakeholder management skills; comfortable presenting to leadership and aligning teams around platform decisions in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.
