evidence.title: Skyddsvakter till Securitas Kristinehamn
evidence.text:
Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.

Vill du arbeta med Sveriges säkerhet? Securitas söker nu skyddsvakter till uppdrag att skydda samhällsviktig verksamhet för Sverige. Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som inte bara söker ett arbete – utan är redo att ta dig an en uppgift med stort ansvar och verklig betydelse för vårt lands försörjning och säkerhet. Det handlar om att skydda det som måste fungera – dygnet runt, året runt.

Uppdraget

Som skyddsvakt har du en avgörande roll i att upprätthålla säkerheten för verksamheter som är viktiga för Sverige. Du arbetar med utökade befogenheter, ofta i nära samarbete med våra uppdragsgivare.

Arbetet är varierande och kan omfatta både stationär och ronderande bevakning, inpasseringskontroller eller arbete i bevakningscentral. Du kommer att behöva fatta egna beslut i skarpa lägen, ha god uthållighet och ett stabilt omdöme. Därför söker vi en person som har förmågan att behålla lugnet när andra inte gör det – och är lojal mot de svenska intressena.

Skyddsvaktsbevakningen bedrivs såväl inomhus som utomhus och tjänsterna vi söker är förlagda till dagtid med arbetstiderna 06.00-18.00 på ett så kallat 5:4 schema. Då vi jobbar i en verksamhet som är igång dygnet runt året om innefattas röda dagar och helger i schemat där normalfallet är arbeta två helger ledig två. Du kommer arbeta hos en nystartad kund där det finns stora möjligheter att vara med och påverka verksamheten. Teamet består av cirka 10 kollegor - ett sammansvetsats gäng där samarbete och proffisonalism står i centrum.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden är att:

Skyddar samhällsviktiga verksamheter rån obehörigt tillträde och andra hot

Utför kontroller enligt gällande föreskrifter och instruktioner

Samverkar med personal och myndigheter i säkerhetsfrågor

Varför ska du välja oss?

Vi är en av världens ledande säkerhetsaktörer, men framför allt är vi trygghet. Hos oss får du ett meningsfullt arbete, en stark gemenskap och möjligheten att utvecklas i en roll som verkligen spelar roll.

Krav:

Har godkända betyg i svenska och engelska från gymnasiet

B-körkort

Svenskt medborgarskap

Godkänd säkerhetsprövning

Det är starkt meriterande om du även har:

Civil eller militär skyddsvaktsutbildning; har du genomfört skyddsvaktsutbildning hos Försvarsmakten inom ramen för Försvarsmaktens grundutbildning (GMU) så kan denna valideras för civilt bruk. Skyddsvaktsutbildningen, samt GMU, ska vara genomförd 2016 eller senare och ditt utbildningsbevis får inte vara äldre än fem år vid ansökningstillfället

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med bevakning av skyddsobjekt, annan bevakning eller säkerhetsarbete.

Vi söker en person med integritet, mognad och förmåga att ta ansvar – både för sin egen och andras säkerhet. Du har en naturlig fallenhet för struktur och ordning, och en vaksamhet som andra litar på. Det här är en tjänst för dig som har livet och erfarenheten i ryggen, och som nu är redo att använda det till att göra skillnad.

Säkerhetsprövning

Observera att tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och innebär att du kommer att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt gällande regelverk kommer det genomföras säkerhetssamtal, bakgrundskontroll och registerkontroll. Bedömningen syftar till att utreda laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter enligt Säkerhetspolisens föreskrifter och vägledningar. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning om dig, din livssituation samt ekonomiska förhållanden vid prövning av din lämplighet.

I förekommande fall kan motsvarande kontroll göras av den som du sammanbor med, eller har en liknande relation med.

För att bli aktuell för tjänsten krävs därför (som lägst) att;

Du/ni inte förekommer i Polismyndighetens olika register, ex misstankeregister, belastningsregister, osv.

Du/ni har ordnad ekonomi; inte har betalningsanmärkningar, oreglerade skulder, förekommer hos inkassoföretag eller Kronofogden

Det här är inte ett vanligt jobb - det är ett uppdrag i tjänst för samhället. Är du den vi söker?

Övrig information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag!

Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till kontaktperson: daniel.mattsson@securitas.se. Har du frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta maja.engelbrekt@securitas.se.

Tjänsten är heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6mån provanställning

Vi arbetar med urvalstester och AI-baserade intervjuer som första urval.

Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail

Sista ansökningsdag är 18/10 2026.

För anställning För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). Inför ansökan görs en bakgrundskontroll och säkerhetssamtal för att bedöma om kandidaten uppfyller ställda krav på laglydnad, lämplighet och medborgerlig pålitlighet samt inte har några sårbarheter. Det är ett krav att ha ordnad ekonomi och inga oreglerade skulder.

Vi har gjort medieval för samtliga rekryteringar så vi undanber oss därför samtal från annonssäljare eller säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

evidence.title: Pracownik Ochrony Warszawa - Wola/Bemowo/Bielany - obiekt handlowy
evidence.text:
Jesteśmy skandynawskim koncernem z branży ochrony fizycznej. Pozycję lidera w branży zawdzięczamy pracownikom i innowacyjnym rozwiązaniom z zakresu bezpieczeństwa.

Obecnie do naszego zespołu poszukujemy pracowników na obiekt handlowy na stanowisko: Pracownik Ochrony

Lokalizacja: Warszawa - Wola/Bemowo/Bielany

Twoje przyszłe zdania:

monitorowanie stanu bezpieczeństwa na terenie chronionego obiektu,

ochrona mienia przed dewastacją i włamaniem,

prowadzenie dokumentacji służbowej.

Ze swojej strony oferujemy:

umowę zlecenie (z możliwością przejścia na umowę o pracę po okresie próbnym),

pracę w zmianach 8/10h,

stawkę od 31,90 zł (za godzinę),

kompletne i bezpłatne umundurowanie,

brak kar finansowych,

terminowe wypłacanie wynagrodzenia zawsze do 10-go każdego miesiąca,

ubezpieczenie NNW (od Następstw Nieszczęśliwych Wypadków).

Aplikuj, jeśli jesteś osobą:

posiadającą status ucznia/studenta - mile widziane,

chcącą poszerzyć lub zdobyć doświadczenie w branży ochrony,

niekaraną,

znasz podstawową obsługę komputera.

Osoby zainteresowane zapraszamy do aplikowania poprzez:

wysłanie CV – przycisk aplikuj.

Kliknięcie przycisku „Wyślij” oznacza, że wyrażasz zgodę na przetwarzanie swoich danych osobowych przez Securitas Polska Sp. z o.o. i Securitas Services Sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Postępu 6 dla potrzeb niezbędnych do realizacji procesu rekrutacji.

Możesz zapoznać się ze szczegółową polityką ochrony danych osobowych przez spółki Securitas pod adresem: https:// www.securitas.pl/Securitas/stand-alone/polityka-prywatnoci/

Dane osobowe będą przechowywane przez okres 12 miesięcy od dnia złożenia aplikacji lub do momentu wycofania zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych.

Współadministratorzy danych: Securitas Polska sp. z o.o. i Securitas Services sp. z o.o. (ul. Postępu 6, 02-676 Warszawa). Cele przetwarzania: Rekrutacja bieżąca i przyszła (za zgodą), obsługa roszczeń. Podstawa prawna: obowiązek prawny, działania przed zawarciem umowy, uzasadniony interes – obsługa roszczeń, zgoda (art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a-c, f i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. a i b RODO). Zgoda: Zgodę na przetwarzanie danych (innych niż wymagane) wyrażasz poprzez ich podanie (w formularzu lub w Twoim CV), a na potrzeby przyszłych rekrutacji, zaznaczając check-box w formularzu. Możesz w każdym czasie wycofać zgodę, ale nie wpływa to na legalność przetwarzania przed jej wycofaniem. Twoje prawa: Dostęp, sprostowanie, przeniesienie, usunięcie danych, ograniczenie ich przetwarzania, sprzeciw w zakresie przetwarzania danych na podstawie uzasadnionego interesu, cofnięcie zgody, skarga do PUODO. Więcej informacji: Znajdziesz tu Informacja o ochronie prywatności kandydatów do zatrudnienia w Securitas lub kontaktując się z naszym Inspektorem Ochrony Danych: iod(at)securitas.pl.

evidence.title: Relief Security Officer
evidence.text:
We’re Hiring: Relief Security Officer

📍 Location: Bristol, BS32 4QH

💰 Pay: £14.00 per hour

📅 Hours: Various shifts including days, nights, and weekends (average 36 hours per week)

🎓 From day one, you’ll gain access to outstanding Learning and Development opportunities, Mentorship, and a whole load of benefits from big brand discounts to give back schemes!

Grade: Site Based

See a Different World. Where potential is seen and progress is nurtured.

As a Relief Security Officer, you will provide security services across a variety of sites within a designated geographical area as required. The Relief Security Officer will be responsible for protecting employees, property, and assets in line with Assignment Instructions and site-specific customer requirements, while delivering exceptional customer service. The Relief Security Officer will consistently demonstrate Securitas' core values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness and must hold a valid SIA licence before commencing operational duties.

Responsibilities

You’ll play a vital part in keeping people, property, and information safe. That includes:

Welcoming and assisting staff, visitors, and contractors.

Conducting regular safety and security patrols.

Ensuring compliance with regulations and procedures.

Supporting emergency protocols, including evacuations and searches.

Keeping vigilant, reporting incidents, and preventing disruption.

Accurately maintaining records of all activity and handovers.

Provide a visible security presence across the site

Conduct regular foot patrols

Monitor CCTV systems and security alarms

Manage access control and visitor sign-in procedures

Respond to incidents and emergencies professionally

Complete accurate incident and shift reports

Assist employees, contractors, and visitors

Ensure all health, safety, and security procedures are followed at all times

Please note - The responsibilities listed here aren’t the full picture—but they give you a good sense of the role. If you meet the minimum requirements and believe you’ve got what it takes to succeed, we’d love to hear from you.

What we’re looking for:

We’re looking for someone who sees a different world—someone who values teamwork, shows initiative, and wants to grow. Ideally, you’ll have:

What We're Looking For:

Valid SIA Door Supervisor or Security Guarding Licence

Full UK Driving Licence and access to a vehicle

Previous corporate security experience preferred

Right to work in the UK with a 5-year checkable history

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Strong customer service and interpersonal skills

Professional appearance and attitude

Strong attention to detail and observational skills

Ability to remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions

Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently

Flexibility to work days, nights, weekends, and public holidays

See a different world with Securitas UK

Ready to make a difference? You're one step closer to joining over 322,000 colleagues worldwide who help make your world a safer place every day.

At Securitas, our values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness guide everything we do. We believe in making a clear promise to our people:

Opportunity – Seeing potential in every person

People – Putting people at the heart of what we do

Purpose – Making your world a safer place

So what happens next?

Our Talent Team reviews every application carefully and is here to support you throughout the process. Whatever the outcome, you'll always hear back from us.

Creating spaces for you to belong

We're proud to be a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Through our networks, partnerships and celebrations throughout the year, we're building a culture where differences are valued and people can be themselves.

Ready to see a rewarding world?

From day one, you'll have access to a range of benefits, including:

Employee discounts with leading global and local brands.

Health and wellbeing support, 24/7 online GP services.

Pension and financial wellbeing resources and support.

Life assurance for added peace of mind.

Employee eligibility to EV Schemes (Subject to graded benefits).

Keen to take the next step...

Join a team that values your contribution, supports your growth and helps you build a rewarding career.

Click "I'm Interested" and start seeing a different world with Securitas UK.

evidence.text:
Jesteśmy skandynawskim koncernem ochrony – największym globalnym graczem na rynku. Pozycję lidera zdobyliśmy dzięki naszym pracownikom oraz nowoczesnym, zintegrowanym rozwiązaniom technicznym.

Obecnie poszukujemy kandydatki/kandydata na stanowisko:

Koordynator/ka ds. bezpieczeństwa obiektów

LOKALIZACJA: WARSZAWA (woj. mazowiecki, łódzkie, lubelskie)

Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie odpowiedzialna za nadzór nad realizacją usług ochrony oraz aktywny rozwój zespołów poprzez wspieranie i motywowanie naszych pracowników.

Wyzwania, jakie na Ciebie czekają:

Koordynowanie działań ochrony w obiektach biurowych i handlowych

Przygotowywanie, wdrażanie oraz regularne aktualizowanie dokumentacji obiektowej

Planowanie grafików, koordynowanie obsady pracowniczej oraz terminowe zapewnienie zasobów kadrowych zgodnie z wymaganiami klientów i potrzebami operacyjnymi

Organizacja i monitorowanie wdrożenia nowych pracowników do pracy w obiekcie

Zapewnienie umundurowania i wyposażenia dla pracowników niezbędnych do realizacji usług ochrony

Zapewnienie znajomości i przestrzegania przez pracowników standardów bezpieczeństwa i higieny pracy w trakcie wykonywania obowiązków służbowych

Koordynacja i przygotowanie obiektów do wdrożenia nowych narzędzi i systemów

Dbanie o utrzymanie standardów jakościowych

Budowanie relacji z klientami, w tym przyjmowanie zgłaszanych przez klientów potrzeb oraz ich realizacja

Identyfikowanie i rekomendowanie pracowników z potencjałem do rozwoju oraz podnoszenie umiejętności u obecnych pracowników poprzez szkolenia oraz instruktaże

Codzienny kontakt z pracownikami w kwestiach operacyjnych oraz reagowanie w przypadku pojawiających się trudności

Kontrole w obiektach oraz przygotowanie i asystowanie przy audytach wewnętrznych

Oczekiwania, jakie mamy w stosunku do Ciebie:

Wpis na listę Kwalifikowanych Pracowników Ochrony

Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu zespołem pracowników

Gotowość do pracy w terenie (praca na terenie kilku województw) oraz do pracy w trybie zadaniowym

Wysokie umiejętności analityczne, zdolność krytycznego myślenia oraz identyfikowanie przyczyn pojawiających się problemów i wdrażanie rozwiązań

Komunikatywność, umiejętność nawiązywania i utrzymywania dobrych relacji zarówno wewnątrz organizacji, jak i na zewnątrz

Wielozadaniowość i podejmowanie racjonalnych decyzji, a także umiejętność pracy pod presją czasową lub sytuacyjną

Nastawienie na pracę zespołową

Bardzo dobra organizacja pracy

Nastawienie na identyfikowanie i reagowanie na potrzeby klientów

Otwartość na rozwój i podnoszenie własnych kwalifikacji

Znajomość j. angielskiego na poziomie B1/B2

Prawo jazdy kat. B

Ze swojej strony oferujemy:

Umowę o pracę

Narzędzia potrzebne do pracy: telefon, laptop, samochód służbowy (również do celów prywatnych)

Możliwość dofinansowania do studiów, kursów oraz szkoleń

Programy rozwojowe ukierunkowane na podnoszenie kwalifikacji, co w dłuższej perspektywie może przełożyć się na możliwość awansu i rozwoju zawodowego w strukturach firmy

Dofinansowanie do karnetów sportowo-rekreacyjnych

Prywatną opiekę medyczną w korzystnej cenie

Ubezpieczenie NNW (Następstw Nieszczęśliwych Wypadków)

Możliwość korzystania z funduszu socjalnego w postaci pożyczek nieoprocentowanych, zapomóg, dopłat do wypoczynku dzieci (ZFŚS)

Zainteresowane osoby prosimy o przesłanie CV. Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi Kandydatami.

Współadministratorzy danych: Securitas Polska sp. z o.o. i Securitas Services sp. z o.o. (ul. Postępu 6, 02-676 Warszawa). Cele przetwarzania: Rekrutacja bieżąca i przyszła (za zgodą), obsługa roszczeń. Podstawa prawna: obowiązek prawny, działania przed zawarciem umowy, uzasadniony interes – obsługa roszczeń, zgoda (art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a-c, f i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. a i b RODO). Zgoda: Zgodę na przetwarzanie danych (innych niż wymagane) wyrażasz poprzez ich podanie (w formularzu lub w Twoim CV), a na potrzeby przyszłych rekrutacji, zaznaczając check-box w formularzu. Możesz w każdym czasie wycofać zgodę, ale nie wpływa to na legalność przetwarzania przed jej wycofaniem. Twoje prawa: Dostęp, sprostowanie, przeniesienie, usunięcie danych, ograniczenie ich przetwarzania, sprzeciw w zakresie przetwarzania danych na podstawie uzasadnionego interesu, cofnięcie zgody, skarga do PUODO. Więcej informacji: Znajdziesz tu Informacja o ochronie prywatności kandydatów do zatrudnienia w Securitas lub kontaktując się z naszym Inspektorem Ochrony Danych: iod(at)securitas.pl.

Strategy & Management Consulting

Sia’s Strategy & Management Consulting global footprint and expertise in more than 40 sectors and services allow us to enhance our clients' businesses worldwide. We guide their projects and initiatives in strategy, business transformation, IT & digital strategy.

A digital leader or growing disruptor, everyone must transform themselves to maintain their advantage. The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to help grow Sia’s Legal AI & Technology practice and lead transformation programs for corporate legal departments and law firms. You will advise legal leaders, shape technology decisions, and lead multidisciplinary teams from opportunity assessment through implementation and adoption.

The role combines client delivery, business development, and practice leadership. You will work closely with Sia’s legal operations, AI, data, and engineering specialists to improve legal service delivery, reduce manual work, and build capabilities clients can sustain.

Key responsibilities

Advise legal leaders and shape transformation programs

Partner with General Counsel, Heads of Legal Operations, and technology leaders to assess workflows, systems, data, and organizational readiness for AI.

Develop business cases, prioritized use cases, technology roadmaps, and operating models, including Legal AI Centers of Excellence.

Shape initiatives across contracting, legal intake and triage, knowledge management, matter and spend management, litigation support, and legal reporting.

Lead legal AI and technology delivery

Lead client engagements across workstreams, owning scope, staffing, budgets, delivery quality, and executive communications.

Guide build-versus-buy decisions, vendor assessments, pilots, and implementation of legal AI platforms, contract lifecycle management systems, and custom AI agents.

Translate legal requirements into workflows, product backlogs, contract playbooks, and acceptance criteria. Coordinate configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, and deployment with technical teams.

Establish evaluation methods with legal reviewers to assess accuracy, completeness, source reliability, and business usefulness. Address confidentiality, privilege, access controls, and human oversight in solution design.

Drive adoption and demonstrate value

Lead practical workshops, training, and change programs that help lawyers and legal operations teams use AI effectively in their daily work.

Track adoption, quality, turnaround times, capacity gains, and cost savings. Use feedback and performance data to improve solutions and establish ongoing ownership and support.

Grow the practice and develop client relationships

Identify and qualify opportunities, expand existing accounts, and lead discovery sessions, proposals, statements of work, and pricing with Sia leadership.

Develop offerings, demonstrations, reusable delivery methods, and client credentials that turn project experience into repeatable services.

Build relationships with legal technology providers and collaborate across Sia’s international teams. Contribute to campaigns, thought leadership, and industry events.

Build and lead teams

Coach consultants and managers, oversee work quality, support recruitment, and develop the team’s legal technology and applied AI capabilities.

Coordinate internal initiatives across legal operations and technical specialists, with clear priorities, owners, and deliverables.

8+ years of relevant experience in consulting, legal operations, legal technology, or technology transformation, including substantial work with legal departments or law firms.

3+ years leading teams or complex client programs, with accountability for delivery, senior stakeholder relationships, and team development.

A track record of implementing legal technology or AI solutions through rollout and adoption, with measurable operational improvements.

Strong understanding of legal workflows, particularly contracting and legal service delivery, and the ability to translate legal requirements into practical technology solutions.

Practical experience evaluating and using generative AI tools, designing workflows, and assessing outputs. Working knowledge of AI agents, retrieval from enterprise knowledge sources, and integration considerations.

Experience developing proposals, scoping engagements, and contributing to account growth or new business.

Strong workshop facilitation, executive communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect legal, business, and technical teams.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience. A law degree is welcome but not required.

Preferred experience

Experience with platforms such as Harvey, Ivo, Legora, or enterprise CLM solutions, alongside general-purpose AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot.

Experience developing contract playbooks, legal knowledge repositories, AI evaluation frameworks, or Legal AI governance and operating models.

Ability to prototype workflows using low-code tools or code, and familiarity with APIs, data models, and enterprise systems.

An established network in legal operations or legal technology, and experience building offerings or participating in communities such as CLOC or ACC.

Why join Sia

Help shape a growing Legal AI & Technology practice, work directly with legal leaders on implementation and adoption, and collaborate with consulting, data, and engineering teams to bring new solutions to market.

Sia invests in total rewards that support how our people work, live, and grow.

Compensation

Annual Performance Bonus

Personal Sales Bonus (uncapped)

401(k) with company match and immediate vesting; HSA and FSA options

evidence.title: Community Manager - Contract
evidence.text:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

About Sia Experience-Marketing Advisory

Sia Experience is the end-to-end marketing and customer experience arm of Sia. Agile and collaborative, our Marketing Advisory Business Line is recognized for delivering high-impact, growth-focused solutions by blending marketing, CX, creative, AI, and deep industry expertise.

As strategic partners, The Marketing Advisory team empowers clients across technology, luxury, consumer goods, finance, energy, and more to scale operational excellence and drive brand-led growth through AI- and data-driven strategies. Our teams lead full-funnel marketing transformations—from strategy and go-to-market execution to experience design, performance measurement, and sustainable impact.

It’s an exciting time to join us. SiaX has long been the agency behind some of the world’s biggest brands—now we’re expanding, becoming one of the most recognizable names for companies that demand bold, business-driving creative. We’re shaping SiaX into the go-to agency of the future. This is your chance to be part of that growth, working alongside top-tier creatives, consultants and agency leaders to continuously evolve what a modern, full-service agency can be. Opportunities like this don’t come around often—if you want in on the next level, this is it.

Contract roles are geared toward independent professionals interested in temporary or project-based work.

Sia Title: Project Consultant (Exempt Contractor)

Project Title: Community Manager

Project Length: This is a temporary position with an expected duration through 12/31/26, may extend

Project Hours: 40 hours per week

Rate: $75-95/hour

The expected compensation for this contract is per year. The exact pay rate will vary depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to skills, experience, and location.

Location: Open to remote candidates

About the Role

Sia is partnering with one of the world's leading technology companies to help build the community around a next-generation consumer AI product at the frontier of artificial intelligence.

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a new community experience from the ground up, powered by cutting-edge AI and designed for people looking to get more out of life with the help of AI agents. The product is already generating real organic energy: users are showing up, experimenting, sharing what they create, and forming their own pockets of culture without much prompting. Now, the opportunity is to turn that momentum into a community that lasts, scales globally, and meaningfully influences where the product goes next.

You'll play a critical role in defining how people connect, collaborate, learn, and create value within an AI-enabled ecosystem with the potential to reach millions. You'll work at the intersection of AI, consumer technology, community, product, and culture, combining the creative freedom of building something new with the reach and resources of one of the world's largest technology companies.

We're looking for someone who thinks like both a strategist and a builder. Someone who is equally energized by understanding community behavior through data, designing engagement programs, testing new ideas, and leveraging AI to create smarter, more personalized community experiences.

This isn't just about managing a community. It's about helping define what community looks like for a new generation of AI products and creating a direct connection between some of the product's most engaged users and the teams building its future.

If you're passionate about emerging technology, human behavior, community growth, and creating experiences people genuinely love, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Own the Community Strategy

Define what community means for an emerging AI product: who it's for, what members get out of it, and how it grows

Build a home for the most engaged users that remains valuable, trusted, and well-run as the community scales

Develop ambassador, advocate, and power-user programs that give highly engaged users a meaningful role in the community

Design and test engagement programs that deepen participation, connection, and long-term community value

Make it simple for members to run their own events and meetups through scalable programs and toolkits

Partner closely with social, brand, and creative teams to bring what the community is creating to a broader audience

Drive adoption in new markets through community-led outreach, adapting the approach as the product expands internationally

Explore how AI can enable smarter, more personalized, and more scalable community experiences

Build the Growth Loop

Partner with growth teams on referral and invite mechanics that feel organic to the community

Identify creators, advocates, and early adopters producing compelling content and help them continue building

Turn community participation into sustainable product advocacy, referrals, and organic growth

Use community behavior, engagement data, and experimentation to understand what drives participation, retention, and advocacy

Keep authentic user stories, use cases, and emerging behaviors flowing back to marketing and product teams

Test new ideas quickly, learn from the results, and scale the programs that resonate most with members

Connect the Community to the Product

Serve as the internal voice of the community, translating user behavior, feedback, emerging AI use cases, requests, and friction into insights Product and Engineering can act on quickly

Identify how people are actually using and experimenting with the product, including behaviors and use cases the team may not have anticipated

Build feedback loops between early adopters and the teams shaping the product roadmap

Own community health metrics including activity, retention, sentiment, advocacy, and community-driven growth

Combine qualitative feedback with participation and behavioral data to identify patterns, opportunities, and emerging needs

Help ensure the path from product to community, and from community back to product, actually works

What You Bring

8+ years of experience across community, social, developer relations, creator programs, product advocacy, or related areas

Experience supporting at least one consumer technology product at meaningful scale

Demonstrated experience building an ambassador, advocate, creator, or superuser program from the ground up

A builder mindset with experience taking community programs from idea to launch, testing what works, and iterating quickly

Strong interest in artificial intelligence and how AI products are changing the way people create, communicate, and interact with technology

Experience building community around an AI, generative AI, emerging technology, or highly technical product is strongly preferred

Ideally, experience engaging early adopters or technically curious users around rapidly evolving products

Experience scaling an online community beyond manual moderation through automation, community roles, governance, escalation paths, and scalable processes

Strong analytical instincts and the ability to use community behavior, engagement data, and qualitative feedback to inform strategy

Ability to translate community insights into clear, actionable recommendations for Product and Engineering

Strong writing skills and a distinct, authentic voice. You understand internet culture, can read a room, and know how to communicate in a way that feels human rather than corporate

Comfort operating in an early-stage environment where the product, community, and playbook are still evolving

A track record of building trust as a core part of the community experience

Nice to Have

Direct experience with AI, generative AI, AI-powered consumer products, AI agents, or emerging technology communities

Experience launching or managing beta, early-access, or design-partner programs

Experience working with highly engaged early adopters and translating their feedback into product insights

Experience using AI, automation, or personalization to improve community engagement or operations

Experience building community internationally

Experience with creator-led or user-generated content ecosystems

Experience working with a product built around a distinct character, identity, or persona

What Success Looks Like

A thriving community that grows organically, where people initially show up for the AI product and stay for the community around it

A community experience that helps people connect, collaborate, learn, and discover new ways to get value from AI

A recognizable power-user or ambassador program that members genuinely want to join

Early adopters and highly engaged users consistently influencing the product roadmap

A steady flow of emerging AI use cases, user behaviors, and community insights reaching Product and Engineering

Community programs that are continuously tested and improved using engagement data, member behavior, and feedback

The most engaged users becoming some of the product's strongest advocates and sources of organic growth

A scalable community model that can grow alongside the product as it reaches millions of users across new markets

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Sia Partners is an equal opportunity employer. At Sia Partners, we are committed to treating all Applicants and Associates fairly based on their abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by law.

Engineering Manager
evidence.text:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

- Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

- Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

- Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

- Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

- Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

- Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

- Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

- Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

- Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

- Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

- Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

- Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

- Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

- Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

- Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

- Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

- Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

- Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

- Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

- Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

- Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

- Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

- A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

- Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

- The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

- Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

- A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

- Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

- Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

- Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

- Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

- An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

- The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

- A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

- a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

- a delivery or project management position;

- a Product Manager role;

- a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;

- a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

- Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience

- Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland

- Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it

- Private health insurance for you and your family

- Company pension

- 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location

- Learning and development support

- Share options

- Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES AT STORA

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

evidence.title: Head of Sales
evidence.text:
Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one.

There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.

The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

- Where should the team focus its time and why?

- How does outbound become consistently productive?

- Where are deals getting stuck?

- How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

- Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

- What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

- How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- Sales strategy and execution

- Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

- Outbound performance and pipeline generation

- Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

- Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

- Performance management and clear expectations across the team

- Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

- Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

You’ll also stay close to customers and deals.

Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports.

WHAT A STRONG CANDIDATE LOOKS LIKE

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

- Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

- Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

- Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

- Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

- Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

- Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

- Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards

- Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it

- Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable

- Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters

- Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing

This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. If you want to inherit a large sales organisation, established territories and a finished playbook, this probably is not the role.

Experience in vertical SaaS, operationally complex industries or international markets would be useful, but none are essential.

WHY STORA

Stora builds the software self storage operators use to run and grow their businesses, covering areas including bookings, payments, facility management, reporting and automation.

The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets.

For a Head of Sales, that creates an interesting point to join:

- A proven product rather than an early experiment

- Existing customers and market credibility

- A sales team already in place

- Significant European market opportunity ahead

- Direct access to the CEO and leadership team

- The ability to meaningfully shape commercial strategy

- Share options and genuine participation in the upside created

The foundations exist. The opportunity is to build what comes next.

LOCATION

Stora operates as a distributed business across the UK and Europe.

Being based in Northern Ireland would be particularly useful given the proximity to the CEO and leadership team, although strong candidates elsewhere in the UK or EU will absolutely be considered.

WHAT STORA OFFERS

- Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission plan

- Share options

- 35 days annual leave

- Private health insurance for you and your family

- Company pension

- Apple hardware

- Work from home budget

- Learning and development support

- Regular in-person team events and company meet-ups

NEXT STEPS

Applications are reviewed as they come in and Stora will move quickly where there is a strong fit.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

Stora is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect.

Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment decisions are based on merit, capability and business need.

If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let the team know.

evidence.title: Software Engineer II - Product (Multiple Roles)
evidence.text:
WHAT IS STORA?

Stora https://stora.co/ is a self-storage software platform leading a technology-driven transformation in the industry. We help operators manage their businesses, automate processes, and grow revenue.

In just over five years, we’ve helped more than 450 operators process tens of millions in automated payments. Known as innovators in our space, we’re a fast-growing team focused on making self-storage better for everyone.

WHY JOIN US?

Stora offers a collaborative environment where you’ll have room to grow and excel. We value honesty, humility, and responsibility, and encourage everyone to contribute ideas and take ownership of their role. As a part of Stora, you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on our product and be a key player in a rapidly evolving industry.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a software engineer at Stora, you’ll join a team of passionate Rubyists, working together to enhance and expand our Rails-based platform. You’ll help deliver our product roadmap https://stora.co/roadmap and improve internal tools that keep Stora running smoothly.

You’ll work across a variety of interesting domains: from billing and CRM to public APIs, reporting, integrations, and internal tooling, with plenty of room to grow into the areas that interest you most.

We’re looking for someone with experience building production Rails applications, comfortable working across the stack and diving into JavaScript and CSS when needed.

You’ll thrive here if you enjoy taking ownership from idea to delivery, and can work independently on well-defined projects while collaborating closely with experienced engineers in a small, fast-moving team.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and maintain features, owning them from initial discussions through to deployment.

- Work closely with the product team and other stakeholders to shape and refine new features.

- Dedicate time to app maintenance – we aim for at least 20% – improving stability, performance, and developer experience.

- Write and maintain tests so we can confidently deploy to production multiple times per day.

- Monitor, investigate, and resolve issues to keep the system stable and performant as we scale.

- Collaborate with and learn from experienced engineers to continuously grow your skills.

OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK

We take a majestic monolith approach — keeping our Rails app clean, cohesive, and aligned with best practices from the Ruby community. Our stack should feel familiar to most experienced Rubyists:

- Backend: Rails 8, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq

- Frontend: Turbo 8, a sprinkling of React, ViewComponents, Sass, BEM methodology

- Testing: Minitest, Capybara, Playwright

- Payments: Stripe Connect and Billing

- Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You’ve built and shipped production Rails applications and know your way around its ecosystem from writing clean, maintainable code to debugging in a live environment. ActiveRecord, background jobs, and the request/response cycle.

- Comfortable leveraging modern LLM‑powered tools to speed up development, troubleshoot, and explore solutions while knowing when to rely on your own expertise.

- A testing mindset, with experience writing automated tests in Minitest or RSpec.

- Comfortable debugging and troubleshooting production issues.

- Able to work independently on well‑defined projects while collaborating closely with a small, fast‑moving team.

- Clear communicator who can explain technical challenges and trade‑offs effectively.

Benefits & Compensation

- Competitive salary – starting from £50k+

- Remote Work – Fully remote within the UK or EU only. Candidates must be based in either the United Kingdom or the European Union.

- Office Access – Use of office in Belfast for those who live locally.

- Health & wellness – Private health insurance for you and your family.

- Retirement – Company pension plan.

- Leave – 35 days paid annual leave

- Professional growth - L&D support

- Share options

- WFH budget

evidence.title: Product Manager, Core Experience
evidence.text:
In just five years, Stora https://stora.co has become the platform behind more than 30% of UK self storage locations, and we're scaling globally from here. Operators have processed over £150m in automated payments through us, and see an average of 32% business growth after they switch.

We're doing this in a market that's wide open. Europe has over 10,000 self storage sites and is growing fast, yet it sits years behind the US on maturity and is still barely touched by good software. The UK is our stronghold. The rest of Europe is where we're heading next.

Stora is the operating system for modern self storage: online bookings, payments, facility management, reporting, and automation in one platform. We started as operators ourselves, and that's still how we think. If you want to own a product operators depend on every day, in a company genuinely rethinking how it builds, this is it.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We have a strong product team, great engineers, and a growing product. The bottleneck isn't ideas or execution capacity. It's people who can hold the full picture at once.

What the business needs, what the customer actually experiences, what's technically feasible, what to cut when time is short, and knowing when to slow down. Making good calls across all of it. That's the job.

We've shortened the loop between insight and shipped product by stripping out the layers that slow good judgement down. The quality bar didn't move. This role exists to keep doing that. It carries real ownership from day one, and the scope grows as Stora does.

THE SURFACE YOU'D OWN

This is the product operators live in every day, and the storefront their own customers book through. You're designing for two users at once: the operator running the business, and the end customer renting the unit. Getting that B2B2C experience right is a genuine craft problem. It's a broad, central surface, and it's heavy on UX.

Concretely, the surface includes:

- Core workflows: customers, units, tenancies, access

- Roles, permissions, account structure

- Operational reporting: occupancy, utilisation, activity

- The internal data layer: event tracking, core models, metric definitions

- The growth surface: storefront, checkout, the lead → booking funnel

If an operator uses it daily, or relies on it to understand their business, it sits with this team.

HOW WE ACTUALLY WORK

We've changed how product gets built at Stora. This is how we operate now.

Designers work directly in the codebase. Engineers and product people work closely together from the start. We use AI genuinely: to explore, prototype and move faster. The work gets closer to reality, sooner.

If you're at a company that talks about moving faster but runs the same process it did three years ago, this will feel different. We're not done evolving how we work, and this person will have real scope to shape that.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own a problem space end-to-end, from understanding the customer need to something live in the product

- Work across both sides of the experience: operator back office and end-customer storefront

- Work directly with engineering leads. Close collaboration, not handoff

- Make scope calls. Know what to cut, what's fundamental, what can wait

- Work with or without a designer, depending on the problem. What matters is the outcome

- Stay close to customers, talk to operators, understand how they run their businesses, bring that into every decision

- Shape how we work. The process isn't fixed. If something's slowing things down, fix it

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Real product experience at a SaaS company. You've owned features or problem spaces end-to-end and shipped things people use. Roughly 2+ years, though we care more about the evidence than the number

- A builder by instinct. You make things: side projects, tools, a company you tried to start. We'd rather see someone who ships than someone who only plans

- A design or engineering past works too. You may have come from design, engineering, or somewhere else entirely. Designers and people who've started their own things tend to do well here

- Great product taste. You can tell the difference between a solution that works and one that just ships

- You define it yourself. You don't need everything defined to make progress

- Real design sense. Strong enough to contribute or push back, which matters a lot on a surface this UX-heavy

- AI-native. You use AI as a natural part of how you think and work. Not waiting to be shown how

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need a detailed brief before you can start

- You've only ever worked inside someone else's process and haven't shipped anything of your own

- You think good product work stops before it ships

- You go quiet when a problem is ambiguous instead of pushing into it

WHY STORA

- A category-defining surface to own. Self storage software is wide open, and the core experience is the heart of it. You set the direction here, you don't inherit it.

- Work that ships, and that you feel. We've stripped out the layers between insight and shipped product. What you build reaches operators in weeks, not quarters.

- A team that builds differently. Designers in the codebase, AI used for real, process that bends when it should. Small team, outsized impact.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary

- Share options

- Remote across the UK & Europe, or hybrid from our Belfast office

- 35 days holiday

- Private health insurance (for you + family)

- Company pension plan

- Apple hardware

- Learning & development support

NEXT STEPS

When you apply, we'll ask for a link to something you've made — a product, a side project, a repo, a tool you built because something annoyed you. It doesn't need to be polished, successful, or related to storage. We just want to see that you build. Please include one.

We're reviewing applications as they come in and will be in touch quickly if it looks like a match.

evidence.title: Senior Software Engineer (Product)
evidence.text:
WHAT IS STORA?

Stora https://stora.co/ is on a mission to reinvent self-storage through technology. Our platform helps operators run their businesses more efficiently, automate the day-to-day, and unlock new revenue opportunities.

In just over five years, we’ve helped more than 450 operators process tens of millions in automated payments. We’re recognised as innovators in our space, and we’re a fast-growing, product-led team focused on making self-storage better for everyone.

WHY JOIN US?

We believe senior engineers should have room to lead, not just code.

At Stora you’ll:

- Set the direction — help shape our product, architecture, and engineering practices.

- Lead by example — deliver high-quality features while mentoring and supporting others.

- Work with impact — your ideas won’t get lost in a committee; you’ll see them live in production, helping real businesses every day.

- Stay hands-on — we value technical leadership that’s grounded in active coding and problem-solving.

We value honesty, humility, and responsibility — and we give everyone the trust and autonomy to own their role.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll join a small, passionate team of Rubyists, taking ownership of complex projects from concept to deployment. Alongside writing maintainable, well-tested code, you’ll help define technical direction, guide architectural decisions, and mentor engineers as we scale.

Our work spans diverse domains including billing, CRM to public APIs, reporting, integrations, and internal tooling

You’ll have the freedom to specialise or lead initiatives in the areas that interest you most. We’re pragmatic, not dogmatic — we balance moving fast with building for the long term.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead the design and development of complex features from concept to deployment.

- Collaborate with product and stakeholders to define scope, refine requirements, and ensure solutions meet business goals.

- Make sound architectural decisions to keep our Rails app maintainable, performant, and scalable.

- Dedicate time (at least 20%) to improving stability, performance, and developer experience.

- Maintain a strong automated test suite so we can confidently deploy to production multiple times per day.

- Proactively monitor, investigate, and resolve production issues, driving preventative improvements.

- Mentor and support engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.

OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK

We take a majestic monolith approach — keeping our Rails app clean, cohesive, and aligned with Ruby community best practices.

- Backend: Rails 8, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

- Frontend: Turbo 8, targeted React for richer UI, ViewComponents, Sass, BEM methodology

- Testing: Minitest, Capybara, Playwright

- Payments: Stripe Connect and Billing

- Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven track record designing, building, and scaling production Rails applications.

- Strong command of Rails fundamentals — ActiveRecord, background jobs, request/response cycle — and how to apply them effectively.

- Experience architecting maintainable systems that balance speed of delivery with long-term sustainability.

- Comfortable working across the stack, including frontend technologies (JavaScript, CSS).

- Skilled at using modern LLM-powered tools to accelerate work and explore solutions — with the judgement to know when to rely on your own expertise.

- Strong testing mindset, with hands-on experience in Minitest or RSpec.

- Confident debugging and resolving complex production issues.

- Skilled mentor with the ability to grow and support other engineers.

- Clear communicator, able to articulate technical challenges, trade-offs, and decisions.

BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

- Competitive annual salary – starting from £75k DoE

- Remote Work Option – Can be fully remote within the UK or EU only. Candidates must be based in either the United Kingdom or the European Union

- Office Access – Use of office in Belfast for those who live locally

- Health & wellness – Private health insurance for you and your family

- Retirement – Company pension plan

- Leave – 35 days paid annual leave

- Professional growth - L&D support

- Share options

- WFH budget

- Company-wide social events

NEXT STEPS

We’re reviewing applications as they come in and will be in touch quickly if it looks like a match.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES AT STORA

Stora is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

All recruitment and employment decisions are made on the basis of merit, competence, and business need. We actively promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

evidence.title: Software Engineer II - (Ruby)
evidence.text:
Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over four years, we’ve helped more than 300 operators process tens of millions in automated payments. We’re recognised as innovators in our space, and we’re a fast-growing, product-led team focused on making self-storage better for everyone.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a mid-level Software Engineer to join our growing product team.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve our Rails-based platform, contributing to customer-facing features, internal tools and the ongoing stability and performance of the product.

This role is well suited to someone with solid Ruby on Rails experience who is comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.

We work best with self-starting team players: people who take ownership, communicate clearly and enjoy working in small, focused teams. You’ll have support from senior engineers, but you should also be comfortable working independently on well-defined tasks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Build and maintain product features, taking ownership from initial discussion through to deployment.

- Collaborate with Product and other stakeholders to define and refine the scope of new features.

- Contribute to app maintenance. We aim to spend at least 20% of our time improving stability, performance and developer experience.

- Write and maintain tests so we can confidently deploy to production multiple times per day.

- Investigate, debug and resolve issues to keep the system stable as we scale.

- Act on monitoring insights to keep the app performant and reliable.

- Contribute to code reviews and team discussions.

- Learn from senior engineers and continue developing your skills in a collaborative environment.

OUR TECHNOLOGY STACK

Backend: Rails 7, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq
Frontend: Hotwire/Turbo 8, targeted React, ViewComponents, Sass, BEM
Testing: Minitest, Capybara, Selenium
Payments: Stripe Connect and Billing
Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 2 years working with Ruby on Rails.

- Solid understanding of Rails and its ecosystem, including ActiveRecord, background jobs and the request/response cycle.

- Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

- Comfortable working across the stack, including JavaScript and CSS when needed.

- Familiarity with writing tests using Minitest, RSpec or similar.

- Comfortable debugging and troubleshooting production issues.

- Good communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical challenges, trade-offs and blockers clearly.

- Excited to work in a small, fast-moving product team alongside experienced engineers.

WHY JOIN US?

Stora offers a collaborative environment where you’ll have room to grow, contribute and do meaningful product work.

We value honesty, humility and responsibility. We encourage everyone to contribute ideas, take ownership of their role and help us improve the way we build.

As part of Stora, you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on our product and play an important role in a rapidly evolving industry.

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION

- Competitive salary: From £50,000 (or Euro equivalent)

- Remote work: Fully remote within the UK or EU. Candidates must be based in either the United Kingdom or the European Union.

- Office access: Use of our Belfast office for those who live locally.

- Health and wellness: Private health insurance for you and your family.

- Retirement: Company pension plan.

- Leave: 35 days paid annual leave inclusive of public holidays (dependent on location)

- Professional growth: Share options, WFH budget and opportunities for in-person meetups.

NEXT STEPS

We’re actively reviewing CVs on an ongoing basis and will reach out if your profile feels like a good match for the role.

EQUALITY, DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Stora, we’re committed to building a team where everyone feels welcome, respected and able to do their best work.

We value different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital or family status, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or socio-economic background.

Maintenance Technician - Roving - Urban Properties
evidence.text:
Roving Maintenance Technician - Sunrise Management – Urban Properties Division

San Diego, California

Who we are:

At Sunrise, we practice resident hospitality, focusing on what matters most: Helping people feel right at home. We are people people who pride ourselves in providing our residents with a Positive Living Experience.

About this role:

The Roving Maintenance Technician provides hands-on maintenance support across multiple Sunrise properties, ensuring each assigned community meets company standards for quality, safety, and curb appeal. This role supports onsite teams during staffing gaps, high-volume work periods, or special projects, adapting to varied environments and property needs. Responsibilities include general maintenance, preventive programs, timely service request completion, and adherence to all safety regulations while traveling between sites as scheduled by management.

Hourly Pay Range:

$25.00 - $27.00 DOE

What you’ll do - Includes but are not limited to:

Maintenance and Repairs

Perform general maintenance tasks, including appliance repair, basic electrical, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, pool maintenance, and custodial work.

Maintain the exterior curb appeal of the community and ensure the cleanliness of the grounds.

Assist with daily upkeep of pools, spas, laundry rooms, recreation areas, rental offices, restrooms, and other common areas.

Ensure apartments are rent-ready within 3-5 days of vacancy.

Respond promptly and professionally to tenant service requests, ensuring efficient resolution within 24 hours. Notify the Community Manager and residents of delays caused by part orders or other factors.

Property Inspections

Maintain accurate inventory of tools, equipment, and supplies.

Use personal protective equipment (e.g., back belts, goggles, dust masks, hard hats, gloves) as instructed and assigned.

Conduct inspections and adhere to monthly preventive maintenance directives, including lighting, fire safety, pool/spa, life/safety hazards, and signage checks.

Understand the locations of gas, electricity, irrigation, and water shutoffs, as well as sewer cleanouts.

Collaboration and Documentation

Assist with move-in and move-out inspections as directed.

Monitor and document the status of vacant units.

Recommend improvements to methods of operation, safety, and service quality.

Suggest changes to working conditions and equipment to enhance efficiency.

Perform on-call emergency service as required.

Collaborate on special projects such as preventive maintenance of building components or mechanical systems.

Adhere to Sunrise Management’s Injury and Illness Prevention Policy and Hazardous Materials Policy. Maintain Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) for chemicals used on-site and ensure familiarity with safety precautions.

Communicate maintenance problems or safety concerns promptly to Site Management.

Ability to read, write, understand, and communicate in English required.

Represent Sunrise Management professionally, maintaining a neat appearance and adhering to the company’s dress code.

Other Duties and Responsibilities

Attend and participate in training seminars as requested.

Assist other staff members as needed.

Deliver communications to residents as required.

Support resident functions and activities.

Perform additional duties as assigned.

Multi-Site Support & Communication

Rotate between assigned Sunrise communities within the designated region to provide coverage and operational support.

Maintain regular communication with Community Managers and Maintenance Supervisors regarding priorities, property updates, and resident needs.

Support consistency in maintenance standards and safety practices across all sites.

Travel Requirements

Travel between multiple properties daily; mileage reimbursed per company policy.

Must be flexible with scheduling to support urgent maintenance needs.

What you will need:

Valid CA driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle, and proof of insurance required.

Must be able to travel to multiple property locations within assigned region.

1-2 years of hands-on maintenance experience (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, painting).

General computer skills, including operating a mobile device required.

Strong attention to detail, organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills

Superior customer service skills including the ability to manage difficult customers and/or situations.

Ability to work independently.

Ability to work a flexible schedule to include weekends, evenings, and holidays.

Ability to maintain a flexible, available schedule to respond promptly and resolve after-hours and weekend emergency maintenance.

Who you are:

Focused with high attention to detail

Curious and proactive

Growth-oriented and well-organized

Disciplined and self sufficient

A strong communicator

Tech savvy

What’s in it for you:

We believe people do their best work when they’re supported—personally, professionally, and beyond. Here’s what you can expect as part of our team:

Competitive compensation and career growth – As our company continues to grow and expand, so do the opportunities for our team.

Comprehensive Health Benefits – We offer medical, dental, and vision insurance to keep you and your family healthy.

Tax-Saving Benefits – Take advantage of a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) to manage healthcare and dependent care expenses efficiently.

Peace of Mind – Company-paid life insurance offers financial protection for you and your loved ones.

Work Model – Strong support for a work-life balance while keeping you connected and engaged.

Time to Recharge – Generous paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays so you can truly unplug and come back refreshed.

Sunrise Management is an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace.  We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.
